body.zh: 尼泊尔政府部长表示，周五，两名水电工人从被废墟掩埋的隧道中被救出，距离灾难性洪水席卷该地区已经过去一周多了。 能源部发布的视频显示，一名男子被从泥泞的洞口中救出，救援人员欢呼雀跃。救援人员帮助他站了起来。 照片显示，第二名男子浑身是泥，双手合十祈祷，救援人员用橙色担架将他抬走。 尼泊尔内政部长苏丹古隆确认，这两名男子分别是 30 岁的机械工头桑杰·沙阿 (Sanjay Shah) 和 45 岁的机械主管卡比尔·马哈詹 (Kabir Maharjan)。 获救工人卡比尔·马哈詹 (Kabir Maharjan) 的兄弟阿米尔·马哈詹 (Amir Maharjan) 告诉法新社：“我很高兴，我的心轻松了。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 自8月26日泥浆和瓦砾席卷该地区以来，数百名水电工人失踪，两人是其中之一。 尼泊尔能源部长比拉吉·巴克塔·什雷斯塔 (Biraj Bhakta Shrestha) 证实，一名人员已从 Trishuli 3A 隧道中安全获救，不久之后又有一人获救。 古隆在一份声明中说：“我们刚刚收到消息称，还有一人……也获救。” 政府最初表示，相信多条隧道内可能有 100 多名工人还活着。 Trishuli 3A 和其他地点的搜索仍在继续。 中尼边境发生岩冰雪崩引发的巨浪，尼泊尔救援队已找到1250多具尸体，5000多人失踪。 澳大利亚救援专家阿诺德·迪克斯曾为多起隧道塌方救援提供建议，他一直在远程支持此次行动，并正在前往尼泊尔为地面救援人员提供支持。 周五早些时候，国际隧道和地下空间协会主席迪克斯表示，Trishuli 3A 水电项目的团队相信他们听到了隧道内微弱的反应。 他说救援人员已向隧道内喊话：“别担心，我们正在救你。” 迪克斯告诉法新社：“他们相信他们收到了来自内部的微弱回应，说‘预感’，是的或好的，”他补充说，他正在前往尼泊尔参加救援工作的途中。 “现在，我‘玻璃杯满了四分之三’……经过一周 24/7 的心痛，我们可能会回到奇迹的国度，”他说。 迪克斯说，团队已经挖开了堵塞隧道的碎片 50 到 60 米，并希望随时能够突破。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: After more than a week trapped in darkness and mud, Sanjay Shah and Kabir Maharjan were pulled from the Nepal hydropower tunnel, a moment of profound relief and joy for them and their families. Their rescue, described by ministers as a 'miracle,' echoes the biblical promise that weeping may last for the night, but joy comes with the morning. It is a...
reflection.zh: 在黑暗和泥泞中被困一周多后，桑杰·沙阿和卡比尔·马哈詹从尼泊尔的水电隧道中被救出，这对他们和他们的家人来说是巨大的解脱和喜悦。他们的获救被部长们称为“奇迹”，呼应了圣经中“哭泣或许会持续一夜，但早晨必带来欢欣”的应许。这证明了人类精神的韧性和救援人员的奉献精神，在仍有数百人被困的持续危机中带来了一线希望。

verse.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verse.textZh: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

title.en: Watch: Moment workers are rescued from Nepal tunnel
title.zh: 观看：尼泊尔一隧道工人获救瞬间

summary.en: Rescuers pull two people from a hydropower tunnel more than a week after a massive flash flood devastated the Nepal-China border.
summary.zh: 在一次毁灭性的洪水摧毁了尼泊尔-中国边境一个多星期后，救援人员从一家水电隧道中救出了两人。

reflection.en: In the aftermath of a devastating flash flood in Nepal, the successful rescue of two workers from a hydropower tunnel offers a moment of profound relief. This event underscores the fragility of human endeavors against the forces of nature and the deep human instinct to seek safety and refuge.
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔发生毁灭性洪水之后，从一家水电隧道中成功营救出两名工人，带来了极大的宽慰。这一事件凸显了人类的努力在自然力量面前的脆弱性，以及人类对安全和庇护的深切本能。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Steve Irwin's family celebrates 'superhero' dad, 20 years after shock death
title.zh: 史蒂夫·欧文的家人庆祝“超级英雄”父亲，在他离世20年后

summary.en: Bindi Irwin, daughter of the late Australian conservationist Steve Irwin, known as the 'Crocodile Hunter,' paid tribute to her father on the 20th anniversary of his death. Steve Irwin died in 2006 at age 44 when a stingray barb pierced his chest while filming. Bindi described her father as a 'superhero' and stated...
summary.zh: 已故澳大利亚环保主义者史蒂夫·欧文（被誉为“鳄鱼猎手”）的女儿宾迪·欧文（Bindi Irwin）在父亲去世20周年之际向他致敬。史蒂夫·欧文于2006年去世，享年44岁，当时在拍摄时被黄貂鱼的刺刺穿了胸部。宾迪形容她的父亲是“超级英雄”，并表示他的遗产不仅是野生动物保护，更是对地球和彼此的爱。

body.en:
Australian conservationist Bindi Irwin has marked the 20th anniversary of her famous father's death with a touching tribute to the man best known as the "Crocodile Hunter".

Steve Irwin died on 4 September 2006, aged 44, after a stingray fatally pierced his chest while he was underwater filming a documentary at the Great Barrier Reef.

Bindi, who was eight when her father died, called Steve a "superhero" in an online post on Friday, saying she has "watched the world mourn my dad with our family" for the past two decades.

"I always thought that my dad's legacy is wildlife conservation; it turns out, his legacy is love. For our planet and for each other," Bindi, 28, wrote on Instagram.

She described the impact of her father's death on her mother Terri and her younger brother Robert, 22.

"My mum lost the love of her life; my brother and I lost the greatest dad," she wrote. "Grief never truly leaves us; we walk alongside it every day."

Bindi also shared details on how her daughter connects with the grandfather she never got to meet.

"I have a 5-year-old daughter who watches his documentaries every morning. She feels utterly loved by her 'grandpa crocodile' without ever having met him."

Since Steve's death, the Irwins have continued to run Australia Zoo in Queensland.

"My dad left a lasting impact so poignant that it will ripple out for generations to come," Bindi wrote, saying his life and legacy were "worth celebrating".

She thanked Steve for being the family's "guardian angel" and signed off her message saying she loved him "with my whole heart".

Steve's wife Terri also took to social media to mark the day, posting an interview where the khaki-clad wildlife advocate recounted Bindi's birth and its impact on him.

"The most incredible wildlife encounter of my life was the birth of my daughter, Bindi," Steve says in the interview, with his signature enthusiasm.

"I was flabbergasted and it was then that her name evolved. I've gone, 'Bindi!' after my favourite crocodile, Bindi," he said, with a wide grin.

Robert Irwin also posted a tribute to his father, with a photo of Steve holding him when he was a baby, alongside the caption, "Your legacy is forever".

Last November, Robert was crowned the winner of US dance competition Dancing with the Stars, a decade after his sister won the same title.
body.zh: 澳大利亚自然资源保护主义者宾迪·欧文 (Bindi Irwin) 为纪念她著名的父亲去世 20 周年，向这位被誉为“鳄鱼猎人”的人致以感人至深的敬意。 2006 年 9 月 4 日，史蒂夫·欧文 (Steve Irwin) 在大堡礁水下拍摄纪录片时，被黄貂鱼刺穿胸口身亡，享年 44 岁。 宾迪的父亲去世时她才八岁，她在周五的一篇在线帖子中称史蒂夫为“超级英雄”，并表示在过去的二十年里，她“看着世界和我们的家人一起哀悼我的父亲”。 “我一直以为我父亲的遗产是野生动物保护；事实证明，他的遗产是爱。为了我们的星球，为了彼此，”28 岁的宾迪在 Instagram 上写道。 她描述了父亲去世对母亲特丽和 22 岁弟弟罗伯特的影响。 “我的妈妈失去了她一生的挚爱；我和我的兄弟失去了最伟大的父亲，”她写道。 “悲伤从未真正离开我们；我们每天都与它同行。” 宾迪还分享了她的女儿如何与她从未见过的祖父联系的细节。 “我有一个 5 岁的女儿，每天早上都会看他的纪录片。她虽然未曾见过‘鳄鱼爷爷’，但她却感受到了他的深爱。” 史蒂夫去世后，欧文夫妇继续经营昆士兰州的澳大利亚动物园。 宾迪写道：“我的父亲留下了如此深刻的持久影响，它将波及子孙后代。”他说，他的一生和遗产“值得庆祝”。 她感谢史蒂夫成为这个家庭的“守护天使”，并在留言中写道，她“全心全意”地爱他。 史蒂夫的妻子特丽也在社交媒体上发布了一篇采访来纪念这一天，这位身穿卡其布的野生动物倡导者在采访中讲述了宾迪的出生及其对他的影响。 “我一生中最令人难以置信的野生动物遭遇是我女儿宾迪的出生，”史蒂夫在采访中带着他标志性的热情说道。 “我大吃一惊，就在那时，她的名字演变了。我走了，‘宾迪！’以我最喜欢的鳄鱼宾迪命名，”他笑着说道。 罗伯特·欧文还发布了一张史蒂夫小时候抱着他的照片，向他的父亲致敬，并配上标题“你的遗产是永远的”。 去年 11 月，罗伯特在美国舞蹈比赛“与星共舞”中荣获冠军，十年前，他的姐姐赢得了同样的冠军。

reflection.en: Twenty years after Steve Irwin's sudden death, his daughter Bindi reflects on his legacy not just as conservation, but as love. This enduring love, alongside faith and hope, provides comfort and meaning even after profound loss. It reminds us that the deepest legacies are often rooted in the heart, transcending even the most tragic circumstances.
reflection.zh: 在史蒂夫·欧文意外去世20年后，他的女儿宾迪反思他的遗产，认为他留下的不仅是环保事业，更是爱。这种持久的爱，连同信心和盼望，即使在巨大的失落之后也能带来安慰和意义。它提醒我们，最深刻的遗产往往根植于内心，甚至能超越最悲惨的境况。

verse.textEn: And now these three remain: faith, hope and love. But the greatest of these is love.
verse.textZh: 如今常存的有信，有望，有爱这三样，其中最大的是爱。

title.en: 'Beneath their office': Why the US-Canada dispute has turned so nasty
title.zh: “在他们的办公室下面”：美加争端为何如此恶劣

summary.en: A trade dispute between the US and Canada has spiralled into a bitter fight over tariffs, sovereignty and Donald Trump's threats.
summary.zh: 美加之间的贸易争端已演变成一场关于关税、主权和唐纳德·特朗普威胁的激烈斗争。

body.en:
What began as a trade fight between two of the world's most closely connected economies has escalated into a broader confrontation over Canada's sovereignty, culture and military, with United States President Donald Trump and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney now trading increasingly personal attacks.

The latest escalation follows the collapse of trade talks between the two countries on 21 August.

Canada walked away from negotiations after saying the US had made unacceptable last-minute demands, while the US has argued there was a deal on the table that Canada chose not to accept.

The US has since imposed 50 per cent tariffs on billions of dollars of Canadian goods, with Canada preparing retaliatory measures of its own.

Since then, the dispute has spilled well beyond trade . Trump has repeatedly suggested Canada should become the 51st US state, ordered US federal agencies to refer to Lake Ontario as "Lake America" and continued to attack Canadian leaders online.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

US officials have also mocked Canada's military, prompting Carney to accuse Washington of "doing memes", "throwing shade" and "trying to be tough".

But beneath the memes and insults is a serious economic standoff that both sides still say could ultimately be resolved at the negotiating table.

While Trump has imposed 50 per cent tariffs on about US$20 billion ($27 billion) worth of Canadian goods, Canada is preparing retaliatory tariffs of roughly the same value on US products from 8 September.

Carney says the US was seeking terms that would have left major Canadian industries, particularly the highly integrated auto sector, effectively operating as subsidiaries of US companies.

He has also accused the US of seeking changes that would affect Canada's French-language and cultural protections, as well as restrictions on Canada's ability to negotiate future free trade agreements with other countries.

Canada has rejected those demands as a threat to its economic interests and sovereignty.

The Trump administration disputes Canada's account of the negotiations and has argued that a deal was available that Canada chose not to accept.

Trump has repeatedly suggested that Canada should become the 51st US state, a proposal Canada has firmly rejected.

What might once have sounded like political provocation has become a central part of the dispute, with Carney increasingly framing the confrontation as a defence of Canadian sovereignty.

That rhetoric carries particular weight in Quebec, where there are concerns about what US absorption of Canada could mean for the province's French language and culture.

Carney has also pushed back against any suggestion...
body.zh: 世界上联系最紧密的两个经济体之间的贸易战一开始就升级为围绕加拿大主权、文化和军事的更广泛对抗，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和加拿大总理马克·卡尼现在越来越多地进行人身攻击。 最近的升级是在两国贸易谈判于 8 月 21 日破裂之后发生的。 加拿大在表示美国在最后一刻提出了不可接受的要求后退出了谈判，而美国则辩称有一项协议摆在桌面上，但加拿大选择不接受。 此后，美国对价值数十亿美元的加拿大商品征收50%的关税，加拿大也准备采取报复措施。 从那时起，争端已经远远超出了贸易范围。特朗普多次建议加拿大成为美国第51个州，命令美国联邦机构将安大略湖称为“美国湖”，并不断在网上攻击加拿大领导人。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 美国官员还嘲笑加拿大军队，促使卡尼指责华盛顿“搞迷因”、“投下阴影”和“试图强硬”。 但在这些表情包和侮辱背后是严重的经济僵局，双方仍然表示最终可以在谈判桌上解决。 尽管特朗普已对价值约200亿美元（约合270亿美元）的加拿大商品征收50%的关税，但加拿大正准备从9月8日起对美国产品征收大致相同价值的报复性关税。 卡尼表示，美国正在寻求一些条款，使加拿大主要工业，特别是高度一体化的汽车行业，能够作为美国公司的子公司有效运营。 他还指责美国寻求的改变会影响加拿大的法语和文化保护，并限制加拿大与其他国家谈判未来自由贸易协定的能力。 加拿大拒绝了这些要求，认为这是对其经济利益和主权的威胁。 特朗普政府对加拿大对谈判的描述提出质疑，并辩称加拿大选择不接受一项协议。 特朗普多次建议加拿大成为美国第51个州，但加拿大坚决拒绝了这一提议。 曾经听起来像是政治挑衅的事情已经成为争端的核心部分，卡尼越来越多地将这场对抗视为对加拿大主权的捍卫。 这种言论在魁北克尤其重要，人们担心美国吞并加拿大可能对该省的法语和文化意味着什么。 卡尼也反对任何建议……

reflection.en: When trade talks collapse and personal attacks replace reasoned debate, the path to peace becomes obscured. The principle of pursuing peace, even when difficult, calls for seeking common ground and de-escalating conflict, rather than allowing disputes to fester and grow.
reflection.zh: 当贸易谈判破裂，人身攻击取代了理性辩论时，和平之路变得模糊不清。追求和平的原则，即使在困难时，也呼吁寻求共同点并缓和冲突，而不是让争端恶化和蔓延。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Argentine president reignites Falklands dispute after Trump questions UK sovereignty
title.zh: 阿根廷总统在特朗普质疑英国主权后重燃福克兰斯争端

summary.en: Javier Milei praised Donald Trump after he said he was reviewing the US' stance on the long-running dispute.
summary.zh: 哈维尔·米莱在特朗普表示他正在审查美国对这一长期争端的立场后，对此表示赞赏。

body.en:
Argentine President Javier Milei escalated his country's long-running dispute with the United Kingdom over the Falkland Islands, praising US President Donald Trump for saying the US could reconsider its historically neutral stance on the islands' sovereignty.

In a nationally televised address on Thursday night local time, Milei seized on Trump's comments this week that the US could review its position on the islands, casting the potential shift as proof that his close relationship with the US president — often criticised by political opponents — was paying dividends.

"The United States is considering this change in position because it knows that Argentina has a reliable partner, aligned with Western values, in a strategically important position that can be a valuable ally in the decades to come," Milei said.

The libertarian Argentine leader then announced a series of actions aimed at stopping the development of the Sea Lion oil project, about 220km north of the islands, where UK company Rockhopper Exploration and Israel's Navitas Petroleum plan to begin drilling in the coming months and start producing oil in 2028.

Argentina considers the project an illegal exploitation of resources in waters it claims as its own.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

He threatened tougher sanctions against companies involved in offshore drilling and announced new funding for a naval base in Argentina's southernmost province, Tierra del Fuego, to bolster the country's military presence near the islands, known in Argentina as the Malvinas.

"Argentina will not stand idly by," Milei said. "Any further advance on the Malvinas Islands will be considered a violation of our national security."

Milei's effort to refocus national attention on the Falklands marks a striking turn for a leader who has faced criticism at home for warming ties with the UK and professing admiration for Margaret Thatcher, the UK prime minister who led the country to retake the remote archipelago during the 1982 Falklands War after Argentina had invaded it.

The two-month conflict killed 649 Argentine troops, 255 British service members and three islanders.

The sovereignty claim remains one of the few causes that cuts across Argentina's stark political divides, giving Milei a welcome political opening as his approval ratings slip and the economy sputters.

"We can argue about my style. We can disagree over fiscal or exchange-rate policy," Milei said.

"But this issue demands that we lay down our arms and show a united front to the world as a nation and as a society. There are causes that rise above any political difference. The Malvinas is one of them."

Argentina maintains that...
body.zh: 阿根廷总统哈维尔·米莱升级了该国与英国在福克兰群岛问题上的长期争端，并赞扬美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示美国可以重新考虑其在群岛主权问题上的历史中立立场。 在当地时间周四晚上的全国电视讲话中，米莱抓住了特朗普本周关于美国可以重新审视其在这些岛屿上的立场的言论，将这一潜在转变视为他与美国总统的密切关系（经常受到政治对手批评）正在带来红利的证据。 米莱说：“美国正在考虑改变立场，因为它知道阿根廷有一个可靠的伙伴，与西方价值观一致，具有重要的战略地位，可以成为未来几十年的宝贵盟友。” 这位自由主义的阿根廷领导人随后宣布了一系列行动，旨在阻止海狮石油项目的开发，该项目位于群岛以北约 220 公里处，英国公司 Rockhopper Exploration 和以色列纳维塔斯石油公司计划在未来几个月内开始钻探，并于 2028 年开始生产石油。 阿根廷认为该项目非法开采其声称拥有主权的水域的资源。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他威胁要对参与海上钻探的公司实施更严厉的制裁，并宣布为阿根廷最南端火地岛省的海军基地提供新资金，以加强该国在群岛（阿根廷称为马尔维纳斯群岛）附近的军事存在。 “阿根廷不会袖手旁观，”米莱说。 “在马尔维纳斯群岛上的任何进一步进展都将被视为侵犯我们的国家安全。” 米莱重新将全国注意力集中在福克兰群岛上的努力，标志着这位领导人的一个惊人转变。这位领导人因与英国关系升温而在国内面临批评，并公开表示钦佩英国首相玛格丽特·撒切尔(Margaret Thatcher)，她在1982年阿根廷入侵马岛战争期间领导英国重新夺回了这个偏远的群岛。 为期两个月的冲突造成 649 名阿根廷军人、255 名英国军人和 3 名岛民死亡。 主权主张仍然是弥合阿根廷严重政治分歧的少数原因之一，在他的支持率下滑和经济萎靡之际，为米莱提供了一个受欢迎的政治机会。 “我们可以争论我的风格。我们可以在财政或汇率政策上存在分歧，”米雷说。 “但这个问题要求我们放下武器，作为一个国家和一个社会向世界展示统一战线。有些原因超越任何政治分歧。马尔维纳斯群岛就是其中之一。” 阿根廷坚称...

reflection.en: The sovereignty of the Falkland Islands has been a point of contention for decades. President Milei's comments, seizing on a potential shift in US policy, risk escalating this long-standing dispute. In moments of heightened tension, the call to live peaceably with all people, as far as it depends on us, remains a vital principle.
reflection.zh: 福克兰斯群岛的主权问题几十年来一直是争论的焦点。米莱总统抓住美国政策可能转变的机会发表评论，有加剧这一长期争端的风险。在紧张局势加剧的时刻，尽我们所能与众人和睦相处的呼吁，仍然是一项重要的原则。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Nepal says it will need billions in funding to rebuild after flash floods
title.zh: 尼泊尔称在发生洪水后需要数十亿美元用于重建

summary.en: Nepal is one of the most vulnerable countries to the climate crisis, even though it is one of the lowest emitters of global greenhouse emissions. In the deadly flash floods on the Nepal-Tibet border, at least 1,200 people have died and thousands more are missing. BBC South Asia correspondent Azadeh Moshiri is in Nepal...
summary.zh: 尼泊尔是受气候危机影响最严重的国家之一，尽管其全球温室气体排放量很低。在尼泊尔-西藏边境发生的致命山洪中，至少有1200人死亡，数千人失踪。英国广播公司南亚记者阿扎德·莫希里正在尼泊尔，当局正试图在覆盖村庄和道路的瓦砾和碎石中开始重建工作。

body.en:
Nepal is one of the most vulnerable countries to the climate crisis, even though it is one of the lowest emitters of global greenhouse emissions.

In the deadly flash floods on the Nepal-Tibet border – which scientists are still studying the exact cause of – at least 1,200 people have died and thousands more are missing.

BBC South Asia correspondent Azadeh Moshiri is in Nepal where authorities are trying to begin rebuilding amid the debris and rubble covering villages and roads.
body.zh: 尼泊尔是全球温室气体排放量最低的国家之一，但它是最容易受到气候危机影响的国家之一。 尼泊尔和西藏边境致命的山洪爆发——科学家仍在研究其确切原因——至少有 1,200 人死亡，数千人失踪。 BBC 南亚记者阿扎德·莫希里 (Azadeh Moshiri) 在尼泊尔，当局正试图在村庄和道路上的废墟和瓦砾中开始重建工作。

reflection.en: The earth itself groans, bearing the weight of human impact and natural disasters. In Nepal, flash floods have devastated communities, leaving a trail of loss and destruction. As rebuilding efforts begin, we are reminded of our interconnectedness with creation and the urgent need for care and stewardship.
reflection.zh: 大地本身也在呻吟，承受着人类活动和自然灾害的重负。在尼泊尔，山洪爆发摧毁了社区，留下了损失和破坏的痕迹。随着重建工作的开始，我们被提醒与受造界的相互联系，以及对关怀和管理的迫切需要。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Trump's Iran strategy: Could this become a forever war?
title.zh: 特朗普的伊朗战略：这会变成一场永恒的战争吗？

summary.en: The US has launched fresh attacks on military targets in Iran, aiming to prevent Tehran from rebuilding its destroyed capabilities. However, this risks triggering a sustained downward spiral of reconstruction followed by new attacks.
summary.zh: 美国对伊朗的军事目标发动了新的袭击，旨在阻止德黑兰重建其被摧毁的能力。然而，这可能会引发一个持续的恶性循环：重建、然后是新的袭击。

body.en:
The US has launched fresh attacks on military targets in Iran. It wants to prevent Tehran rebuilding its destroyed capabilities, but risks triggering a sustained downward spiral of reconstruction followed by new attacks.

US President Donald Trump has given a fairly clear description of what the next phase of the Iran war could look like. The Iranians had tried to rebuild their radar equipment, Trump stated after the most recent wave of US strikes . "We waited until it was almost built, and then we hit it," he said.

On Tuesday, American forces once again attacked several targets in Iran . According to US Central Command (CENTCOM), the targets destroyed included "air defense sites, radar systems, maritime assets and facilities, mine laying capabilities, and communications sites."

Iran responded by firing rockets and drones at US facilities in the region. With this, the war moved on to what CENTCOM had indicated just a few days earlier could be the strategy for the next phase.

According to the news portal Axios, it was considering limited strikes, at regular intervals if necessary, to prevent Iran from reconstituting its military capabilities in the Strait of Hormuz . An American government representative used a concept from Israeli security policy to describe this idea: He called it "mowing the grass."

The metaphor refers to a strategy that doesn't even attempt to promise that an opponent will be defeated once and for all. It is enough to regularly reduce the enemy's military capabilities to the point where the threat remains manageable. When the grass grows back, you "mow" it again.

Applied to the situation in Iran, this would mean the US keeping an eye on which military capabilities the enemy is reconstituting, and attacking once it crosses a certain threshold.

In the past few months, the US has scored some military successes. US forces have significantly reduced Iran's military capabilities in the Strait of Hormuz, and have begun clearing Iranian sea mines.

However, these successes will not last. Tehran is repairing or procuring new radar installations, anti-aircraft positions and anti-ship missiles. US bombs could certainly destroy important Iranian positions with targeted strikes. But the knowledge and the industrial basis of Iranian military technology would remain.

Reconstruction can therefore be delayed, but not prevented. The US will repeatedly be confronted with the same choice: whether to accept that Tehran is regaining its capabilities, or to attack again and destroy them.

Mona Yacoubian, director of the Middle East program at the Center for Strategic and International Studies in Washington, warned as early as April that this development could lead to an "enduring low-intensity conflict punctuated by more intensive...
body.zh: 美国对伊朗的军事目标发动了新的袭击。它希望阻止德黑兰重建其被摧毁的能力，但有可能引发重建工作持续螺旋式下降，进而引发新的袭击。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对伊朗战争的下一阶段可能会是什么样子给出了相当明确的描述。特朗普在美国最近一波袭击后表示，伊朗人曾试图重建他们的雷达设备。 “我们一直等到它快建成了，然后我们就开始了，”他说。 周二，美军再次袭击了伊朗的多个目标。据美国中央司令部（CENTCOM）称，被摧毁的目标包括“防空站点、雷达系统、海上资产和设施、布雷能力和通信站点”。 伊朗向美国在该地区的设施发射火箭和无人机作为回应。至此，战争转向了中央司令部几天前表示的下一阶段的战略。 据新闻门户网站 Axios 报道，伊朗正在考虑进行有限的打击，并在必要时定期进行打击，以阻止伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡重建其军事能力。一位美国政府代表用以色列安全政策中的一个概念来描述这个想法：他称之为“割草”。 这个比喻指的是一种甚至不试图承诺彻底击败对手的策略。定期将敌人的军事能力降低到威胁可控的程度就足够了。当草重新长出来时，你再次“修剪”它。 应用于伊朗局势，这意味着美国密切关注敌人正在重组哪些军事能力，一旦超过一定阈值就发动攻击。 过去几个月，美国取得了一些军事胜利。美军大幅削弱了伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡的军事能力，并开始清除伊朗的海雷。 然而，这些成功不会持续下去。德黑兰正在修复或采购新的雷达装置、防空阵地和反舰导弹。美国的炸弹肯定可以通过有针对性的打击摧毁伊朗的重要阵地。但伊朗军事技术的知识和工业基础将保留。 因此，重建可以被推迟，但不能被阻止。美国将反复面临同样的选择：是接受德黑兰正在恢复其能力，还是再次攻击并摧毁它们。 华盛顿战略与国际研究中心 (CSIS) 中东项目主任莫娜·雅库比安 (Mona Yacoubian) 早在 4 月份就警告称，这一事态发展可能会导致“持久的低强度冲突，其间夹杂着更激烈的……

reflection.en: The news describes a cycle of destruction and rebuilding, where each strike is met with efforts to restore capabilities, only to be targeted again. This pattern of action and reaction risks a perpetual conflict. The ancient wisdom calls us to break this cycle, not by mirroring the aggression, but by choosing a different path, seeking to overcome destructive...
reflection.zh: 新闻描述了一个破坏与重建的循环，每一次打击都伴随着恢复能力的努力，却又招致新的打击。这种反复的行动和反应模式，有陷入永久冲突的风险。古老的智慧呼唤我们打破这个循环，不是通过模仿侵略，而是选择一条不同的道路，努力用建设性的、生命肯定的行动来克服破坏性的模式。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Norway seizes Russian ship in Svalbard to compensate Ukraine
title.zh: 挪威扣押俄罗斯船只以赔偿乌克兰

summary.en: Norway has seized a Russian ship, the Professor Molchanov, under a court order obtained by Ukraine's Naftogaz. This action is a consequence of Russia's refusal to pay damages awarded to Naftogaz following Moscow's seizure of assets in Crimea in 2014. Russia has protested the seizure.
summary.zh: 挪威根据乌克兰Naftogaz公司获得的法院命令，扣押了一艘俄罗斯船只“莫尔恰诺夫教授”号。此举源于俄罗斯拒绝支付在2014年莫斯科吞并克里米亚后，被判给Naftogaz的赔偿金。俄罗斯已对此扣押提出抗议。

body.zh: 挪威当局根据 Naftogaz 在乌克兰寻求并获得的法院命令扣押了一艘俄罗斯船只“Professor Molchanov”。俄罗斯对此举表示抗议，因为俄罗斯拒绝支付 Naftogaz 的损失。 挪威法院下令在北极扣押一艘俄罗斯船只，以执行乌克兰国家能源公司 Naftogaz 在莫斯科扣押其在克里米亚（俄罗斯于 2014 年非法吞并克里米亚）的资产后赢得的 42.2 亿美元（约合 36 亿欧元）赔偿索赔的一部分。 官员们宣布，周三晚间，该船已被阻止离开位于斯瓦尔巴群岛巴伦支堡的俄罗斯煤矿定居点的港口。 斯瓦尔巴群岛自 1925 年以来一直是挪威领土，但它是一个非军事区，来自包括俄罗斯在内的数十个国家的人们可以在某些条件下免签证定居。 俄罗斯驻挪威大使表示，莫斯科将通过法律途径寻求释放该船。 第一个宣布该船被扣押的团体是代表 Naftogaz 的美国律师事务所卡温顿 (Covington)，该律师事务所试图确保海牙常设仲裁法院于 2023 年给予其赔偿。 在与乌克兰持续的战争中，俄罗斯拒绝支付罚款、法律费用和利息，Naftogaz 此后开始尝试通过当地法院扣押并强制出售俄罗斯商业资产。 Naftogaz 代理首席执行官 Sergii Fedorenko 表示：“俄罗斯不能仅仅通过拒绝遵守国际仲裁裁决来逃避责任。” 卡温顿表示，几个月来，它一直在追踪这艘名为“莫尔查诺夫教授”号的船。该公司表示，其申请周一获得了北特罗姆斯和塞尼亚地区法院的批准，该法院命令斯瓦尔巴群岛州长确保该船抵达后留在码头。 斯瓦尔巴群岛总督办公室随后发表声明，确认该船已被扣押，并将被扣押在斯瓦尔巴群岛。 声明称：“州长将与 Trust Arktikugol 合作，照顾船上的船员和乘客。”Trust Arktikugol 指的是管理巴伦支堡采矿定居点的俄罗斯企业（意为“北极煤炭”）。 与此同时，挪威司法部表示，该问题与奥斯陆政府没有直接关系。 司法部表示：“俄罗斯可以要求地区法院重新评估此案。” 俄罗斯驻挪威大使尼古拉·科尔丘诺夫周四在一份声明中表示，莫斯科将通过法律渠道寻求释放该船。 他说：“我们坚持要求立即释放该船，并确保乘客和船员的安全。” 克里姆林宫还召见挪威驻莫斯科大使，提出正式...

reflection.en: The seizure of the Professor Molchanov ship illustrates a complex legal and financial dispute stemming from geopolitical conflict. It brings to the fore the struggle for justice and compensation when international relations are strained, highlighting how past actions, like the annexation of Crimea, continue to have repercussions years later.
reflection.zh: “莫尔恰诺夫教授”号船只被扣押的事件，凸显了地缘政治冲突引发的复杂法律和金融纠纷。它将人们的注意力引向了在国际关系紧张时，为寻求正义和赔偿所做的斗争，并表明了像2014年吞并克里米亚这样的过往行为，多年后仍会产生持续的影响。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: US sanctions halt TOEFL and GRE tests in Iran, disrupting study plans
title.zh: 美国制裁叫停伊朗托福和GRE考试，打乱留学计划

summary.en: Students in Iran are unable to take TOEFL and GRE exams due to the suspension of a US sanctions exemption. Applicants report that this decision jeopardizes their university application deadlines and imposes costly travel requirements.
summary.zh: 由于美国制裁豁免被暂停，伊朗学生无法参加托福和GRE考试。申请者表示，此举威胁到他们的大学申请截止日期，并增加了昂贵的旅行负担。

body.en:
Students in Iran can no longer take English-language proficiency exams after the suspension of a US sanctions exemption. Applicants say the move threatens university deadlines and adds costly travel obligations.

Iranian students hoping to study abroad are facing a new obstacle after TOEFL and GRE testing was suspended inside the country following changes to US sanctions regulations .

"My entire plan was built around taking this exam," a TOEFL candidate in Tehran told DW.

She said she had spent months preparing applications for a Ph.D. program, contacting professors and gathering documents despite internet disruptions and other challenges.

ETS, the US-based organization that administers both English-language proficiency exams, announced it suspended testing in Iran after the US Treasury Department's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) froze General License G, which had allowed certain educational services to continue in Iran .

"Following OFAC's suspension of General License G, ETS has paused administration of the TOEFL and GRE tests in Iran effective immediately," the organization said in an official notice.

ETS added that Iranian nationals can still take the exams outside Iran and that it is exploring options to restore testing.

TOEFL is a US-based English-language proficiency test accepted by universities worldwide. The GRE is a standardized test required by some graduate programs, particularly in the United States and Canada.

Since the  Iran war  began in late February, the US has increasingly expanded sanctions targeting Iranian trade and exports, contributing to broader disruptions throughout the Iranian economy .

An Iranian institution that administered TOEFL exams told DW that new registrations had stopped following the latest sanctions changes .

The institution added that the suspension could be temporary, but no date had been given for exams to resume.

That uncertainty is particularly serious for students approaching university and scholarship deadlines who have spent months preparing and paying application-related costs.

The suspension follows earlier problems with IELTS (British equivalent of TOEFL) testing in Iran. An IELTS center in Tehran  told DW that sanctions-related difficulties transferring money had become one of the main obstacles to continuing exams.

Some Iranian applicants had already been traveling to countries such as Turkey and Armenia to take IELTS. TOEFL and GRE candidates may now have to do the same.

Alireza, who is preparing to apply to a university in Italy, said the suspension of TOEFL had disrupted a backup plan he had arranged after IELTS testing became unavailable.

"European universities usually accept IELTS. But because IELTS has been suspended in Iran, after...
body.zh: 在美国制裁豁免暂停后，伊朗的学生不能再参加托福和GRE考试。申请人表示，此举威胁到大学的最后期限，并增加了昂贵的旅行义务。希望出国留学的伊朗学生在美国制裁法规变更后，托福和GRE考试在国内暂停后面临新的障碍。“我的整个计划都是围绕着参加这次考试制定的，”德黑兰的一名托福考生告诉DW。她说，尽管互联网中断和其他挑战，她还是花了几个月的时间准备博士学位课程的申请，联系教授并收集文件。管理这两项考试的美国组织ETS宣布，在美国财政部外国资产控制办公室（ OFAC ）冻结通用许可证G后，它暂停了在伊朗的考试，该许可证允许某些教育服务继续在伊朗进行。“在OFAC暂停通用许可证G之后， ETS已暂停在伊朗进行托福和GRE考试，立即生效，”该组织在一份官方通知中表示。ETS补充说，伊朗国民仍然可以在伊朗境外参加考试，并且正在探索恢复测试的选项。托福是全球各大学接受的美国英语水平考试。GRE也由同一个美国组织管理，是一些研究生课程要求的标准化考试，特别是在美国和加拿大。自2月下旬伊朗战争开始以来，美国越来越多地扩大针对伊朗贸易和出口的制裁，导致整个伊朗经济出现更广泛的混乱。一家管理托福考试的伊朗机构告诉德国之声，在最近的制裁变更后，新的注册已经停止。该机构补充说，暂停考试可能是暂时的，但没有给出恢复考试的日期。对于接近大学和奖学金截止日期的学生来说，这种不确定性尤其严重，他们花了数月时间准备文件，联系教授并支付与申请相关的费用。此前，伊朗雅思（英国相当于托福）考试出现了问题。德黑兰雅思考试中心告诉德国之声，与制裁有关的转账困难已成为继续考试的主要障碍之一。一些伊朗申请人已经前往土耳其和亚美尼亚等国家参加雅思考试。托福和GRE考生现在可能必须做同样的事情。准备申请意大利一所大学的Alireza表示，暂停托福考试打乱了他在雅思考试不可用后安排的备考计划。“欧洲大学通常接受雅思考试。但由于雅思考试已被暂停...

reflection.en: The suspension of TOEFL and GRE tests in Iran, a consequence of US sanctions, leaves many students in a difficult position, threatening their academic timelines and forcing them to incur additional expenses. These students, who have worked diligently to prepare their applications, find their voices unheard and their futures uncertain due to decisions made...
reflection.zh: 美国制裁暂停了伊朗的托福和GRE考试，这使得许多学生陷入困境，威胁到他们的学业时间表，并迫使他们承担额外费用。这些学生辛勤准备申请材料，却发现自己的声音被忽视，未来变得不确定，这一切都源于远方的决定。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们“为不能说话的开口，为所有孤苦者辨明是非”。这段经文提醒我们要为那些机会受到不公正限制的人们发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Can Hichilema heal Zambia's political divide?
title.zh: 希奇莱马能否弥合赞比亚的政治分歧？

summary.en: Zambian President Hakainde Hichilema begins his second term following a disputed election that exposed significant political divisions. His administration faces the dual challenge of unifying the nation while also addressing concerns regarding political freedoms.
summary.zh: 赞比亚总统哈凯恩德·希奇莱马在一次有争议的选举暴露了深刻的政治分歧后，开始了第二个任期。他的政府面临着团结国家并解决对政治自由担忧的双重挑战。

body.en:
The Zambian president starts a second term after a contested election exposed deep political divisions. His challenge now is to unite the country while addressing concerns over political freedoms.

Zambian President Hakainde Hichilema was sworn in for a second five-year term on Tuesday.

For decades, Zambia has worn its peaceful transfers of power almost like a badge of honor in a region where elections have too often ended in disputed results, violence or leaders refusing to leave. Hichilema's own victory in 2021 appeared to strengthen that reputation.

Hichilema begins his second term after a disputed election , with his main challenger facing treason charges , opposition supporters questioning the credibility of the vote and controversy surrounding the closure of courts during the crucial window for election petitions.

Hichilema has promised reconciliation. But for a president who once sat on the other side of power as an opposition leader and treason suspect himself, the test now is whether those words will be matched by the political space he gives his opponents.

Ngobola Cengelo Muyembe, a political, business and social analyst, told DW that reconciliation must begin by recognizing that a significant part of the electorate backed someone else.

"You have to remember that in every 10 people that voted, four people voted for the other side," Muyembe said, noting that during the president's inaugural address, he spoke about reconciliation and uniting people. "But that message can only resonate if what is on the ground reflects what is being spoken about."

Raymond, a self-employed Zambian who asked that his full name not be used, told DW that Hichilema should look beyond who supported him at the ballot box and govern across Zambia's political and ethnic divisions.

"The president, congratulations! Don't think about people who voted for you, didn't vote for you. One Zambia, one nation, one city," Raymond said. "Real change in mines and agriculture. The mines want us Zambians to be benefiting. Even your Tonga, your Bemba, you are all Zambians."

Artist Mazuba Nzabuka told DW he also wants Hichilema to govern those who supported him and those who did not, while giving young people a greater voice.

"Going forward, he is going to do the promises left behind. He is a president for all people," said Nzabuka. "Those who did not vote for him, those who voted for him. We are the same people. The five years going forward, our voices can be heard. Look after the youths."

But reconciliation will have to contend with the political fallout from the election.

Zambia returned to multiparty democracy in 1991 and has since witnessed several changes of governing parties through elections. Hichilema himself benefited from that tradition when he defeated incumbent...
body.zh: 赞比亚总统在一场有争议的选举暴露出深刻的政治分歧后开始了第二个任期。他现在的挑战是团结国家，同时解决对政治自由的担忧。 赞比亚总统哈坎德·希奇莱马周二宣誓就职，开始第二个五年任期。 几十年来，赞比亚的和平权力移交几乎就像是一个荣誉徽章，该地区的选举经常以有争议的结果、暴力或领导人拒绝离开而告终。希奇莱马自己在 2021 年的胜利似乎强化了这一声誉。 希奇莱马在一场有争议的选举后开始了他的第二个任期，他的主要挑战者面临叛国罪指控，反对派支持者质疑投票的可信度，以及围绕选举请愿的关键窗口期间关闭法院的争议。 希奇莱马承诺和解。但对于一位曾经作为反对派领袖站​​在权力另一边并怀疑自己叛国的总统来说，现在的考验是这些话是否会与他给予对手的政治空间相匹配。 政治、商业和社会分析师恩戈博拉·森杰洛·穆延贝 (Ngobola Cengelo Muyembe) 告诉德国之声，和解必须首先认识到很大一部分选民支持其他人。 穆延贝说：“你必须记住，每 10 个人投票，就有 4 个人投票给对方。”他指出，在总统的就职演说中，他谈到了和解和团结人民。 “但只有当实际情况反映了所谈论的内容时，这一信息才能产生共鸣。” 赞比亚个体经营者雷蒙德要求不透露自己的全名，他告诉德国之声，希奇莱马应该超越投票箱中支持他的人，并跨越赞比亚的政治和种族分歧进行治理。 “总统，恭喜你！不要去想那些投票给你的人，那些没有投票给你的人。一个赞比亚，一个国家，一座城市，”雷蒙德说。 “矿山和农业发生了真正的变化。矿山希望我们赞比亚人受益。甚至你们的汤加、你们的本巴，你们都是赞比亚人。” 艺术家马祖巴·恩扎布卡 (Mazuba Nzabuka) 告诉德国之声，他还希望希奇莱马能够统治那些支持他和不支持他的人，同时让年轻人有更大的发言权。 恩扎布卡说：“展望未来，他将履行留下的承诺。他是所有人的总统。” “那些没有投票给他的人，那些投票给他的人。我们是同一个人。未来五年，我们的声音可以被听到。照顾年轻人。” 但和解必须应对选举带来的政治影响。 赞比亚于1991年恢复多党民主，此后通过选举多次更换执政党。当希奇莱马击败现任总统时，他本人也从这一传统中受益。

reflection.en: In Zambia, President Hichilema faces the daunting task of bridging deep political divides after a contentious election. The pursuit of unity and the safeguarding of political freedoms are critical for his second term, echoing the ancient wisdom that righteous rulers bring stability and hope, while the absence of justice leads to ruin.
reflection.zh: 在赞比亚，希奇莱马总统面临着在一次有争议的选举后弥合深刻政治分歧的艰巨任务。追求团结和保障政治自由对他第二个任期至关重要，这呼应了古老的智慧：公义的统治者带来稳定和希望，而缺乏公义则导致毁灭。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: China Desk
title.zh: 中国观察

strap.en: Policy signals, social change, and national developments inside China.
strap.zh: 聚焦中国内部政策走向、社会变化与国家动态。

title.en: Watch: Moment workers are rescued from Nepal tunnel
title.zh: 视频：尼泊尔隧道工人获救瞬间

summary.en: Rescuers pull two people from a hydropower tunnel more than a week after a massive flash flood devastated the Nepal-China border.
summary.zh: 在导致尼泊尔-中国边境地区遭受毁灭性洪灾一周多后，救援人员从一座水电站隧道中救出了两人。

reflection.en: In the aftermath of disaster, the focus often shifts to the immense scale of destruction. Yet, amidst the rubble and the waiting, the rescue of two individuals from the Nepal tunnel shines a light on the preciousness of each human life. Jesus taught that whatever we do for the least of these, we do for Him.
reflection.zh: 在灾难的余波中，人们的注意力常常转向巨大的破坏规模。然而，在瓦砾和等待之中，从尼泊尔隧道中救出两名个人的事件，彰显了每个人的生命都何等宝贵。耶稣教导说，凡你们为我这些最小的弟兄做的，就是为我做的。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: ‘Everyone seems to have forgotten’: In Tibet, flood-hit families search for the missing and grapple with China’s silence
title.zh: 在西藏，“每个人似乎都已忘记”：洪水肆虐家庭寻找失踪者，并与中国的沉默作斗争

summary.en: Relatives are trying to gather information online and from Nepal, while Tibet advocacy groups report that information is being suppressed in China. Fan Hong last heard from her husband, Lin Bo, who was working on a Chinese highway project in Nepal, on the morning of the disaster. Over a week later, she is desperately...
summary.zh: 亲属们正试图从网上和尼泊尔收集信息，而西藏倡导团体则报告信息在中国受到压制。范红在尼泊尔-西藏灾难发生当晚听到了她丈夫林波的消息，林波当时正在尼泊尔的一个中国公路项目上工作。一周多过去了，她仍在绝望地寻找他，难以从当局那里获得信息，并转向了社交媒体。

body.en: Relatives try to piece together information found online and from Nepal as Tibet advocates groups say information is suppressed in China Fan Hong last heard from her husband on the morning of the Nepal-Tibet disaster. More than a week later, the 31-year-old is desperately searching for information about Lin Bo, who was working on a Chinese highway project in Nepal. Struggling to get information from authorities, Fan turned to social media for help. “My husband works on a project in Nepal, about 5 kilometres from the Gyirong border crossing. I want to know what the situation is, but I haven’t been able to reach him,” the 31-year-old from China’s Sichuan province wrote on Rednote. Continue reading...
body.zh: 亲戚们试图将网上和来自尼泊尔的信息拼凑起来，因为西藏倡导团体称信息在中国受到压制。 范红最后一次听到她丈夫的消息是在尼泊尔-西藏灾难发生的早上。一个多星期后，这位31岁的男子正在拼命寻找有关林波的信息，林波正在尼泊尔的一个中国高速公路项目上工作。由于难以从当局获取信息，范向社交媒体寻求帮助。 “我丈夫在尼泊尔的一个项目工作，距离吉隆口岸约 5 公里。我想知道情况如何，但一直联系不上他，”这位来自中国四川省的 31 岁男子在 Rednote 上写道。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the aftermath of the Nepal-Tibet disaster, families like Fan Hong's are left in agonizing uncertainty, struggling to find information about their missing loved ones. The silence from authorities and the difficulty in accessing news echo the plight of those who are often voiceless. This situation calls us to remember and advocate for those whose suffering...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔-西藏灾难发生后，像范红这样的家庭陷入了痛苦的不确定之中，努力寻找失踪亲人的信息。当局的沉默和获取新闻的困难，呼应了那些常常无声者的困境。这种情况提醒我们要铭记并为那些可能被遗忘的受苦者发声，这体现了圣经中为不能为自己发声者说话的呼召。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Pacific leaders voice concern over Chinese missile test but stop short of condemnation
title.zh: 太平洋领导人对中国导弹试验表示担忧，但未予谴责

summary.en: The Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) concluded with most member nations agreeing to "register concern" over China's recent intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) test, which overflew several members without adequate notice. Leaders urged transparency and advance notification for such tests, with Nauru being the sole...
summary.zh: 太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）闭幕，多数成员国同意就中国近期洲际弹道导弹（ICBM）试验“表示关切”，该试验在未获充分通知的情况下飞越了部分成员国领土。领导人敦促所有进行ICBM试验的国家确保透明度和保障，包括按照国际惯例至少提前24小时发出通知。18个成员国中，瑙鲁是唯一一个对此条款持异议的国家。

body.en:
The Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) has wrapped up with most nations agreeing to "register concern" on China's recent intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) test, "which overflew a number of members without adequate notice".

"Leaders call on all states undertaking ICBM testing to ensure transparency and reassurance, including through the provision of advance notification of a test at least 24 hours in accordance with international practice," the communique says, as read out by Palau's President and PIF chair Surangel Whipps Junior, after the closing ceremony.

In a rare move for the usually consensus-based forum, Nauru was the only one of 18 PIF members to dissent from the clause.

Kiribati and Nauru were the only two Pacific nations that had previously blocked a draft PIF statement in the immediate aftermath of Beijing's test, a move that Prime Minister Anthony Albanese had been advocating for.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

However the statement went further than analysts and government sources had expected; the PIF foreign ministers' meeting statement in August was broader, discussing ballistic missile testing in the region, but had stopped short of singling out a particular ICBM or referencing a notice period for nations to undergo any testing.

Whipps also hit back against China's comments that Palau sensationalised its ballistic missile test, saying: "There's no sensationalism, it's just stating the facts."

"The Pacific Islands weren't informed [of the test]. The ones that were informed were informed late, and so I think the message from the forum is clear: that transparency needs to happen."

Intelligence shows the nuclear-capable intercontinental ballistic missile test in July flew over the Philippines, Palau and Micronesia's airspace before landing in the Pacific Ocean.

The response has become something of a litmus test for PIF and its members for their strategic positioning.

The communique's relevant clause includes a reference to the Fiji-led Ocean of Peace declaration made last year, which states the region should be free from coercion and militarisation.

However, it doesn't name China, nor does it use heftier diplomatic language than "concern".

While Australian officials were happy with the agreed statement, it fell short of some pre-retreat expectations, including those of the host, Palau.

"They sent a missile next to French Polynesia, another one next to Tuvalu, crossing over our airspace. They never bothered to tell us that's what's happening," he said.

"I said 'there's a lot of space between Japan and Guam, why don't you send it there? Why does it have to come to the middle of the Pacific when last year we just signed a...
body.zh: 太平洋岛屿论坛（PIF）结束时，大多数国家同意对中国最近的洲际弹道导弹（ICBM）试验“表达关切”，“该试验在没有充分通知的情况下飞越了一些成员国”。 帕劳总统兼太平洋岛国论坛主席苏兰吉尔·惠普斯·儒尼奥尔在闭幕式后宣读的公报称，“领导人呼吁所有进行洲际弹道导弹测试的国家确保透明度和保证，包括根据国际惯例至少提前 24 小时提前通知测试情况”。 对于这个通常以共识为基础的论坛来说，这是一个罕见的举动，瑙鲁是 18 个 PIF 成员中唯一不同意该条款的国家。 基里巴斯和瑙鲁是此前在北京试验后立即阻止PIF声明草案的仅有的两个太平洋国家，此举是总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯一直倡导的。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 然而，该声明超出了分析师和政府消息人士的预期；太平洋岛国论坛外交部长八月份的会议声明范围更广，讨论了该地区的弹道导弹试验，但没有单独指出特定的洲际弹道导弹或提及各国进行任何试验的通知期。 惠普斯还反驳了中国关于帕劳炒作其弹道导弹试验的言论，他说：“没有煽情，只是陈述事实。” “太平洋岛屿没有被告知（这次测试）。那些被告知的人却很晚才被告知，所以我认为论坛传达的信息很明确：需要实现透明度。” 情报显示，7月份进行的具有核能力的洲际弹道导弹试验飞越了菲律宾、帕劳和密克罗尼西亚的领空，然后降落在太平洋上。 这一回应已成为 PIF 及其成员战略定位的试金石。 公报的相关条款包括提及斐济去年发表的《和平海洋宣言》，该宣言指出该地区不应受到胁迫和军事化。 然而，它没有点名中国，也没有使用比“关切”更重的外交语言。 虽然澳大利亚官员对商定的声明感到满意，但它没有达到一些退会前的预期，包括东道主帕劳的预期。 “他们向法属波利尼西亚发射了一枚导弹，又向图瓦卢发射了一枚导弹，飞越了我们的领空。他们从来没有费心告诉我们发生了什么，”他说。 “我说‘日本和关岛之间有很大的空间，你为什么不把它送到那里？为什么它必须来到太平洋中部，去年我们刚刚签署了一份……

reflection.en: The leaders of the Pacific Islands Forum have expressed concern over a recent ICBM test that flew over their territories without sufficient warning. Their call for transparency and advance notification echoes the ancient prophetic vision of a world where such instruments of potential conflict are managed with greater care and consideration for all nations....
reflection.zh: 太平洋岛国论坛的领导人对近期一次未获充分预警便飞越其领土的洲际弹道导弹试验表示关切。他们呼吁提高透明度和提前通知，这呼应了古代先知的异象——一个世界，在那里，潜在冲突的工具能够得到更谨慎的处理，并顾及所有国家。 这一时刻凸显了国家安全利益与地区稳定之间的微妙平衡，敦促在国际事务中走上更加开放和相互保证的道路。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Reform’s media presenter worked for Chinese state propaganda channel
title.zh: 改革派媒体主持人曾在中国国家宣传频道工作

summary.en: Reform UK's top media presenter, Ray Addison, who hosts the party's podcast and social media campaigns, has worked for a Chinese state propaganda channel within the past year. Addison presented films about Xinjiang province, where China faces accusations of genocide, for state media in September 2025.
summary.zh: 据《卫报》报道，英国改革党（Reform UK）的首席媒体主持人雷·阿迪森（Ray Addison）在过去一年中曾为中国国家宣传频道工作。阿迪森曾于2025年9月为中国官媒制作了关于新疆省的影片，而中国在该地区面临种族灭绝的指控。

body.en: Party podcast and social media host Ray Addison fronted films about province where China is accused of genocide Reform UK’s top media presenter has worked for a Chinese state propaganda channel within the past year, the Guardian can reveal. Ray Addison, who presents the political party’s in-house podcast and social media campaigns, fronted films about Xinjiang province – where the Chinese government is accused of committing genocide – for state media in September 2025. Continue reading...
body.zh: 据《卫报》透露，党播客和社交媒体主持人雷·艾迪生 (Ray Addison) 主持了有关中国被指控进行种族灭绝的省份的电影。 《改革英国》(Reform UK) 顶级媒体主持人去年曾在中国国家宣传频道工作。负责该政党内部播客和社交媒体活动的雷·艾迪生 (Ray Addison) 于 2025 年 9 月为官方媒体播放了有关新疆省（中国政府被指控实施种族灭绝）的电影。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news that a political party's media presenter has worked for a state propaganda channel raises questions about truthfulness and integrity in public communication. Ephesians 4:25 calls believers to "put off falsehood and speak truthfully to one another," a principle vital for maintaining trust in political discourse and media.
reflection.zh: 一名政党媒体主持人曾为国家宣传频道工作的消息，引发了关于公共传播中真实性和诚信的疑问。以弗所书4章25节呼吁信徒“各人与邻舍说实话”，这一原则对于在政治言论和媒体中维持信任至关重要。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Malaysia's middle path between China and US faces new tests
title.zh: 马来西亚在中国和美国之间走中间道路面临新考验

summary.en: Malaysia's Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim's recent comments on Taiwan and US-backed military facilities have raised questions about the sustainability of the nation's non-aligned foreign policy as US-China rivalry intensifies in Southeast Asia.
summary.zh: 马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣最近就台湾和美国支持的军事设施发表的言论，在美中竞争日益加剧的东南亚地区，引发了对该国不结盟外交政策可持续性的质疑。

body.en:
The prime minister's comments on Taiwan and US-backed military facilities near Sabah have revived questions over Malaysia's non-aligned foreign policy.

Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim has spent much of his time in office insisting that Kuala Lumpur will not be forced to choose between the United States and China .

But two sets of comments last month have raised questions about how sustainable that position is as rivalry between the two superpowers increasingly spills into Southeast Asia.

"I see Taiwan as part of China, period," he said in an interview with news outlet Al Jazeera that aired on August 16.

Beijing considers democratically governed as  Taiwan part of its territory. While Chinese leaders say they favor "peaceful reunification," they have never ruled out using force to bring the island under Beijing's control.

More controversially, Anwar appeared to accept Beijing's argument that force could be necessary.

"If one province decides to break away. Do we use force? I think I will, [to] protect the sanctity and unity of the nation," he said.

The comments drew an enthusiastic response from Beijing, while Taiwan's Foreign Ministry accused Anwar of effectively legitimizing the use of force against the island and warned that his "one-sided support for China could negatively impact Taiwanese businesses' confidence in investing in Malaysia," including in the country's strategically important semiconductor sector.

Two days after his comments on Taiwan aired, Anwar argued that Malaysia  should strengthen its defenses in Sabah, citing the expansion of US-backed military facilities on the nearby Philippine island of Balabac.

The Philippines is upgrading facilities on Balabac, roughly 50 kilometers (31 miles) from the Malaysian islands of Banggi and Balambangan.

Balabac was one of four additional locations added in 2023 to the Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement, which allows US forces to access designated Philippine military facilities, construct infrastructure and pre-position equipment.

Taken together, Anwar's comments raised concerns that Malaysia is growing warmer toward Beijing while becoming more suspicious of Washington's military footprint in the region.

Kuala Lumpur has also been one of the region's strongest critics of Israel's actions in Gaza . Anwar has repeatedly accused the United States and European governments of hypocrisy and double standards for championing democracy and international law while failing, in his view, to hold Israel sufficiently accountable.

But Malaysia experts warn against interpreting Anwar's rhetoric as evidence of a fundamental strategic realignment.

"Malaysia still maintains very good relations with the US and other Western countries," Ngeow Chow Bing, director of the...
body.zh: 总理对台湾和沙巴附近美国支持的军事设施的评论再次引发了对马来西亚不结盟外交政策的质疑。 马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣(Anwar Ibrahim)在任期间大部分时间都坚称，吉隆坡不会被迫在美国和中国之间做出选择。 但上个月的两套评论引发了人们的疑问，随着两个超级大国之间的竞争日益蔓延到东南亚，这一立场的可持续性如何。 “我认为台湾是中国的一部分，就这样，”他在接受半岛电视台 8 月 16 日播出的采访时说道。 北京认为台湾是其领土的一部分，实行民主治理。尽管中国领导人表示支持“和平统一”，但他们从未排除使用武力将该岛置于北京的控制之下。 更具争议性的是，安瓦尔似乎接受了北京关于可能需要使用武力的论点。 “如果一个省决定脱离。我们会使用武力吗？我想我会，[以]保护国家的神圣和统一，”他说。 这些言论引起了北京的热烈回应，而台湾外交部则指责安瓦尔实际上使对台湾使用武力合法化，并警告说，他“对中国的片面支持可能会对台湾企业投资马来西亚的信心产生负面影响”，包括对该国具有重要战略意义的半导体行业的投资。 在发表有关台湾的言论两天后，安瓦尔认为马来西亚应该加强在沙巴的防御，并列举了美国支持的在附近的菲律宾巴拉巴克岛扩建军事设施的情况。 菲律宾正在升级巴拉巴克岛的设施，该岛距离马来西亚班吉岛和巴兰班安岛约 50 公里（31 英里）。 巴拉巴克是 2023 年《增强防务合作协议》新增的四个地点之一，该协议允许美军进入菲律宾指定军事设施、建设基础设施和预置设备。 总而言之，安瓦尔的言论引发了人们的担忧，即马来西亚对北京的态度越来越好，同时对华盛顿在该地区的军事足迹越来越怀疑。 吉隆坡也是该地区对以色列在加沙行动最强烈的批评者之一。安瓦尔一再指责美国和欧洲政府在倡导民主和国际法方面虚伪和双重标准，同时他认为，未能让以色列承担足够的责任。 但马来西亚专家警告不要将安瓦尔的言论解读为根本战略调整的证据。 “马来西亚仍然与美国和其他西方国家保持着非常良好的关系，”该中心主任Ngeow Chow Bing...

reflection.en: Malaysia's Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim seeks to navigate a delicate path between global powers, aiming to avoid choosing sides. This pursuit of balance reflects a desire for peace and stability in a complex geopolitical landscape. The challenge lies in upholding this 'middle path' when external pressures mount, testing the nation's resolve to foster good...
reflection.zh: 马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣试图在两大全球势力之间走一条微妙的道路，力求不选边站队。这种寻求平衡的努力，反映了在复杂的地缘政治格局中对和平与稳定的渴望。当外部压力增大时，如何坚持这条“中间道路”并促进与各方的良好关系，是对国家决心的考验。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Dozens of trapped hydropower tunnel workers in Nepal could still be alive, official says
title.zh: 尼泊尔水电隧道数十名被困工人仍有可能活着，官员称

summary.en: Approximately 46 workers are believed to be trapped in a 'room-like' structure within a hydropower plant tunnel on the Nepal-Tibet border following deadly flash floods. A Nepal electricity authority official expressed hope that many could still be found alive after a week.
summary.zh: 在致命的山洪暴发后，约有46名工人被认为被困在尼泊尔-西藏边境水电站隧道内的一个“房间状”结构中。尼泊尔电力局的一名官员表示，希望许多人在一周后仍能被发现活着。

body.en: About 46 people believed to be trapped in ‘room-like’ structure inside hydro plant tunnel on Nepal-Tibet border After the flood: human suffering on an unfathomable scale in Nepal’s worst-hit districts Nepal authorities have said they are “confident” that dozens of workers in Nepal’s Rasuwagadhi hydropower plant are still alive, more than a week after deadly flash floods left them trapped in an underground chamber. Authorities said that at least 639 workers were still missing from hydropower plants built along Nepal’s Bhote Koshi and Triushuli rivers. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尼泊尔与西藏边境的水电站隧道内约有 46 人被困在“类似房间”的结构中 洪水过后：尼泊尔受灾最严重的地区的人们遭受了难以估量的痛苦 一名尼泊尔电力局官员表示，在致命的山洪爆发后，数十名工人被困在尼泊尔拉苏瓦加迪水电站的地下密室中一周后，很可能会发现数十名工人还活着。尼泊尔电力局董事会成员阿姆苏·基兰·沙希 (Amhsu Kiran Shahi) 周三对路透社表示：“在拉苏瓦加迪，我们认为有 46 人被困在隧道内一个类似房间的结构中。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the face of disaster, the immediate concern is for the lives of those trapped. Amidst the uncertainty and fear, there is a flicker of hope that these 46 workers might still be found alive. This situation calls to mind Psalm 46:1, reminding us that even in overwhelming crises, God is our refuge and strength.
reflection.zh: 面对灾难，当务之急是那些被困者的生命。在不确定和恐惧之中，人们怀着一丝希望，希望这46名工人仍能被活着找到。这种情况让人想起诗篇46:1，提醒我们即使在压倒性的危机中，雅伟也是我们的避难所和力量。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: China’s demise was gleefully predicted by the west – meanwhile, it built an AI revolution | Larry Elliott
title.zh: 西方曾欢欣鼓舞地预言中国将衰落——与此同时，中国却掀起了一场人工智能革命

summary.en: Free AI models that rival expensive US versions are poised to disrupt global markets, offering a lesson for Britain. While Western predictions of China's economic demise have been frequent, focusing on issues like overinvestment, debt, property collapse, and political repression, China has quietly been building a...
summary.zh: 免费且媲美昂贵美国版本的人工智能模型将颠覆全球市场，并给英国带来启示。尽管西方对中国经济的衰落预测不绝于耳，聚焦于过度投资、债务、房地产崩溃和政治压迫等问题，中国却在悄然掀起一场人工智能革命。

body.en: Free AI models that are as good as the investment-hungry US versions will disrupt global markets, and offer Britain a lesson Almost from the moment it began, the end of the Chinese economic miracle has been much anticipated. Thick and fast, the books have come explaining how it will end badly. Overinvestment. A country wallowing in debt. The collapse of the property market . Political repression. The demand for democracy from a growing middle class. All have been put forward as reasons for the inevitable terminal crisis. Even those impressed by the country’s rapid growth took comfort from the notion that the west would continue to dominate advanced manufacturing while China would be stuck assembling TVs. And while the wait for its much-predicted demise has gone on and on, China has become the workshop of the world. Larry Elliott is a Guardian columnist Continue reading...
body.zh: 与渴望投资的美国版本一样好的免费人工智能模型将扰乱全球市场，并为英国提供一个教训。几乎从它开始的那一刻起，人们就一直在期待中国经济奇迹的结束。厚厚的书很快就来了，解释了它将会如何糟糕的结局。过度投资。一个深陷债务泥潭的国家。房地产市场崩溃。政治镇压。不断壮大的中产阶级对民主的需求。所有这些都被认为是不可避免的终极危机的原因。即使是那些对中国的快速增长印象深刻的人也因西方将继续主导先进制造业而中国将陷入电视机组装的困境而感到安慰。尽管人们对它的消亡的等待一直在持续，但中国已经成为世界工厂。拉里·埃利奥特是《卫报》专栏作家继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence in China, as described in the article, mirrors the prophetic vision of Daniel where knowledge would increase in the end times. This technological surge, while impressive, calls us to consider the wisdom and ethical frameworks guiding its development and application. May we seek to use these powerful tools for...
reflection.zh: 文章所描述的中国人工智能的飞速发展，与但以理书中关于末世知识增长的预言相呼应。这场技术浪潮虽然令人瞩目，却也促使我们反思指导其发展和应用的智慧与伦理框架。愿我们寻求以造物主的智慧与秩序为榜样，善用这些强大的工具。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: The shifting ties in Australia's backyard as 'deep pockets' beckon
title.zh: 澳大利亚后院的变动关系：‘深口袋’的诱惑

summary.en: While China stirs tensions over Taiwan in Palau, island leaders are urging Canberra to focus on climate and drug crime.
summary.zh: 在中国试图在帕劳挑起关于台湾的紧张局势之际，岛屿领导人正敦促堪培拉关注气候变化和毒品犯罪。

body.en:
China and Taiwan's diplomatic tug-of-war is casting a shadow over the ongoing Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) as a handful of national leaders declined to attend — however, experts on the ground caution that a geopolitical focus risks ignoring the core priorities of Australia's neighbours.

The annual 18-member gathering in the Taiwanese-allied nation of Palau opened on Monday with climate change, economic security, and the rising influence of the transnational drug trade top of the agenda.

China has said it has "serious concerns" that Taiwan was invited to attend in its own right, while questions have been raised about whether China has influenced five of 18 national leaders from the forum (those of Kiribati, Fiji, Vanuatu, Samoa and Solomon Island) not to attend.

The cornerstone regional political forum began this year with a pointed message from Palau's President Surangel Whipps Jr, who urged nations to adhere to this year's theme of unity and reminded outside partners that they "do not choose our destination".

This year's PIF takes place as Kiribati moves to constitutionally restrict diplomatic recognition to UN member states only — thus excluding Taiwan — while China actively seeks to strip Taiwan of its 'development partner' status in the forum. This comes nearly two months after a Chinese ballistic missile test in the Pacific Ocean .

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Taiwan, a self-governing democracy, broke away from mainland China in 1949. China views it as Chinese territory that must be brought under its control by force if necessary.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has made strengthening regional ties a key focus of his administration's foreign policy, signing multiple bilateral agreements with countries like Fiji, Vanuatu, and Tuvalu.

But despite the noise around China, "leaders have made it clear they're here to work" Tess Newton Cain, principal consultant at Asia-Pacific strategic firm Sustineo, told SBS News from Koror.

"The issue of the China-Taiwan tussle is largely a distraction, and one that they try to minimise."

On Wednesday, $600 million in Australian funding was announced to tackle transnational drug smuggling from South America that is increasingly causing harm across the Pacific.

China has made the PIF something of a battleground, maintaining that Taiwan ought to be sidelined during talks, as it is not technically a "dialogue partner" due to a difficult compromise that PIF members have reached over its status for the past three decades.

Palau, one of the few nations that maintains official diplomatic ties with Taiwan, has accused China of running a coercion campaign against it after travel...
body.zh: 由于少数国家领导人拒绝出席，中国和台湾的外交拉锯战给正在进行的太平洋岛屿论坛（PIF）蒙上了阴影。然而，现场专家警告称，地缘政治焦点可能会忽视澳大利亚邻国的核心优先事项。 一年一度的 18 名成员聚会于周一在台湾盟友帕劳开幕，气候变化、经济安全和跨国毒品贸易影响力不断上升成为首要议题。 中国表示，它“严重关切”台湾本身受邀参加，同时也有人质疑中国是否影响论坛 18 个国家领导人中的 5 个（基里巴斯、斐济、瓦努阿图、萨摩亚和所罗门群岛）不参加。 这一基石区域政治论坛于今年拉开帷幕，帕劳总统小苏兰吉尔·惠普斯发出了尖锐的信息，他敦促各国坚持今年的团结主题，并提醒外部伙伴“我们的目的地不是他们选择的”。 今年的PIF召开之际，基里巴斯从宪法上采取行动，限制仅对联合国成员国进行外交承认，从而将台湾排除在外，而中国则积极寻求剥夺台湾在论坛中的“发展伙伴”地位。这是中国在太平洋进行弹道导弹试验近两个月后的事。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 台湾是一个自治民主国家，于 1949 年脱离中国大陆。中国将其视为中国领土，必要时必须使用武力将其置于其控制之下。 安东尼·阿尔巴内塞总理将加强区域关系作为其政府外交政策的重点，与斐济、瓦努阿图和图瓦卢等国签署了多项双边协议。 不过，尽管中国周围一片喧嚣，“领导人已经明确表示，他们来这里是为了工作”，亚太战略公司 Sustineo 的首席顾问泰丝·牛顿·凯恩 (Tess Newton Cain) 在科罗尔告诉 SBS 新闻。 “中国与台湾的争斗问题在很大程度上是一种干扰，他们试图将其最小化。” 周三，澳大利亚宣布提供 6 亿美元资金，用于打击来自南美洲的跨国毒品走私，这种走私在太平洋沿岸造成的危害日益严重。 中国已将太平洋岛礁论坛变成了一个战场，坚持认为台湾应该在谈判中靠边站，因为过去三十年来，太平洋岛礁论坛成员就其地位达成了艰难的妥协，因此从技术上讲，台湾并不是“对话伙伴”。 帕劳是少数几个与台湾保持正式外交关系的国家之一，该国指责中国在旅行后对其进行胁迫行动......

reflection.en: The leaders of Pacific island nations are navigating complex geopolitical currents, yet their urgent pleas to Australia highlight their immediate concerns: climate change and the drug trade. These are matters of justice and well-being for their people, echoing the prophet Micah's call to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Yahweh. Their focus on...
reflection.zh: 太平洋岛国领导人正驾驭复杂的地缘政治暗流，但他们向澳大利亚发出的紧急呼吁，凸显了他们眼前的关切：气候变化和毒品交易。这些关乎其人民的福祉和公义，呼应了先知弥迦的呼召，要行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行。他们关注切实的需要而非遥远的冲突，提醒我们真正的优先事项往往在哪里。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Can communities be proteced from melting glaciers?
title.zh: 社区能否免受冰川融化的影响？

summary.en: Rising temperatures are increasing the risk of floods and avalanches in mountain regions. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet shows the urgent need for solutions, and the tools that could help save lives.
summary.zh: 日益升高的气温增加了山区发生洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明，迫切需要解决方案以及可能有助于挽救生命的工具。

body.en:
Rising temperatures are increasing the risk of floods and avalanches in mountain regions. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet shows the urgent need for solutions, and the tools that could help save lives.

High mountain glaciers formed in the ice age are retreating and becoming unstable as the burning of fossil fuels heats the climate and leads to a decline in snowfall.

The instability creates the conditions for large glacial sections to collapse, triggering ice and rock avalanches that can dam river valleys before tidal waves of water are released.

Following the glacier collapse that triggered what is known as a mountain tsunami in Nepal and Tibet on August 26 , thousands are still missing and feared dead. Unlike the 2025 glacier avalanche that destroyed the town of Blatten in Switzerland — where nearly all inhabitants were evacuated — a lack of early warning systems in the Himalayas left locals and tourists at the mercy of flash floods .

The causes of glacier collapse are part of a complex web of interrelated changes to high mountain landscapes due in part to rising global temperatures, say scientists.

Levan Tielidze, research fellow in glacial geomorphology at Australia's Monash University, said the Himalayas are not, as is often imagined, a "frozen and relatively stable environment," but "dynamic systems in which glaciers , snow, permafrost, rock slopes, rivers and monsoon processes interact." 

"As the climate warms, these components are changing simultaneously, meaning hazards can cascade from one process into another," he told DW. When rock, ice and water interact in more unpredictable ways on the world's highest peaks, the resulting debris flows "can transform into a catastrophic flood far downstream."

Almost 25 years ago, in what was then the biggest glacial collapse in history, one glacier crashed onto another in the Caucasus Mountains of North Ossetia in Russia. The event caused avalanches of ice and debris that slid more than 24 kilometers (15 miles) and killed around 125 people.

"The Kolka Glacier disaster was one of the early warnings of the increasing occurrence and potential severity of such glacier-related hazards," said Tielidze. 

Meanwhile, the UN says glaciers in Nepalese mountains have declined by one-third in 30 years, which has added to their instability. 

Some research suggests that even if emissions from burning fossil fuels were low enough to prevent the planet from heating by more than 2 degrees Celsius (3.6 Fahrenheit) compared to pre-industrial times, the wider Hindu Kush Himalayan region could lose up to half its glacier cover — compared to 2020 levels — by the end of the century.

For Dipesh Chapagain, senior scientist at...
body.zh: 气温上升增加了山区发生洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明迫切需要解决方案以及可以帮助拯救生命的工具。 由于化石燃料的燃烧导致气候变暖并导致降雪量减少，冰河时代形成的高山冰川正在后退并变得不稳定。 这种不稳定性为大片冰川崩塌创造了条件，引发冰雪崩塌，在潮水释放之前可能会堵塞河谷。 8 月 26 日，冰川崩塌在尼泊尔和西藏引发了山地海啸，之后仍有数千人失踪并恐已死亡。与 2025 年摧毁瑞士布拉滕镇的冰川雪崩不同，那次冰川雪崩几乎所有居民都被疏散，喜马拉雅山缺乏预警系统，导致当地人和游客受到山洪暴发的影响。 科学家表示，冰川崩塌的原因是高山景观相互关联的复杂变化网络的一部分，部分原因是全球气温上升。 澳大利亚莫纳什大学冰川地貌学研究员莱万·蒂利泽 (Levan Tielidze) 表示，喜马拉雅山并不像人们通常想象的那样是一个“冰冻且相对稳定的环境”，而是“冰川、积雪、永久冻土、岩坡、河流和季风过程相互作用的动态系统”。 他告诉德国之声：“随着气候变暖，这些组成部分同时发生变化，这意味着危害可能从一个过程级联到另一个过程。” 当岩石、冰和水在世界最高峰上以更难以预测的方式相互作用时，由此产生的泥石流“可能会在下游转化为灾难性的洪水”。 大约 25 年前，俄罗斯北奥塞梯高加索山脉的一座冰川与另一座冰川相撞，发生了当时历史上最严重的冰川崩塌事件。该事件导致冰雪和碎片滑落超过 24 公里（15 英里），造成约 125 人死亡。 蒂利泽说：“科尔卡冰川灾难是此类冰川相关灾害日益频繁且潜在严重性的早期预警之一。” 与此同时，联合国表示，尼泊尔山区的冰川在 30 年内减少了三分之一，这加剧了冰川的不稳定。 一些研究表明，即使燃烧化石燃料的排放量足够低，足以防止地球升温超过工业化前时期 2 摄氏度（3.6 华氏度），到本世纪末，更广阔的兴都库什喜马拉雅地区的冰川覆盖率可能会比 2020 年的水平减少多达一半。 对于 Dipesh Chapagagain 来说，高级科学家......

reflection.en: The melting glaciers and subsequent disasters in Nepal and Tibet are a stark reminder that our planet groans under the weight of human activity. Romans 8:22 speaks of all creation groaning in travail, awaiting its redemption. This passage calls us to acknowledge the deep interconnectedness of our world and our responsibility to care for it.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏融化的冰川及随之而来的灾难，鲜明地提醒我们，我们的地球在人类活动的重压下呻吟。罗马书8:22说，万物一同叹息劳苦，等候得赎。这段经文呼吁我们认识到我们世界深层的相互联系，以及我们照顾它的责任。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: How China buried Tibet flood images after Nepal disaster
title.zh: 中国如何掩埋了尼泊尔灾难后的西藏洪水图像

summary.en: In Tibet, a digital crackdown followed the deadly flood that has devastated communities along the China-Nepal border. Censors erased viral footage while Chinese state media flooded platforms with official content.
summary.zh: 在西藏，一场致命的洪水摧毁了中国和尼泊尔边境的社区，随后出现了数字审查。审查人员删除了病毒式传播的画面，而中国官方媒体则用官方内容充斥了各大平台。

body.en:
In Tibet, a digital crackdown followed the deadly flood that has devastated communities along the China-Nepal border. Censors erased viral footage while Chinese state media flooded platforms with official content.

When a catastrophic flash flood swept through the rugged China-Nepal border on August 26, the physical devastation was immediate.

In Nepal , a black torrent of mud and rock tore through communities, leaving hundreds dead and thousands more missing along the borderlands.

But across the frontier in Tibet, an autonomous region of China , the physical disaster was almost instantly followed by a digital one: the rapid, high-tech erasure of the catastrophe's visual evidence.

As survivors tried to upload raw footage of the deluge, China's state-backed information control apparatus swung into action, executing a sophisticated, precision operation to shape the public narrative and bury inconvenient truths.

The contrasting realities — a tragic humanitarian crisis in Nepal and a tightly sanitized, triumphant rescue narrative in China — reveal the evolving mechanics of Beijing's modern censorship machine.

Rather than imposing a blunt, blanket blackout, authorities deployed advanced image-recognition technology and "saturated information" tactics to drown out domestic scrutiny while deflecting diplomatic friction abroad.

In the immediate aftermath of the flood-triggered mudslide, local residents captured dramatic footage of the torrent engulfing Gyirong Port, a critical overland trade hub between China and Nepal.

The most striking video showed a black wall of water and debris crashing into and destroying the "national" border gate.

In an article titled "An Unrecorded Mudslide Rushes into Gyirong Port" on China's WeChat, a universal app that combines messaging with payment options and social media functions, local blogger "Matou Qingnian" described the chaotic scene.

"The most terrifying moment happened at the Gyirong Port," the author wrote, describing video footage of crowds, including children, fleeing in panic before a pitch-black torrent swallowed the camera's view.

Within hours, both the article and the raw video footage had vanished from Chinese social media .

According to  China Digital Times (CDT) , an independent watchdog that tracks Chinese internet censorship , the video of the collapsing border gate was systematically blocked from being shared on WeChat, even in private messages.

"The footage itself contained no graphic violence, no protests, and no political slogans," explained Mira, a CDT editor who specializes in tracking sensitive keywords and media. "The target of the censorship was the symbol itself: the National Gate."

Digital analysts note that this censorship highlights a significant upgrade...
body.zh: 在西藏，致命的洪水摧毁了中尼边境沿线的社区，随后进行了数字镇压。审查机构删除了病毒式传播的视频，而中国官方媒体则在平台上充斥着官方内容。 8 月 26 日，一场灾难性的山洪席卷崎岖的中尼边境，造成了立即的破坏。 在尼泊尔，一股黑色泥浆和岩石洪流席卷了边境地区的社区，造成数百人死亡、数千人失踪。 但在中国西藏自治区的边境地区，这场物理灾难几乎立刻就发生了一场数字灾难：灾难的视觉证据被迅速、高科技删除。 当幸存者试图上传洪水的原始镜头时，中国国家支持的信息控制机构立即采取行动，执行复杂而精确的操作，以塑造公众叙事并掩盖难以忽视的真相。 对比鲜明的现实——尼泊尔悲惨的人道主义危机和中国严密消毒、胜利的救援故事——揭示了北京现代审查机制不断演变的机制。 当局没有实施生硬、全面的封锁，而是采用了先进的图像识别技术和“饱和信息”策略来淹没国内审查，同时转移国外的外交摩擦。 洪水引发的泥石流发生后，当地居民拍下了洪流吞没吉隆港的戏剧性镜头，吉隆港是中国和尼泊尔之间重要的陆路贸易枢纽。 最引人注目的视频显示，黑色的水墙和碎片冲撞并摧毁了“国家”边境大门。 当地博主“马头青年”在中国微信（一款将消息传递、支付选项和社交媒体功能结合在一起的通用应用程序）上发表了一篇题为“一场未记录的泥石流冲进吉隆口岸”的文章，描述了当时的混乱场面。 “最可怕的时刻发生在吉隆口岸，”作者写道，并描述了包括儿童在内的人群在漆黑的洪流吞没摄像机视野之前惊慌失措的画面。 几个小时内，这篇文章和原始视频片段就从中国社交媒体上消失了。 据追踪中国互联网审查制度的独立监管机构中国数字时代（CDT）称，倒塌边境大门的视频被系统性地禁止在微信上分享，甚至在私人信息中也是如此。 专门跟踪敏感关键词和媒体的 CDT 编辑米拉解释说：“视频本身不包含暴力画面、抗议活动和政治口号。” “审查的目标是标志本身：国门。” 数字分析师指出，这次审查凸显了重大升级......

reflection.en: The story describes how visual evidence of a devastating flood in Tibet was systematically erased, replaced by official narratives. This act of censorship raises questions about truth and transparency, reminding us of the importance of speaking truthfully and avoiding deception, as Ephesians 4:25 urges.
reflection.zh: 故事描述了西藏一场毁灭性洪水的视觉证据如何被系统性地抹去，并被官方叙事所取代。这种审查行为引发了关于真相和透明度的疑问，提醒我们说实话和避免欺骗的重要性，正如以弗所书4:25所敦促的那样。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.

summary.en: The strengthening El Niño is already disrupting lives around the world, as the United Nations warns the "surging" climate pattern is raising the risk of months of heatwaves, floods, drought and extreme weather. body.en:
The strengthening El Niño is already disrupting lives around the world, as the United Nations warns the "surging" climate pattern is raising the risk of months of heatwaves, floods, drought and extreme weather.

On Thursday, the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) said there was a likelihood of "nearly 100 per cent" that El Niño will persist through to February, noting that this was the first time that an El Niño update had been so unequivocal.

The WMO's secretary-general, Celeste Saulo, said the climate driver, which was officially declared underway in June, has already dealt a blow to communities worldwide.

"We are already seeing disruption and devastation from droughts and floods and we expect these impacts to increase as El Niño intensifies," she said.

The phenomenon is expected to peak at very high intensity towards the end of the year — potentially at a record-breaking level — with lasting effects on the climate well into 2027 and the prospect of unprecedented global heat.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

UN secretary-general António Guterres warned that El Niño is "being supersized before our eyes" by climate change.

"The science leaves no room for doubt: the planet is in uncharted waters, and those waters are heating up," Guterres said in response to the WMO update.

El Niño is associated with higher global temperatures and can bring drought and extreme heat to some regions while increasing rainfall and flood risks in others.

In Australia, El Niño typically increases the likelihood of hotter, drier conditions in the east and south-east, though its influence varies, and other climate factors also shape rainfall and temperatures.

Warmer-than-usual weather is expected across most of Australia through the spring.

More than a million students are learning remotely this week as toxic wildfire haze blankets parts of Indonesia, with officials warning that efforts to extinguish the blazes are entering a critical phase.

"Our problems are not over. September is the peak of El Niño," Indonesia's forestry minister Raja Juli Antoni told reporters this week.

El Niño is driving hotter, drier conditions in the region, intensifying a dry season that has seen thousands of hectares burnt.

Indonesian forest fire forensics expert Bambang Hero Saharjo told the BBC this year's El Niño-fuelled blazes could burn an area as large as 11 million hectares.

The haze has spread across parts of Southeast Asia, triggering health warnings and hospitalisations.

body.zh: 不断加强的厄尔尼诺现象已经扰乱了世界各地的生活，联合国警告称，这种“急剧上升”的气候模式正在增加持续数月的热浪、洪水、干旱和极端天气的风险。 周四，世界气象组织（WMO）表示，厄尔尼诺现象有“近100%”的可能性将持续到二月份，并指出这是第一次如此明确地更新厄尔尼诺现象。 世界气象组织秘书长塞莱斯特·索洛 (Celeste Saulo) 表示，6 月份正式宣布启动的气候驱动计划已经对世界各地的社区造成了打击。 她说：“我们已经看到干旱和洪水造成的破坏和破坏，预计随着厄尔尼诺现象的加剧，这些影响将会加剧。” 预计这种现象将在年底达到非常高的强度——可能达到破纪录的水平——对气候的持续影响将持续到 2027 年，全球可能会出现前所未有的高温。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯警告说，气候变化导致厄尔尼诺现象“在我们眼前变得更加严重”。 古特雷斯在回应世界气象组织的最新消息时表示：“科学不容置疑：地球正处于未知水域，而且这些水域正在升温。” 厄尔尼诺现象与全球气温升高有关，可能给一些地区带来干旱和极端高温，同时增加其他地区的降雨和洪水风险。 在澳大利亚，厄尔尼诺现象通常会增加东部和东南部出现更热、更干燥天气的可能性，尽管其影响各不相同，而且其他气候因素也会影响降雨量和气温。 预计整个春季澳大利亚大部分地区的天气将比平常温暖。 本周，有毒野火烟雾笼罩印度尼西亚部分地区，超过一百万学生正在远程学习，官员警告说，扑灭大火的努力正进入关键阶段。 “我们的问题还没有结束。九月是厄尔尼诺现象的顶峰，”印度尼西亚林业部长拉贾·朱利·安东尼本周告诉记者。 厄尔尼诺现象导致该地区气候变得更加炎热、干燥，加剧了旱季，导致数千公顷土地被烧毁。 印度尼西亚森林火灾法医专家 Bambang Hero Saharjo 告诉 BBC，今年厄尔尼诺现象引发的大火可能会烧毁面积达 1100 万公顷的土地。 雾霾已经蔓延到东南亚部分地区，引发健康警告和住院治疗。 邻国马来西亚卫生部报告称，由于空气质量问题，全国哮喘和结膜炎病例不断增加……

title.en: This virus has evolved. Australia doesn't have a new vaccine
title.zh: 这种病毒已经进化。澳大利亚没有新疫苗

summary.en: Australia is lagging behind the latest formulations being developed overseas.

body.en:
Australians can't yet access a COVID-19 vaccine tailored for new variants, highlighting how Australia's system tends to lag behind, as a major manufacturer confirms it has no plans to push into Australia's market.

Pfizer and BioNTech's latest COVID-19 vaccine, adapted to target the XFG subvariant, has been approved in the United States for the 2026-27 season, following international guidance to more closely match vaccines with contemporary circulating variants.

But experts say the lag is not necessarily cause for alarm, with Australia continuing to monitor circulating variants and having access to relatively recent updated vaccines.

Pfizer and BioNTech's LP.8.1-adapted COVID-19 vaccine was registered on the Australian Register of Therapeutic Goods in late 2025 and became available in Australia in December.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The issue is therefore less about Australia going without updated COVID-19 vaccines, and more about how quickly newer formulations can be made available as the virus continues to evolve.

Professor Paul Griffin, an infectious diseases physician and clinical microbiologist, said Australia tended to lag behind some countries in updating COVID-19 vaccines.

"I think it's just some of the way we're managing those updates just means it's not quite happening as streamlined a way as we might like," he said.

Griffin said countries with more established frameworks could update vaccines closer to real time.

While he said faster access would be preferable, he also stressed the importance of continuing to update vaccines as the virus changes.

But Sarah McGuinness, a senior research fellow at Monash University, told SBS News there was no single explanation for why a new formulation might become available overseas before it does in Australia.

She said one factor is the decisions vaccine manufacturers make about which countries to seek regulatory approval in, and when, with vaccine sponsors responsible for deciding whether to seek regulatory approval in different countries.

McGuinness also said Australia is a relatively small market compared with areas such as the US and Europe, meaning new formulations are not always brought here first.

Peter Markey, a GP and public health physician who chairs the Royal Australian College of General Practitioners' public health special interest group, said Australian authorities were continuing to monitor the virus internationally.

He said governments, researchers and the World Health Organization would be watching circulating strains and sub-strains and "looking out for vaccines to match them".

title.en: Before global fame, Steve Irwin was a wildlife researcher with a tatty green backpack
title.zh: 环球成名之前，史蒂夫·欧文是一位带着破旧绿色背包的野生动物研究员

summary.en: Twenty years after his death, Steve Irwin's passion for wildlife lives on through his family and the generations he inspired.
summary.zh: 在他去世二十年后，史蒂夫·欧文对野生动物的热情通过他的家人和他激励的几代人得以延续。

body.en:
Twenty years after Steve Irwin's sudden death, a man who wrestled crocodiles with him for a living still can't talk about it without choking up.

In 2006, while holidaying in France, Mark Read had just returned from a walk with his baby daughter when he found his wife sobbing outside an internet café.

Two decades on, the memories of the man the world knew as the Crocodile Hunter still bring a lump to his throat.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Read first met Irwin in 1997 on what can only be described as a very Steve Irwin kind of operation, a turtle rodeo in Queensland's Moreton Bay.

People were tearing around in small, fast boats in shallow water, hurling themselves overboard to wrestle the surprised critters to the surface in order to study their health, breeding status and growth rates.

From that chaotic first encounter, the pair went on to spend years working together on crocodile research across north Queensland.

Their collaboration helped launch a pioneering satellite‑tracking effort dubbed Crocs in Space, a partnership between the Queensland Parks and Wildlife Service, Australia Zoo and the University of Queensland.

It used some of the first functional satellite transmitters ever fitted to estuarine crocodiles, revealing how far the big predators could roam and even how many found their way home after relocation.

Far from a caricature, Read remembers Irwin as an extraordinarily intelligent, relentlessly curious collaborator in the field.

Inside was an even tattier folder and notepad he constantly filled with sketches to capture techniques and ideas for future research.

There were long, quiet hours that never made it to television — nights around campfires and early mornings when Irwin would wake Read for tea and conversations about crocodiles, wild places and how to get the public to care.

For a man with global reach and serious earning power, Irwin never changed, turning up to remote field trips in boots with holes patched up with gaffer tape.

"It most certainly wasn't about earning a heap of money and living a lavish lifestyle."

It was in the way he could read a crocodile's body language in a heartbeat or calmly scoop up a six‑foot coastal taipan snake from the grass, keep it unruffled, and then let it slide away as if it were the most natural thing in the world.

He was, Read says, both a "proper stirrer" who loved teasing people in good humour and a deeply tender family man who "lived for his family".

When Steve and Terri Irwin's first daughter was born, they sent boxes of presents and an enormous floral arrangement to the family home.
