title.en: Pacific leaders voice concern over Chinese missile test but stop short of condemnation
title.zh: 太平洋领导人对中国导弹试验表示担忧，但未予谴责

summary.en: The Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) concluded with most member nations agreeing to "register concern" over China's recent intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) test, which overflew several members without adequate notice. Leaders urged transparency and advance notification for such tests, with Nauru being the sole...
summary.zh: 太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）闭幕，多数成员国同意就中国近期洲际弹道导弹（ICBM）试验“表示关切”，该试验在未获充分通知的情况下飞越了部分成员国领土。领导人敦促所有进行ICBM试验的国家确保透明度和保障，包括按照国际惯例至少提前24小时发出通知。18个成员国中，瑙鲁是唯一一个对此条款持异议的国家。

body.en:
The Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) has wrapped up with most nations agreeing to "register concern" on China's recent intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) test, "which overflew a number of members without adequate notice".

"Leaders call on all states undertaking ICBM testing to ensure transparency and reassurance, including through the provision of advance notification of a test at least 24 hours in accordance with international practice," the communique says, as read out by Palau's President and PIF chair Surangel Whipps Junior, after the closing ceremony.

In a rare move for the usually consensus-based forum, Nauru was the only one of 18 PIF members to dissent from the clause.

Kiribati and Nauru were the only two Pacific nations that had previously blocked a draft PIF statement in the immediate aftermath of Beijing's test, a move that Prime Minister Anthony Albanese had been advocating for.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

However the statement went further than analysts and government sources had expected; the PIF foreign ministers' meeting statement in August was broader, discussing ballistic missile testing in the region, but had stopped short of singling out a particular ICBM or referencing a notice period for nations to undergo any testing.

Whipps also hit back against China's comments that Palau sensationalised its ballistic missile test, saying: "There's no sensationalism, it's just stating the facts."

"The Pacific Islands weren't informed [of the test]. The ones that were informed were informed late, and so I think the message from the forum is clear: that transparency needs to happen."

Intelligence shows the nuclear-capable intercontinental ballistic missile test in July flew over the Philippines, Palau and Micronesia's airspace before landing in the Pacific Ocean.

The response has become something of a litmus test for PIF and its members for their strategic positioning.

The communique's relevant clause includes a reference to the Fiji-led Ocean of Peace declaration made last year, which states the region should be free from coercion and militarisation.

However, it doesn't name China, nor does it use heftier diplomatic language than "concern".

While Australian officials were happy with the agreed statement, it fell short of some pre-retreat expectations, including those of the host, Palau.

"They sent a missile next to French Polynesia, another one next to Tuvalu, crossing over our airspace. They never bothered to tell us that's what's happening," he said.

"I said 'there's a lot of space between Japan and Guam, why don't you send it there? Why does it have to come to the middle of the Pacific when last year we just signed a...
body.zh: 太平洋岛屿论坛（PIF）结束时，大多数国家同意对中国最近的洲际弹道导弹（ICBM）试验“表达关切”，“该试验在没有充分通知的情况下飞越了一些成员国”。 帕劳总统兼太平洋岛国论坛主席苏兰吉尔·惠普斯·儒尼奥尔在闭幕式后宣读的公报称，“领导人呼吁所有进行洲际弹道导弹测试的国家确保透明度和保证，包括根据国际惯例至少提前 24 小时提前通知测试情况”。 对于这个通常以共识为基础的论坛来说，这是一个罕见的举动，瑙鲁是 18 个 PIF 成员中唯一不同意该条款的国家。 基里巴斯和瑙鲁是此前在北京试验后立即阻止PIF声明草案的仅有的两个太平洋国家，此举是总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯一直倡导的。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 然而，该声明超出了分析师和政府消息人士的预期；太平洋岛国论坛外交部长八月份的会议声明范围更广，讨论了该地区的弹道导弹试验，但没有单独指出特定的洲际弹道导弹或提及各国进行任何试验的通知期。 惠普斯还反驳了中国关于帕劳炒作其弹道导弹试验的言论，他说：“没有煽情，只是陈述事实。” “太平洋岛屿没有被告知（这次测试）。那些被告知的人却很晚才被告知，所以我认为论坛传达的信息很明确：需要实现透明度。” 情报显示，7月份进行的具有核能力的洲际弹道导弹试验飞越了菲律宾、帕劳和密克罗尼西亚的领空，然后降落在太平洋上。 这一回应已成为 PIF 及其成员战略定位的试金石。 公报的相关条款包括提及斐济去年发表的《和平海洋宣言》，该宣言指出该地区不应受到胁迫和军事化。 然而，它没有点名中国，也没有使用比“关切”更重的外交语言。 虽然澳大利亚官员对商定的声明感到满意，但它没有达到一些退会前的预期，包括东道主帕劳的预期。 “他们向法属波利尼西亚发射了一枚导弹，又向图瓦卢发射了一枚导弹，飞越了我们的领空。他们从来没有费心告诉我们发生了什么，”他说。 “我说‘日本和关岛之间有很大的空间，你为什么不把它送到那里？为什么它必须来到太平洋中部，去年我们刚刚签署了一份……

reflection.en: The leaders of the Pacific Islands Forum have expressed concern over a recent ICBM test that flew over their territories without sufficient warning. Their call for transparency and advance notification echoes the ancient prophetic vision of a world where such instruments of potential conflict are managed with greater care and consideration for all nations....
reflection.zh: 太平洋岛国论坛的领导人对近期一次未获充分预警便飞越其领土的洲际弹道导弹试验表示关切。他们呼吁提高透明度和提前通知，这呼应了古代先知的异象——一个世界，在那里，潜在冲突的工具能够得到更谨慎的处理，并顾及所有国家。 这一时刻凸显了国家安全利益与地区稳定之间的微妙平衡，敦促在国际事务中走上更加开放和相互保证的道路。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: 'Hard to continue': Harvey's future is in limbo as his sport faces an existential threat
title.zh: 这些澳大利亚人依赖狭窄的训练窗口。今年它几乎没有打开

summary.en: Australia has just experienced one of the warmest winters on record, causing panic among those who use its mountains. Professional snow athletes, like snowboarder Harvey Edmanson, are self-funded and struggle to find training opportunities in Australia, threatening their careers.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚刚刚经历了创纪录的温暖冬季，这让依赖其山脉的人们感到恐慌。像单板滑雪运动员哈维·埃德曼森这样的职业雪上运动员是自费训练的，他们在澳大利亚难以找到训练机会，这威胁着他们的职业生涯。

body.en:
Ski resorts across Australia have faced one of the hottest winters on record. For Australian snowboarder Harvey Edmanson, this is a threat to his future, and to the future of young snow athletes across Australia.

Speaking to SBS, the member of the Australian Alpine Snowboard National Team said: "If I don't have snow and training opportunities in Australia, it's going to make it really hard to continue."

Many professional snow athletes, including Edmanson, are self-funded. He has to fit his training around working as a façade designer in Melbourne.

The 27-year-old does most of his training at Mount Buller in Victoria but also ventures further north to the Perisher and Thredbo resorts in NSW.

Typically, he aims to train on the slopes from early July until late September. This year his start was delayed by three weeks and he was forced to stop in late August.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Additionally, to train at a high level, Edmanson and other athletes need a sectioned-off part of the slope where they can set up racing conditions.

Ski resorts are usually happy to accommodate this, but have found it harder this year due to having a smaller area with sufficient snow depth.

"When there's only limited snow and limited run hill space, then it's not possible," Edmanson said.

Australian snow athletes often compete overseas during the northern hemisphere’s winter before returning to train in Australia in the off-season.

As snow seasons get shorter, Edmanson said athletes are skipping Australia entirely and starting to look overseas for off-season training.

This is not something he can do given he needs to work, and he joked that he "can't commute to New Zealand".

Some in the snow sports community fear for future generations of Australian snow athletes if opportunities continue to dwindle for younger athletes seeking to develop.

Edmanson runs a futures program for developing athletes and says there's a lot of young athletes who are "looking to compete, looking to train, and they don't get enough time on snow in Australia".

Many younger athletes need to balance school and practice. Edmanson didn’t travel overseas to compete until he finished school.

"The most important part of my training and development all happened in Australia," he said. "It's really scary that there's a lot of young athletes that might not have that opportunity."

This year’s Milano Cortina Winter Olympics provided an injection of optimism into Australian snow sports after the Australian team won a national best three golds, two silvers and one bronze.

To continue this momentum, Edmanson says we need to give young athletes "that opportunity...
body.zh: 澳大利亚各地的滑雪胜地面临着有记录以来最热的冬天之一。对于澳大利亚单板滑雪运动员哈维·埃德曼森（Harvey Edmanson）来说，这对他的未来以及澳大利亚年轻滑雪运动员的未来构成了威胁。 澳大利亚高山滑雪国家队成员在接受 SBS 采访时表示：“如果我在澳大利亚没有雪和训练机会，我将很难继续下去。” 许多职业雪上运动员，包括埃德曼森，都是自筹资金的。他必须适应在墨尔本担任幕墙设计师的工作所接受的培训。 这位 27 岁的球员大部分训练都在维多利亚州的布勒山进行，但也会冒险前往更北的新南威尔士州的佩里舍 (Perisher) 和斯雷德博 (Thredbo) 度假村。 通常，他的目标是从七月初到九月底在斜坡上训练。今年他的出发时间推迟了三周，并在八月下旬被迫停止。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 此外，为了进行高水平训练，埃德曼森和其他运动员需要将斜坡划分出一部分，以便他们设置比赛条件。 滑雪场通常很乐意满足这一要求，但今年发现难度更大，因为面积较小，雪深足够。 埃德曼森说：“当雪量有限且滑坡空间有限时，这是不可能的。” 澳大利亚雪上运动员经常在北半球的冬季前往海外比赛，然后在淡季返回澳大利亚训练。 埃德曼森说，随着雪季变短，运动员们将完全跳过澳大利亚，开始到海外进行休赛期训练。 鉴于他需要工作，这不是他能做的事情，他开玩笑说他“无法通勤到新西兰”。 雪上运动界的一些人担心，如果寻求发展的年轻运动员的机会继续减少，澳大利亚未来几代的雪上运动员就会担心。 埃德曼森运营着一个培养运动员的未来计划，他说有很多年轻运动员“想要参加比赛，想要训练，但他们在澳大利亚没有足够的时间在雪上”。 许多年轻运动员需要平衡学业和训练。埃德曼森直到完成学业才出国参加比赛。 “我的训练和发展中最重要的部分都发生在澳大利亚，”他说。 “这真的很可怕，很多年轻运动员可能没有这样的机会。” 今年的米兰科尔蒂纳冬奥会，澳大利亚队夺得全国最好成绩三金两银一铜，为澳大利亚雪上运动注入了乐观的情绪。 埃德曼森说，为了保持这种势头，我们需要给年轻运动员“这个机会......

reflection.en: The unusually warm winter in Australia has created a crisis for athletes like Harvey Edmanson, whose training and careers depend on snow. This situation evokes Habakkuk's lament, where even in the face of devastating crop failure and economic hardship, the prophet chooses to find joy in Yahweh. It calls us to consider where we place our ultimate hope when...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚异常温暖的冬季给哈维·埃德曼森这样的运动员带来了危机，他们的训练和职业生涯都依赖于降雪。这种情况让人想起哈巴谷的哀歌，即使面对毁灭性的歉收和经济困难，先知仍选择在雅伟里喜乐。这促使我们思考，当外部环境变得严峻时，我们最终的盼望放在何处。

verse.textEn: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines... yet I will rejoice in Yahweh.
verse.textZh: 虽然无花果树不发旺，葡萄树不结果……然而，我要因雅伟欢欣。

title.en: Antisemitism royal commission to report later than planned
title.zh: 反犹太主义皇家委员会报告推迟

summary.en: The Royal Commission on Antisemitism and Social Cohesion has extended its reporting deadline by four days to avoid coinciding with the first anniversary of the Bondi Massacre, a mass shooting that claimed 15 lives. Commissioner Virginia Bell stated the extension was requested to ensure the report does not overshadow...
summary.zh: 反犹太主义和社会凝聚力皇家委员会将其报告截止日期延长了四天，以避免与邦迪大屠杀一周年纪念日发生冲突，该屠杀事件造成 15 人死亡。委员会主席弗吉尼亚·贝尔表示，延长是为了确保报告不会盖过 12 月 14 日（袭击周年纪念日）的庄严悼念活动。

body.en:
The Royal Commission on Antisemitism and Social Cohesion has had its deadline extended by four days so that it does not clash with the anniversary of the Bondi Massacre.

The months-long royal commission was slated to hand down its final report on 14 December, the first anniversary of the mass shooting that left 15 people dead. The commission will now report on 18 December.

In a statement, commissioner Virginia Bell AC SC said she requested the extension from the federal government so that her final report did "not overshadow the first anniversary of the Bondi Chanukah attack".

"The 14th of December will be a solemn occasion marked by memorials," the statement said.

"I am aware of concern within the Jewish community that delivery of the report on the anniversary would be a distraction. I welcome this short extension."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Established on 9 January, the royal commission heard evidence from 348 witnesses over 62 days of hearings in Sydney and Melbourne.

Bell is currently preparing her final report, which will examine this evidence alongside more than 20,000 public submissions.

On 26 August, the final day of public hearings, Bell told the commission her focus had been on the lives of ordinary Jewish Australians.

"The Bondi Chanukah attack came after more than two years of a marked increase in antisemitism throughout Australia," she said.

"Laying out the picture of the lived experience of antisemitism is a critical part of any steps to combat that phenomenon."

An interim report was released on 30 April and made 14 recommendations to strengthen counterterrorism responses.

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 皇家反犹太主义和社会凝聚力委员会已将截止日期延长四天，以免与邦迪大屠杀周年纪念日相冲突。 为期数月的皇家委员会定于 12 月 14 日提交最终报告，即造成 15 人死亡的大规模枪击事件一周年纪念日。该委员会将于 12 月 18 日提交报告。 弗吉尼亚·贝尔 AC SC 专员在一份声明中表示，她请求联邦政府延期，以便她的最终报告“不会掩盖邦迪光明节袭击一周年”。 声明称：“12 月 14 日将是一个以纪念活动为标志的庄严时刻。” “我知道犹太社区担心在周年纪念日提交报告会分散注意力。我欢迎这次短暂的延期。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 皇家委员会成立于 1 月 9 日，在悉尼和墨尔本举行了为期 62 天的听证会，听取了 348 名证人提供的证据。 贝尔目前正在准备她的最终报告，该报告将审查这些证据以及 20,000 多份公众提交的意见。 8 月 26 日，即公开听证会的最后一天，贝尔告诉委员会，她的重点是普通犹太澳大利亚人的生活。 她说：“邦迪光明节袭击发生在两年多以来，整个澳大利亚的反犹太主义明显增加。” “展示反犹太主义的生活经历是打击这一现象的任何步骤的关键部分。” 4月30日发布了一份中期报告，提出了加强反恐应对措施的14项建议。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: In a world often marked by conflict and sharp anniversaries, the decision to postpone the Royal Commission's report is a gesture of profound sensitivity. By choosing to honor the solemnity of the Bondi Massacre's first anniversary, the commission prioritizes communal healing and remembrance over its own procedural timeline. This act of careful consideration...
reflection.zh: 在一个常常充满冲突和尖锐纪念日的世界里，推迟皇家委员会报告的决定是一种深刻体贴的姿态。通过选择尊重邦迪大屠杀一周年纪念日的庄严，委员会将社区的疗愈和追思置于其自身程序时间表之上。这一审慎的举动体现了“使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必得称为神的儿子”的教导，旨在避免进一步的痛苦，并为哀悼留出空间。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: CNBC latest to pull back from Hong Kong as local office closes, shows axed
title.zh: CNBC撤出香港，关闭本地办公室并取消节目

summary.en: CNBC has closed its Hong Kong office and canceled several daily shows as part of a "programming and production restructuring." Owner Versant Media Group announced the closure, with international editorial coverage to continue from London, Abu Dhabi, Singapore, and Beijing. Shows like "Inside India" and "The China...
summary.zh: CNBC已将其香港办公室关闭，并作为“节目和制作重组”的一部分取消了多个日常节目。其所有者Versant Media Group宣布了此次关闭，国际编辑报道将继续由伦敦、阿布扎比、新加坡和北京负责。包括《印度内幕》和《中国连接》在内的节目已被取消。

body.en: CNBC has become the latest media outlet to pull back from Hong Kong, with owner Versant Media Group closing its local office as part of “programming and production restructuring,” according to Bloomberg. CNBC. Photo: CNBC. The US broadcaster said that several daily shows, including Inside India, The China Connection , and Europe Early Edition , have been axed, while CNBC Meets and Built for Billions will also reportedly come to an end. “International editorial coverage will continue to be led from London, Abu Dhabi, Singapore and Beijing,” a spokesperson said. “As part of these programming and production changes, the Hong Kong bureau will close, while editorial coverage of Hong Kong and the wider region will continue as part of our Asia reporting.” CNBC saw over a dozen layoffs this year after media conglomerate Comcast spun off the business news channel and its sister network MS NOW – formerly MSNBC – into a new company called Versant Media Group. Media groups exit city Although long seen as a regional media hub, several international news operations have scaled back their operations in Hong Kong or left the city entirely in recent years. This April, Yahoo began to scale back its local presence after 27 years, with most full-time news staff laid off . In 2024, the Wall Street Journal relocated its Asia headquarters from Hong Kong to Singapore, while US-backed Radio Free Asia shuttered in Hong Kong citing the implementation of the security law. The New York Times headquarters in New York. File photo: HKFP/Tom Grundy. In 2020, the New York Times shifted a third of its Hong Kong staff to South Korea also citing security law concerns. Meanwhile, Bloomberg, the Financial Times and the Associated Press are among the foreign outlets that have seen staff face visa difficulties. Hong Kong has plummeted in international press freedom indices since the onset of the 2020 and 2024 security laws . Watchdogs cite the arrest and jailing of journalists , raids on newsrooms and the closure of around 10 media outlets including Apple Daily , Stand News and Citizen News . Over 1,000 journalists have lost their jobs, whilst many have emigrated . Meanwhile, the city’s government-funded broadcaster RTHK has adopted new editorial guidelines , purged its archives and axed news and satirical shows. See also: Explainer: Hong Kong’s press freedom under the national security law In 2022, Chief Executive John Lee said press freedom was “in the pocket” of Hongkongers but “nobody is above the law.” Although he has told the press to “ tell a good Hong Kong story ,” government departments have been reluctant to respond to story pitches .
body.zh: 据彭博社报道，CNBC 成为最新一家从香港撤出的媒体，其母公司 Versant Media Group 关闭了其在香港的办事处，作为“节目和制作重组”的一部分。美国全国广播公司财经频道。照片：CNBC。这家美国广播公司表示，包括《Inside India》、《The China Connection》和《Europe Early Edition》在内的几档每日节目已被取消，而 CNBC Meets 和Built for Billions 也据报道也将结束。一位发言人表示：“国际社论报道将继续由伦敦、阿布扎比、新加坡和北京主导。” “作为这些节目和制作变化的一部分，香港分社将关闭，而对香港和更广泛地区的社论报道将继续作为我们亚洲报道的一部分。”在媒体集团 Comcast 将商业新闻频道及其姐妹网络 MS NOW（前身为 MSNBC）分拆成一家名为 Versant Media Group 的新公司后，CNBC 今年裁员了十几人。媒体集团退出香港 尽管香港长期以来被视为区域媒体中心，但一些国际新闻机构近年来已缩减在香港的业务或完全离开香港。今年 4 月，雅虎在成立 27 年后开始缩减其在当地的业务，大部分全职新闻人员被解雇。 2024年，《华尔街日报》将其亚洲总部从香港迁至新加坡，而美国支持的自由亚洲电台则以实施国安法为由关闭了香港。 《纽约时报》总部位于纽约。资料照片：HKFP/Tom Grundy。 2020年，《纽约时报》也以安全法问题为由，将三分之一的香港员工调往韩国。与此同时，彭博社、金融时报和美联社等外国媒体的员工都面临签证困难。自2020年和2024年国安法实施以来，香港的国际新闻自由指数大幅下降。监管机构称逮捕和监禁记者、突击搜查新闻编辑室以及关闭包括《苹果日报》、《立场新闻》和《公民新闻》在内的约 10 家媒体机构。超过 1,000 名记者失业，许多人移居国外。与此同时，香港政府资助的广播公司香港电台采用了新的编辑指南，清理了档案并砍掉了新闻和讽刺节目。另请参阅：解释：国家安全法下香港的新闻自由 2022 年，行政长官李家超表示，新闻自由“在香港人的口袋里”，但“没有人可以凌驾于法律之上”。尽管他告诉媒体要“讲好香港故事”，但政府部门却不愿对故事的说法做出回应。

reflection.en: As CNBC restructures its global presence, closing its Hong Kong bureau, it prompts reflection on how media navigates changing landscapes. The Apostle Paul encourages believers to focus their minds on whatever is true, noble, right, pure, lovely, admirable, excellent, or praiseworthy. In times of corporate change and shifting media focus, this ancient wisdom...
reflection.zh: 随着CNBC重组其全球业务并关闭香港办事处，这促使人们反思媒体如何在不断变化的环境中发展。使徒保罗鼓励信徒要思念那真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事，或是有德，或是赞美的。在企业变革和媒体焦点转移的时代，这古老的智慧呼唤着分辨力和对有价值内容的承诺。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Customer service a major ruse as phone scam losses up 56% in first half of year
title.zh: 冒充客服成主要骗局手段 香港今年上半年电话诈骗损失增加56%

summary.en: Hong Kong police reported that impersonating customer service staff is the most prevalent tactic used by phone scammers. In the first half of 2026, these frauds increased by 45% year-on-year, reaching 4,830 cases, contributing to an overall 56% rise in phone scam losses during the same period, despite a slight overall...
summary.zh: 香港警方表示，冒充客服是电话诈骗分子最常用的手段。2026年上半年，此类诈骗案件同比激增45%，达到4,830起，导致同期电话诈骗损失总额上升56%，尽管总体欺诈案件略有下降。

body.en: Impersonating customer service staff is the “most rampant tactic” used by phone scammers, Hong Kong police have said, with the number of such frauds rising 45 per cent year on year in the first half of 2026 to 4,830 cases amid an overall decline in deception crimes. Superintendent Kwok Ching-yee of the Commercial Crime Bureau said police received a total of 20,613 deception cases in the first half of this year, representing a slight drop of 0.7 per cent compared with the same period last...
body.zh: 香港警方表示，冒充客户服务人员是电话诈骗者使用的“最猖獗的策略”，在诈骗犯罪整体下降的情况下，2026年上半年此类诈骗案件数量同比上升45%至4,830起。商业罪案调查科警司郭正仪表示，今年上半年警方共接获20,613宗诈骗案件，较去年同期微跌0.7%。

reflection.en: The alarming rise in phone scam losses, particularly those involving impersonation, underscores the persistent allure of illicit financial gain. The love of money, as the Apostle Paul warns, can indeed be a root of all kinds of evil, leading individuals to prey on others through deceit. May we remain vigilant against such schemes and uphold integrity in our...
reflection.zh: 电话诈骗损失的惊人增长，尤其是涉及冒充身份的骗局，凸显了非法金融收益的诱惑力。正如使徒保罗所警告的，贪财是万恶之根，它会驱使人们通过欺骗来侵害他人。愿我们警惕此类骗局，并在交易中坚守诚信。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Suspect deemed unfit to stand trial for aiding deadly hold-up in Hong Kong
title.zh: 疑涉30年前致命劫案男子被裁定不適合受審

summary.en: A mainland Chinese man, Wen Wenye (61), has been deemed unfit to stand trial for alleged involvement in a deadly shooting during a botched robbery in Hong Kong three decades ago. A High Court jury ruled he could not be held criminally liable due to a cognitive impairment caused by lung cancer, which prevents him from...
summary.zh: 一名内地男子文文也（61歲）因涉嫌參與30年前香港一宗劫案槍擊案，但因肺癌引致的認知障礙，被裁定不適合受審。高等法院陪審團裁定，他因無法理解法律程序及指示其辯護律師，故不需為謀殺及企圖搶劫罪負責。

body.en: A mainland Chinese man has been deemed unfit to stand trial for his alleged involvement in a deadly shooting during a botched robbery in Hong Kong three decades ago, after he was diagnosed with a cognitive impairment caused by lung cancer. A High Court jury of four men and three women ruled on Friday that Shenzhen resident Wen Wenye, 61, could not be held criminally liable for murder and attempted robbery because he was unable to understand the legal proceedings and give instructions to his...
body.zh: 一名中国大陆男子因涉嫌参与三十年前香港一次拙劣抢劫中的致命枪击事件而被认为不适合受审，此前他被诊断出患有肺癌引起的认知障碍。由四男三女组成的高等法院陪审团周五裁定，61岁的深圳居民文文业不能因谋杀和抢劫未遂而承担刑事责任，因为他无法理解法律程序，也无法向他的家人发出指示。

reflection.en: This case brings to light the profound impact of illness on an individual's ability to participate in the justice system. When illness renders someone unable to defend themselves or even understand the proceedings, the principle of speaking for the voiceless becomes paramount. It reminds us to consider the vulnerable, even within the framework of law.
reflection.zh: 此案凸顯了疾病對個人參與司法程序的深遠影響。當疾病使人無法為自己辯護，甚至無法理解訴訟程序時，「為不能發聲者說話」的原則變得至關重要。這提醒我們，即使在法律框架內，也要顧及弱勢群體。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: City University of Hong Kong disciplines students over orientation camp misconduct
title.zh: 香港城市大学因迎新营不当行为处分学生

summary.en: City University of Hong Kong has disciplined students following an orientation event with a disco theme where inappropriate conduct occurred, including a half-naked man carrying a woman in a bra and shorts. This action was taken two days after the university stated its 'zero tolerance' policy for such behavior. All...
summary.zh: 香港城市大学已就一次以迪斯科为主题的迎新活动中的不当行为处分了学生。在该活动中，一名半裸男子抱着一名仅穿着胸罩和短裤的女子。此前两天，该大学曾表示对不当行为“零容忍”。所有涉事学生均承认错误，并向大学正式道歉，接受了纪律处分。

body.en: City University of Hong Kong has disciplined students over an orientation event with a disco theme in which a half-naked man was seen carrying a woman wearing only a bra and shorts, two days after the institution said it had “zero tolerance” for improper conduct. The institution said on Friday that all students involved in the orientation camp incident on August 27 had admitted their mistakes, formally apologised to the university and accepted disciplinary action. “The University’s Student...
body.zh: 香港城市大学在一场迪斯科主题的迎新活动中对学生进行了纪律处分，活动中一名半裸男子抱着一名只穿着胸罩和短裤的女子，两天前该校表示对不当行为“零容忍”。该校周五表示，所有参与8月27日迎新营事件的学生均已承认错误，向校方正式道歉并接受纪律处分。 “大学的学生...

reflection.en: Universities often grapple with setting boundaries for student behavior, especially during orientation events designed to foster community. The disciplinary action taken by City University of Hong Kong underscores the importance of accountability, reminding students that their actions have consequences and that ethical conduct is expected, even in social...
reflection.zh: 大学常常在学生行为的界限设定上挣扎，尤其是在旨在促进社群联系的迎新活动中。香港城市大学采取的纪律处分行动，强调了问责制的重要性，提醒学生他们的行为会产生后果，并且即使在社交场合也应遵守道德规范。这种情况需要平衡促进学生联谊与维护机构价值观。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: M+ Museum abruptly axes performance by award-winning local musician Wong Hin-yan
title.zh: M+博物馆突然取消获奖本地音乐人黄衍仁的演出

summary.en: Award-winning Hong Kong singer-songwriter Wong Hin-yan's scheduled performance at the M+ Museum was abruptly cancelled without a clear explanation, with the museum citing a "programme change."
summary.zh: 获奖的香港唱作人黄衍仁在M+博物馆的演出被突然取消，且未有明确解释，博物馆方面仅表示是“节目变更”。

body.en: Award-winning Hong Kong singer-songwriter Wong Hin-yan has become the latest artist in the city to have a scheduled performance abruptly cancelled without a clear explanation. A poster promoting Hong Kong singer-songwriter Wong Hin-yan’s performance at the M+ Museum on September 4, 2026. Photo: Wong Hin-yan, via Instagram. The M+ Museum announced on Thursday night that Wong’s performance at the “M+ at Night: Sonic Phantoms” event had been called off – one day before the musician was scheduled to play alongside acclaimed jazz double bassist Nelson Fung. M+ said in a social media post that the cancellation was due to a “programme change,” without elaborating further. Two DJ sets will be performed in Wong’s stead on Friday, the museum added. “M+ at Night: Sonic Phantoms” is an event series spanning four dates from September to December. The original line-up, featuring Wong, was announced in July. Wong said on Instagram on Thursday night that he would be “unable” to perform the following evening. “It is what it is,” he wrote, also without elaborating further. The musician thanked the museum’s operator, the West Kowloon Cultural District Authority, for its “continued support,” and apologised to fans who wished to see him perform. “I will absolutely continue to sing and write songs,” Wong added. “Hope to see you again soon!” Wong was involved in the “post-80s” generation of activists who opposed the demolition of the historic Queen’s Pier and clock tower in 2006, according to an Infrasonica profile. He went on to participate in protests against the high-speed rail link to China and performed at a solidarity concert for jailed activists in 2017 . ‘Irresistible force’ Under M+’s post on Thursday announcing the change, some fans expressed dissatisfaction with the museum’s last-minute and unexplained cancellation. The M+ museum at the West Kowloon Cultural District, on September 9, 2025. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “I only wanted to come because of Wong Hin-yan and Nelson Fung. This ‘programme change’ one day before the show… is either a result of a very strong irresistible force or a scam by your team,” one user wrote in Chinese. M+ apologised for the abrupt change in a follow-up comment on Friday, offering refunds for ticket-holders who no longer wished to attend the event. HKFP has reached out to the West Kowloon Cultural District Authority for comment. Wong was recognised by Taiwan’s Golden Horse Awards – the most prestigious prize for Chinese-language films – and the Hong Kong Film Awards in 2022 for the score he composed for the film The Narrow Road . He joins a growing list of performers who have had events abruptly cancelled by venues or organisers in recent years, often without a...
body.zh: 屡获殊荣的香港创作型歌手黄显欣成为香港最新一位原定演出在没有明确解释的情况下突然取消的艺人。 2026 年 9 月 4 日，宣传香港创作歌手黄显恩在 M+ 博物馆演出的海报。照片：黄显恩，来自 Instagram。 M+博物馆于周四晚间宣布，黄在“M+之夜：声波幻影”活动中的演出已被取消，而就在这位音乐家原定与著名爵士低音贝斯手尼尔森·冯（Nelson Fung）一起演出的前一天。 M+在社交媒体帖子中表示，取消是由于“节目变更”，但没有进一步说明。博物馆补充说，周五将有两场 DJ 表演代替黄的表演。 “M+之夜：幻影索尼克”是一个横跨九月至十二月四个日期的活动系列。以黄为主角的最初阵容于七月公布。周四晚上，黄在 Instagram 上表示，他将“无法”在第二天晚上表演。 “事情就是这样，”他写道，但也没有进一步说明。这位音乐家感谢博物馆的运营商西九文化区管理局的“持续支持”，并向希望看到他表演的歌迷道歉。 “我绝对会继续唱歌和写歌，”黄补充道。 “希望很快能再次见到你！”根据 Infrasonica 的简介，黄参与了 2006 年反对拆除历史悠久的皇后码头和钟楼的“80 后”一代活动人士。他随后参加了针对中国高铁建设的抗议活动，并于 2017 年为被监禁的活动人士举办的声援音乐会上表演。 “不可抗拒的力量” 在M+周四宣布这一变化的帖子下，一些粉丝对博物馆最后一刻且不明原因的取消表示不满。西九龙文化区的 M+ 博物馆，2025 年 9 月 9 日。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 “我只是因为黄显恩和冯国强才来的。演出前一天的‘节目变更’……要么是强大的不可抗拒力量的结果，要么是你们团队的骗局，”一位用户用中文写道。 M+在周五的后续评论中对突然改变表示歉意，并为不再希望参加活动的持票人提供退款。 HKFP已联系西九文化区管理局征求意见。黄先生因为电影《窄路》创作的配乐获得了台湾金马奖（华语电影最负盛名的奖项）和 2022 年香港电影金像奖的认可。近年来，越来越多的表演者的活动被场地或组织者突然取消，而且往往没有...

reflection.en: When explanations are withheld, the space left behind is often filled with speculation and uncertainty. The power of words, or their absence, can create ripples of confusion and unease, impacting artists and audiences alike. Proverbs 18:21 reminds us that words carry immense weight, capable of causing deep wounds or bringing life.
reflection.zh: 当解释被省略时，留下的空间常常被猜测和不确定性所填满。言语的力量，或其缺失，会激起困惑和不安的涟漪，影响艺术家和观众。箴言18:21提醒我们，言语具有巨大的力量，能够造成深刻的创伤，也能带来生命。

verse.textEn: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
verse.textZh: 生死在舌头的权下；喜爱它的，必吃它所结的果子。

title.en: John Lee urges banks to finance city’s tech growth, expand offshore yuan business
title.zh: 李家超敦促银行支持本港科技增长，拓展离岸人民币业务

summary.en: Hong Kong's leader has urged the banking sector to support financing the city’s creation of a new economic engine in innovation and technology (I&T) while expanding offshore yuan business, a key area for aligning with national strategies. Speaking at the Hong Kong Association of Banks’ Distinguished Speaker Luncheon...
summary.zh: 香港领导人敦促银行业支持为本港创新科技（I&T）这一新的经济引擎提供融资，并拓展离岸人民币业务，这是与国家战略接轨的关键领域。在周五的香港银行家协会杰出讲者午宴上，行政长官李家超呼吁政府与银行业在四个领域加强合作，包括拓展离岸人民币业务、创新科技（I&T）融资、绿色金融及金融基建。

body.en: Hong Kong’s leader has urged the banking sector to support financing the city’s creation of a new economic engine in innovation and technology (I&T) while expanding offshore yuan business, a key area for aligning with national strategies. Speaking at the Hong Kong Association of Banks’ Distinguished Speaker Luncheon on Friday, Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu called for closer partnership between the government and banking sector in four areas. They comprise expanding offshore renminbi business,...
body.zh: 香港领导人敦促银行业支持为香港打造创新科技新经济引擎提供融资，同时扩大离岸人民币业务，这是与国家战略保持一致的关键领域。行政长官李家超周五在香港银行公会的杰出演讲者午餐会上发表讲话，呼吁政府与银行业在四个领​​域建立更紧密的伙伴关系。它们包括扩大离岸人民币业务、...

reflection.en: Hong Kong's Chief Executive is calling for a strategic partnership between government and banks to foster innovation and technology. This endeavor, like all human work, finds its ultimate purpose and success when committed to Yahweh. Proverbs 16:3 reminds us that when we commit our plans and works to Yahweh, they will be established and succeed according to...
reflection.zh: 香港行政长官呼吁政府与银行建立战略伙伴关系，以促进创新和科技发展。这项事业，如同所有人类的工作一样，当将其托付给雅伟时，才能找到其最终的目的和成功。箴言16:3提醒我们，当我们把计划和工作交托给主时，它们就必得以建立和成功，成就祂的旨意。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: HK Disneyland Hotel to close for facelift from Oct 12
title.zh: 香港迪士尼乐园酒店将从10月12日起关闭进行翻新

summary.en: Hong Kong Disneyland Hotel is scheduled to close for renovations starting October 12. The hotel, which opened over two decades ago with 400 rooms and two restaurants, aims to enhance visitor experience by focusing on more immersive and storytelling elements, acknowledging changing tourist preferences.
summary.zh: 香港迪士尼乐园酒店定于10月12日起关闭进行翻新。该酒店拥有400间客房和两间餐厅，于乐园开放时开业至今已有二十多年，此次翻新旨在通过加强故事性和沉浸式体验来提升游客体验，以适应不断变化的游客偏好。

body.en: Hong Kong Disneyland Hotel will be closed starting from October 12 for refurbishments aimed at better serving visitors’ needs. The resort hotel, which started checking in guests just over two decades ago when the theme park opened, offers 400 rooms and two restaurants. Anita Lai, vice president of communications and public affairs, said on Friday that the hotel would retain its “classic storytelling charm” following the facelift. “We have noticed that many tourists’ demands and preferences have changed. In particular, they look for a more immersive experience,” she said. “Therefore, in our upgrade plan, we will place greater emphasis on more storytelling and immersive experiences as well as further enhance our quality service.” Renovation work has been underway at the west wing of the hotel since June. While the Victorian-style resort hotel is undergoing comprehensive enhancements, the other two establishments in the theme park – Disney Explorers Lodge and Disney’s Hollywood Hotel – will remain open. Food and beverage director Manfred Wong said nearly 150,000 food items that were part of themed-dining offers launched in conjunction with the Pixar Summer Fest, which ended in August, were snapped up by visitors. The park's Plaza Inn restaurant, which reopened in June, has served more than 40,000 visitors so far. The theme park has also stepped up efforts to offer more halal fare, Wong said, including frozen lollipops and two kinds of Halloween-exclusive barbecue platters. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 香港迪士尼乐园酒店将于10月12日起暂停营业，以进行翻新工程，以更好地满足游客的需求。这家度假酒店于二十多年前主题公园开业时开始接待客人，拥有 400 间客房和两家餐厅。传讯及公共事务副总裁黎安妮塔 (Anita Lai) 周五表示，酒店在整修后将保留其“经典讲故事的魅力”。 “我们注意到许多游客的需求和偏好发生了变化。特别是，他们寻求更加身临其境的体验，”她说。 “因此，在我们的升级计划中，我们将更加注重更多的故事性和沉浸式体验，并进一步提升我们的优质服务。”自六月以来，酒店西翼的装修工程一直在进行。虽然维多利亚风格的度假酒店正在进行全面改造，但主题公园内的另外两家酒店——迪士尼探索家度假酒店和迪士尼好莱坞酒店——将继续营业。餐饮总监 Manfred Wong 表示，与 8 月结束的皮克斯夏季音乐节同期推出的主题餐饮优惠中，有近 15 万种食品被游客抢购一空。公园内的 Plaza Inn 餐厅于 6 月重新开业，迄今已为超过 40,000 名游客提供服务。黄说，主题公园还加大力度提供更多清真食品，包括冷冻棒棒糖和两种万圣节专属烧烤拼盘。谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: The Hong Kong Disneyland Hotel is closing for a facelift, a significant undertaking to refresh its offerings and better meet the evolving expectations of its guests. This effort to improve and adapt, even in a place designed for leisure, speaks to the value of diligent work and thoughtful service in all endeavors. As we see this hotel invest in its future,...
reflection.zh: 香港迪士尼乐园酒店将进行翻新，这是一项重要的举措，旨在更新其设施并更好地满足游客不断变化的需求。这种为改进和适应所做的努力，即使是在一个以休闲为目的的地方，也体现了在所有事业中勤奋工作和周到服务的价值。...

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: 3 women charged over play area brawl granted bail, banned from mall
title.zh: 女子在商场游乐区打斗后获准保释，禁止进入商场

summary.en: Three women arrested for a brawl in a Kwun Tong shopping centre's play area last week have been granted bail after appearing in court. The defendants, aged 68, 34, and 34, were charged with fighting in a public place, with one facing an additional assault charge for allegedly striking a child. They were granted...
summary.zh: 上周在观塘一商场游乐区发生打斗的三名女子在出庭后获准保释。被告年龄分别为68岁、34岁和34岁，被控在公众场所打斗，其中一人还面临一项袭击指控，涉嫌殴打一名儿童。她们每人获准以5000港元保释，并被禁止进入该商场。

body.en: Three women arrested over an altercation in the play area of a Kwun Tong shopping centre last week have been granted bail after appearing in court. Kwun Tong Magistrates’ Courts. Photo: GovHK. The defendants – 68-year-old Leung Lai-ha, her 34-year-old daughter Ng Ka-wun, and 34-year-old Xu Yang – made their first appearance at Kwun Tong Magistrates’ Courts on Thursday. The trio were granted HK$5,000 bail each and banned from entering APM mall, where the alleged confrontation took place. All three were charged with fighting in a public place, with Leung facing an additional charge of common assault for allegedly striking Xu’s five-year-old daughter. Footage of the fight was shared widely online last week . No plea was taken from the defendants, and Acting Principal Magistrate Li Chi-ho adjourned the case to November 5.
body.zh: 上周，三名因在观塘购物中心游乐场发生口角而被捕的女子出庭后获准保释。观塘裁判法院。照片：香港政府一站通。被告——68岁的梁丽霞、34岁的女儿吴家媛和34岁的徐洋——周四首次在观塘裁判法院出庭。三人每人获得 5,000 港元保释，并被禁止进入发生冲突的 APM 商场。三人均被指控在公共场所打架，梁因涉嫌殴打徐五岁的女儿而面临另一项普通袭击罪的指控。上周，这场打斗的视频在网上广泛传播。被告没有提出答辩，署理首席裁判官李志豪将案件押后至11月5日审理。

reflection.en: Words and actions, especially when fueled by anger, can have immediate and serious consequences, as seen in the public altercation at the Kwun Tong shopping centre. Proverbs 18:21 reminds us that the tongue has the power of life and death, urging us to consider the impact of our interactions and to seek peaceful resolutions rather than escalating conflict.
reflection.zh: 言语和行为，尤其是在愤怒的驱使下，会产生直接而严重的后果，正如在观塘购物中心发生的公众争执中所见。箴言18:21提醒我们，舌头有死亡和生命的权柄，敦促我们思考互动的后果，并寻求和平解决，而不是加剧冲突。

verse.textEn: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
verse.textZh: 生死在舌头的权下；喜爱它的，必吃它所结的果子。

title.en: Lee says banks have key role to play in five-year plan
title.zh: 李称银行将在五年计划中发挥关键作用

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee has identified the banking sector as a vital partner in Hong Kong's strategy to integrate with and contribute to national development. He stressed the sector's importance for the city's financial resilience and long-term prosperity, particularly as Hong Kong prepares to launch its first...
summary.zh: 香港特首李家超将银行业视为香港融入国家发展并为其做出贡献战略中的关键伙伴。他强调了该行业对城市金融韧性和长期繁荣的重要性，特别是随着香港本月将推出其首个五年计划，该计划旨在利用香港作为中国内地与全球市场之间“超级联系人”的角色。

body.en: Chief Executive John Lee on Friday described the banking sector as a crucial partner for Hong Kong in its efforts to better integrate into and serve the country's development. Speaking at an Association of Banks event, he said the organisation has long been vital to the city's financial resilience and long-term prosperity. Noting that Hong Kong is set to unveil its first five-year plan this month, Lee emphasised that the sector forms a crucial part of it. “The plan will leverage Hong Kong's unparalleled roles as a super connector and super value-adder, linking mainland capital and enterprises with global markets, while bringing in international capital, technology and talent,” he said. “The banking sector is our crucial partner in realising this strategic vision, bringing it to our dynamic life." Lee called for continued cooperation, highlighting four key areas that the government and the banking sector can work together on: expanding the offshore renminbi business and deepening financial connectivity; empowering the real economy and encouraging innovation and technology through finance; developing trading in commodities; and strengthening financial security and market integrity. He also urged the banking sector to play an active role in driving the development of the Northern Metropolis. “I'm confident that the association and the banking sector in general will play an instrumental role in financing large-scale infrastructure projects in the Northern Metropolis, unlocking opportunities created by this boundless new economic engine for Hong Kong and the Greater Bay Area.” Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 行政长官李家超周五表示，银行业是香港更好地融入和服务国家发展的重要合作伙伴。他在银行协会活动上发表讲话时表示，该组织长期以来对该市的金融弹性和长期繁荣至关重要。李指出，香港将于本月公布第一个五年计划，并强调该行业是其中的重要组成部分。他说：“该计划将利用香港作为超级联系人和超级增值者的无与伦比的作用，将内地资本和企业与全球市场联系起来，同时引入国际资本、技术和人才。” “银行业是我们实现这一战略愿景的重要合作伙伴，并将其带入我们充满活力的生活。”李克强呼吁继续合作，并强调政府和银行业可以在四个关键领域合作：扩大离岸人民币业务，深化金融互联互通；通过金融赋能实体经济，鼓励创新科技；发展商品贸易；加强金融安全和市场诚信。他还敦促银行业在推动北方都市发展中发挥积极作用。 “我相信协会和整个银行业将在为北方都市的大型基建项目融资方面发挥重要作用，为香港和大湾区释放这个无限的新经济引擎所创造的机遇。”谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: As Hong Kong embarks on its new five-year plan, Chief Executive John Lee highlights the banking sector's crucial role. This endeavor calls to mind the wisdom of committing our plans and work to a higher purpose. May leaders and citizens alike seek to align their efforts with principles that foster true resilience and long-term prosperity, trusting in Yahweh...
reflection.zh: 随着香港开启其新的五年计划，行政长官李家超强调了银行业的重要作用。这一举措令人想起将我们的计划和工作托付于更高目的的智慧。愿领导者和市民都能寻求将他们的努力与促进真正韧性和长期繁荣的原则相结合，并信靠雅伟指引他们的道路。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Hong Kong proposes grade 2 heritage status for Kennedy Town selfie spot sea wall
title.zh: 香港建议将西环海滨网红打卡点海堤列为二级历史建筑

summary.en: A sea wall on Kennedy Town's waterfront, a popular spot for selfies, is being proposed for Grade 2 historic structure status by Hong Kong authorities. Experts suggest that effective storytelling will be crucial to bringing the site's heritage to life.
summary.zh: 香港当局建议将西环海滨一个受欢迎的自拍景点海堤列为二级历史建筑。专家认为，富有创意的故事讲述对于活化该遗址的文化遗产至关重要。

body.en: A sea wall at a popular selfie spot on Kennedy Town’s waterfront could soon gain grade two status after authorities proposed listing it as a historic structure, although experts say creative storytelling will be key to bringing the site’s heritage to life. According to a document from the Antiquities and Monuments Office, the Historic Buildings Assessment Panel recommended that the New Praya sea wall be given grade two status following an assessment. Subject to members’ endorsement, the office...
body.zh: 坚尼地城海滨一处颇受欢迎的自拍景点的海堤在当局提议将其列为历史建筑后，可能很快就会获得二级地位，不过专家表示，创造性的故事讲述将是让该地点的遗产栩栩如生的关键。根据古物古迹办事处的一份文件，历史建筑评估小组在评估后建议将新海旁海堤评定为二级。经会员认可后，办公室...

reflection.en: This proposal to recognize the Kennedy Town sea wall as a historic structure reminds us of the importance of preserving and sharing our past. Psalm 78:4 calls us to tell the next generation about God's deeds and wonders, ensuring that history and its lessons are not forgotten. May we be inspired to find creative ways to connect with and pass on the stories...
reflection.zh: 将西环海堤列为历史建筑的建议，提醒我们保存和分享历史的重要性。诗篇78:4呼吁我们向下一代讲述雅伟的作为和奇事，确保历史及其教训不被遗忘。 愿我们从中获得启发，以创新的方式连接和传承地方与人物的故事，使历史遗产丰富后人的生命。

verse.textEn: We will not hide them from their descendants; we will tell the next generation the praiseworthy deeds of Yahweh, his power, and the wonders he has done.
verse.textZh: 我们不将这些事向他们的子孙隐瞒，要将雅伟的美德和他的能力，并他奇妙的作为，述说给后代听。

title.en: Hong Kong police arrest 21 men, including private tutor, for sharing indecent images of children
title.zh: 香港警方逮捕21名男子，包括一名私人教师，因分享儿童不雅图片

summary.en: Hong Kong police have arrested 21 men, aged 19 to 47, including a private tutor, for allegedly producing indecent images of children and sharing them on social media platforms. The men were part of a social media group used to share images obtained through methods like up-skirting. Over 7,200 photos and 120 videos...
summary.zh: 香港警方逮捕了21名男子，年龄在19至47岁之间，其中包括一名私人教师，他们涉嫌制作儿童不雅图片并在社交媒体平台上分享。这些男子属于一个社交媒体群组，用于分享通过偷拍等方式获取的图片。在行动中，警方从电子设备中查获了超过7200张照片和120个视频。

body.en: Hong Kong police have arrested 21 men, including a private tutor, for allegedly producing indecent images of children and sharing them on social media platforms. Hong Kong Police Force. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Police said on Thursday that the men, aged 19 to 47, were members of a social media group that they used to share indecent images of children, produced by up-skirting and other clandestine methods, for others to browse and download. Over 7,200 photos and 120 videos were found on electronic devices such as smartphones, tablets, computers, and external hard drives seized during the police operation – codenamed Bravestrike – conducted this week, authorities said. Some of the images are believed to have been secretly filmed in public places across the city, said Superintendent Wong Yick-lung of the force’s Kowloon East regional crime headquarters. These included shopping malls, escalators, MTR stations, and other means of public transportation. “Even more jarringly, a private tutor photographed a female student’s intimate parts during their lessons and later shared the images with other members of the online platform,” Wong told a press conference in Cantonese. Viewers are ‘accomplices’ Among the 21 men, eight were arrested on suspicion of possessing child pornography, while the remaining 13 are suspected of unlawfully recording intimate parts and publishing intimate images without consent. The arrestees have been granted bail pending investigation and have to report to the police later this month. Police also said that those who view and subscribe to social media groups that share indecent images of children are effectively “accomplices,” warning that they can be prosecuted if they are found to have encouraged or instructed others to film or upload the material. Police are continuing to investigate the number of victims and their ages, and will trace the indecent material to its source through Interpol’s International Child Sexual Exploitation database. People cross the street in Hong Kong. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Authorities are also seeking the removal of the social media group and the online images, police added. Parents urged to be vigilant Superintendent Wong urged parents to pay extra attention to their children for signs of sexual abuse if they have hired private tutors, who often get to spend time alone with their students. He further advised parents to ask prospective tutors to apply for a Sexual Conviction Record Check from the police. Social media groups that share voyeuristic images of women – often filmed secretly and published without their consent – have become rampant throughout East Asia, including in Hong Kong. Last year, police arrested 10 linked to an online platform selling upskirt...
body.zh: 香港警方逮捕了 21 名男子，其中包括一名私人导师，罪名是涉嫌制作儿童不雅图片并在社交媒体平台上分享。香港警队。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。警方周四表示，这些年龄在 19 岁至 47 岁之间的男子是一个社交媒体群组的成员，他们在该群组中分享通过裙底和其他秘密方法制作的儿童不雅图片，供其他人浏览和下载。当局称，警方在本周代号为 Bravestrike 的行动中查获了智能手机、平板电脑、电脑和外部硬盘等电子设备，并在其中发现了超过 7,200 张照片和 120 个视频。警队东九龙总区警司黄益龙表示，相信其中一些画面是在全市公众地方秘密拍摄的。其中包括购物中心、自动扶梯、地铁站和其他公共交通工具。 “更令人震惊的是，一名私人导师在上课时拍摄了一名女学生的私密部位，随后将这些照片分享给了在线平台的其他成员，”黄在一场新闻发布会上用粤语说道。观众是“同谋” 21名男子中，8人因涉嫌持有儿童色情物品被捕，其余13人涉嫌非法录制私密部位、未经同意发布私密图片。被捕人士已获准保释候查，并须于本月晚些时候向警方报到。警方还表示，那些查看和订阅分享儿童不雅图片的社交媒体群组的人实际上是“同谋”，并警告说，如果发现他们鼓励或指示他人拍摄或上传这些材料，他们可能会被起诉。警方正在继续调查受害者的人数和年龄，并将通过国际刑警组织的国际儿童性剥削数据库追查不雅材料的来源。人们在香港过马路。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。警方补充说，当局还在寻求删除该社交媒体群组和在线图像。家长们要保持警惕 黄警司敦促家长们如果聘请了私人家教，要特别注意孩子是否有性虐待的迹象，因为私人家教经常有时间与学生独处。他进一步建议家长要求未来的导师向警方申请性定罪记录检查。分享女性偷窥图像的社交媒体团体——通常是在未经她们同意的情况下秘密拍摄和发布的——在包括香港在内的整个东亚地区变得猖獗。去年，警方逮捕了 10 名与销售超短裙的在线平台有关的人……

reflection.en: The news of men arrested for sharing indecent images of children is deeply disturbing, revealing a profound betrayal of trust and a violation of the innocent. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute." This passage reminds us of our responsibility to protect the vulnerable,...
reflection.zh: 关于男子因分享儿童不雅图片被捕的新闻令人深感不安，这揭示了深刻的信任背叛和对无辜者的侵害。《箴言》31:8-9 呼吁我们“为不能自辩的开口，为所有困苦者伸张正义”。这段经文提醒我们有责任保护弱者，特别是儿童，免受剥削和伤害。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Cathay Pacific CEO backs rail-air integration for HK
title.zh: 国泰航空CEO支持陆空一体化以促进香港增长

summary.en: Cathay Pacific Airways CEO Ronald Lam believes high-speed rail and air travel can complement each other, rather than compete, to foster Hong Kong's long-term economic development. He envisions intermodal transport as a significant opportunity for both mainland and international travelers connecting through Hong Kong.
summary.zh: 国泰航空行政总裁林绍波认为，高铁和航空旅行可以相互补充而非相互竞争，以促进香港的长期经济发展。他设想多式联运具有巨大潜力，无论是内地旅客乘坐高铁来港转乘国际航班，还是国际旅客飞抵香港后再乘坐高铁前往其他目的地。

body.en: Cathay Pacific Airways chief executive Ronald Lam says high-speed rail and air travel are not a zero-sum game and that the two sectors should support each other to drive Hong Kong's long-term growth. Speaking on RTHK's "On Broadcast Drive" programme, he said air-rail integration has huge potential. "High-speed rail competes with aviation to some extent, but it also complements it – so it's not a zero‑sum game," Lam said. "I think air‑rail intermodal transport has huge potential – whether it's mainland passengers taking the high‑speed rail to Hong Kong and then connecting to an international flight, or international travellers flying into Hong Kong and then taking the high‑speed rail to different cities on the mainland. "I believe this is the direction we should be moving towards in the future." On the airline's future development, Lam said Cathay Pacific is on a growth drive as it plans to expand its network from 100 to 150 destinations over the next decade, targeting new markets in the Middle East, Central Asia, Africa and South America. He said the new routes might not turn a profit in the first year or two – but called them good long‑term investments for the business sector and Hong Kong. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 国泰航空行政总裁林绍波表示，高铁和航空旅行并非零和游戏，两个行业应相互支持，推动香港的长期增长。他在香港电台的《On Broadcast Drive》节目中表示，空铁融合潜力巨大。林说：“高铁在某种程度上与航空竞争，但同时也是航空业的补充，因此这不是一场零和游戏。” “我认为空铁联运潜力巨大，无论是内地旅客乘坐高铁到香港，然后转乘国际航班，还是国际旅客飞往香港，然后乘坐高铁前往内地不同城市。我相信这就是我们未来应该迈向的方向。”谈及国泰航空的未来发展，林郑月娥表示，国泰航空正处于增长动力，计划未来将航线网络从100个目的地扩展至150个十年来，瞄准了中东、中亚、非洲和南美洲的新市场。他表示，新航线可能不会在头一两年盈利，但称它们对商业领域和香港来说是良好的长期投资。

reflection.en: Ronald Lam sees potential in integrating different transport modes, viewing them not as rivals but as partners for growth. This perspective echoes the wisdom of committing our endeavors to divine guidance, trusting that Yahweh can bless and direct our plans for prosperity and development. When we align our work with a vision for shared benefit, we invite a...
reflection.zh: 林绍波看到了整合不同交通模式的潜力，认为它们是增长的伙伴而非竞争对手。这种观点呼应了将我们的努力托付给神圣指引的智慧，相信雅伟能够祝福和引导我们的计划以获得繁荣和发展。当我们以共享利益的愿景来规划工作时，我们就邀请了更深层次的成功。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Police arrest 269 people over technology scams
title.zh: 警方逮捕269人，涉及科技骗案

summary.en: Over the past two weeks, Hong Kong police have arrested 269 individuals in connection with 203 technology scam cases, resulting in total losses of HK$320 million. The scams primarily involved phone fraud, online shopping scams, and investment fraud. Authorities managed to intercept HK$2.5 million of the stolen funds,...
summary.zh: 在过去两周内，香港警方逮捕了269人，涉及203宗科技骗案，总损失达3.2亿港元。这些骗案主要包括电话诈骗、网络购物诈骗和投资诈骗。警方成功截获了250万港元的被盗资金，其中一宗电话诈骗案的单宗最大损失接近400万港元。

body.en: Police have arrested 269 people over the past two weeks in connection with 203 technology scam cases, involving total losses of HK$320 million. The 203 cases mainly involved phone scams, online shopping and investment fraud. Superintendent Kwok Ching-yee, from the Commercial Crime Bureau, said officers managed to intercept HK$2.5 million of the stolen funds. The largest single loss in a phone scam recorded in the first half of the year, she said, involved fraudsters impersonating customer service officers, tricking the victim out of nearly HK$4 million. “This victim received a call from scammers impersonating a staff member of Alipay customer service, who then falsely claimed the victim had purchased an insurance plan,” she said. “A phishing link was then subsequently sent through WhatsApp, and then the victim was instructed to deposit money to cancel the policy on the pretext that the full amount would be refunded.” “Ultimately, the victim made 13 bank transactions resulting in a loss of HK$4 million.” Kwok pointed out that Alipay logs official records within its app whenever its customer service team contacts a user. She advised the public to hang up and check the app first if they receive an unverified call. She added that scammers also frequently pose as customer service staff from SF Express. Kwok noted that the courier firm stopped making phone calls and sending SMS messages in April, switching exclusively to its official app for customer support. As part of the two-week operation, police also made arrests targeting a syndicate that used forged Hong Kong ID cards to open bank accounts for money laundering. Officers said the syndicate made over 200 attempts to open new accounts across three local banks and a stored-value payment operator from November to July, successfully setting up 42, 14 of which were used for money laundering. Police said the counterfeit IDs were created using AI image-editing software to swap faces on stolen or lost cards. The force also urged members of the public never to share selfie photographs with others. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 过去两周，警方共拘捕269人，涉及203起科技诈骗案件，涉案损失总额达3.2亿港元。 203起案件主要涉及电话诈骗、网络购物、投资诈骗等。商业罪案调查科警司郭正仪表示，警方成功截获了 250 万港元的被盗资金。她表示，今年上半年录得的最大单宗电话诈骗案涉及诈骗者冒充客服人员，骗取受害人近400万港元。她说：“这名受害者接到了冒充支付宝客服人员的诈骗电话，骗子随后谎称受害者购买了保险计划。” “随后通过 WhatsApp 发送了一个网络钓鱼链接，然后指示受害者存钱以取消保单，借口是全额退款。” “最终，受害人进行了13次银行交易，损失了400万港元。”郭指出，每当其客户服务团队联系用户时，支付宝都会在其应用程序中记录官方记录。她建议公众如果接到未经证实的电话，请先挂断电话并检查应用程序。她补充说，诈骗者还经常冒充顺丰速运客服人员。郭指出，这家快递公司在四月份停止打电话和发送短信，只使用其官方应用程序提供客户支持。作为为期两周行动的一部分，警方还逮捕了一个利用伪造的香港身份证开设银行账户进行洗钱的犯罪集团。官员们表示，从 11 月到 7 月，该犯罪团伙尝试在 3 家当地银行和一家储值支付运营商开设新账户 200 多次，成功开设 42 个账户，其中 14 个用于洗钱。警方表示，这些伪造的身份证是使用人工智能图像编辑软件来交换被盗或丢失的卡上的面孔而创建的。警方还敦促公众切勿与他人分享自拍照。谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: The news of 269 arrests in Hong Kong over technology scams, with losses reaching HK$320 million, underscores the pervasive allure and destructive power of greed. The pursuit of quick riches through fraudulent means often leads to ruin for both the perpetrators and their victims. This reflects the ancient wisdom that the love of money can indeed be a root of...
reflection.zh: 香港警方近期逮捕269人，涉及科技骗案，损失高达3.2亿港元，这则新闻凸显了贪婪的普遍诱惑及其毁灭性的力量。通过欺诈手段追求不义之财，往往给施害者和受害者双方都带来毁灭。这印证了古老的智慧：贪财是万恶之根，它使许多人陷入愁苦。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Tai Po fire: 13 Wang Fuk Court owners refuse gov’t buyout as 99% agree to sell
title.zh: 大埔火災：13戶王福樓業主拒絕政府回購協議，99%同意出售

summary.en: Thirteen homeowners at the fire-damaged Wang Fuk Court have failed to meet the government's deadline for its buyout scheme, according to housing authorities. The scheme offered cash or a new flat in exchange for selling their homes. The estate, which housed 1,984 households, was devastated by a fire last November that...
summary.zh: 據房屋當局稱，在火災中受損的王福樓有十三戶業主錯過了政府的強制拍賣計劃截止日期。該計劃提供現金或新的政府資助房屋以換取業主出售其單位。該屋邨在去年十一月的一場致命火災中被毀，造成168人死亡，原住有1,984戶。截至周四，已有1,971戶同意了該計劃的條款。

body.en: Thirteen homeowners at fire-hit Wang Fuk Court have missed the government’s deadline to participate in an official buyout scheme, according to city housing authorities. Wang Fuk Court after deadly fire, April 23, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Owners had until 5pm on Monday to sign and return a letter of acceptance agreeing to sell their flats to the government in return for a cash payment or a new flat in another government-subsidised estate. The government-subsidised residential estate in Tai Po accommodated 1,984 households in eight buildings before a deadly fire hit the estate, claiming 168 lives in November last year. The government said on Thursday that 1,971 households had submitted the acceptance letter before this deadline, signalling their intention to sell their titles to the government. That represents 99.3 per cent of all Wang Fuk Court households. Of these, 1,595 owners – 80.9 per cent of the total – took the next step in the process, signing a formal sale and purchase agreement with government-appointed estate administrators. “The government will continue to follow up on procedures for acquiring the remaining titles at full speed,” authorities said in a statement on Thursday. No extensions Officials previously said that the Monday deadline would not be extended, and the government had not ruled out using “legislative means” to acquire the remaining unsold units in the future. Betty Ho, a Wang Fuk Court homeowner, refused to sell her flat to Hong Kong government. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Betty Ho, a Wang Fuk Court homeowner who refuses to sell her flat to the government , told HKFP earlier this month that it would be “robbing” residents of their private property if the government tried to acquire unsold titles by law. “I am interested to see how [the government] could make such a law. It would completely ruin Hong Kong,” Ho said in Cantonese. Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong, who heads the government task force arranging long-term accommodation for residents, earlier said that the government could start the legislative process for acquiring unsold titles as early as next year. Wong added that if the government were to handle unsold titles by law, compensation would be “substantially lower” than the buyout offer that expired on Monday. Wang Fuk Court on fire in late November 2025. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The government announced a buyout scheme in February, with the prices set at HK$8,000 or HK$10,500 per square foot, depending on whether the homeowner had paid land premiums. Under the buyout scheme, homeowners were offered either a cash payout or a unit in another subsidised estate through a flat-exchange exercise.
body.zh: 据市住房部门称，遭受火灾的宏福苑的 13 名房主错过了政府参与官方买断计划的最后期限。致命火灾后的宏福苑，2026 年 4 月 23 日。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。业主必须在周一下午 5 点之前签署并返回一份同意书，同意将其公寓出售给政府，以换取现金付款或在另一个政府补贴的房产中购买新公寓。位于大埔的政府资助住宅小区共有八栋楼宇，共容纳了 1,984 户家庭，去年 11 月发生致命火灾，造成 168 人死亡。政府周四表示，已有 1,971 户家庭在截止日期前提交了录取通知书，表明他们打算将所有权出售给政府。这占宏福苑所有家庭的 99.3%。其中，1,595 名业主（占总数的 80.9%）采取了下一步行动，与政府指定的房地产管理人员签署了正式的买卖协议。当局在周四的一份声明中表示：“政府将继续全速跟进获取剩余产权的程序。”不延期 官员此前表示，周一的最后期限不会延长，政府也不排除未来使用“立法手段”收购剩余的未售单位。宏福苑房主何贝蒂 (Betty Ho) 拒绝将她的公寓出售给香港政府。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。宏福苑的房主Betty Ho拒绝将自己的公寓出售给政府，她本月早些时候告诉《香港新闻社》，如果政府试图通过法律收购未售出的产权，那将是“掠夺”居民的私人财产。 “我很想知道（政府）如何制定这样的法律。这将彻底毁掉香港，”何先生用粤语说道。负责为居民安排长期住宿的政府特别工作组负责人的副财政司长黄伟纶早些时候表示，政府最早可以在明年启动收购未售出产权的立法程序。黄补充说，如果政府依法处理未售出的产权，赔偿将“大大低于”周一到期的买断要约。宏福苑于 2025 年 11 月下旬起火。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。政府在2月份宣布了一项买断计划，价格定为每平方英尺8,000港元或10,500港元，视乎业主是否缴付地价而定。根据买断计划，房主要么获得现金支付，要么通过统一交换活动获得另一个补贴房产的单位。

reflection.en: In the aftermath of the devastating fire at Wang Fuk Court, the government offered a buyout scheme to help residents rebuild their lives. While the vast majority accepted, thirteen homeowners chose not to participate. This situation underscores the complex needs and decisions faced by those affected by tragedy, and the government's responsibility to provide...
reflection.zh: 在王福樓災難性火災之後，政府提供了一項回購計劃，以幫助居民重建生活。儘管絕大多數人接受了該計劃，但仍有十三戶業主選擇不參與。這一情況凸顯了受災難影響的居民所面臨的複雜需求和抉擇，以及政府對其公民的責任。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to charges under the national security law, specifically conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. The charge carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主派活动人士黄之锋周三承认触犯国安法，罪名是共谋寻求外国制裁中国，该罪名最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong, a young activist known for his role in Hong Kong's democracy movement, has pleaded guilty to charges under the national security law. This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Shein shares slide on fast-fashion retailer’s stock market debut
title.zh: Shein股票上市首日下跌，快时尚零售商估值缩水

summary.en: Shares of the fast-fashion brand Shein fell as much as 10% on their debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The company, founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, was valued at just over $26 billion, a significant drop from its previous valuation of nearly $100 billion.
summary.zh: 快时尚品牌Shein在香港证券交易所上市首日股价下跌高达10%。这家中国创立、现总部设在新加坡的公司，估值略高于260亿美元，远低于其此前近1000亿美元的估值。

body.en: Hong Kong flotation at $26bn by firm once valued at $100bn follows failure to list in US and UK Shares in the fast-fashion brand Shein slumped by as much as 10% as the China-founded company made its long-anticipated trading debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The Singapore-headquartered company, once valued at almost $100bn (£74bn), went public on Tuesday pricing shares at HK$48.56, valuing the business at just over $26bn. Continue reading...
body.zh: 曾估值 1000 亿美元的公司在香港发行 260 亿美元，此前该公司未能在美国和英国上市。快时尚品牌 Shein 在香港证券交易所首次上市后，其股价下跌了 10%。这家总部位于新加坡的公司一度估值近 1000 亿美元（740 亿英镑），周二上市，股价为 48.56 港元，业务估值略高于 260 亿美元。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic drop in Shein's valuation on its Hong Kong stock market debut, from nearly $100 billion to just over $26 billion, serves as a potent reminder of the volatile nature of commerce. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans, a wisdom that transcends market highs and lows.
reflection.zh: Shein在香港股市上市首日估值从近1000亿美元暴跌至略高于260亿美元，这有力地提醒我们商业的波动性。箴言16:3鼓励我们将所做的事交托给雅伟，信靠祂必成就我们的计划，这智慧超越了市场的起伏。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: The London stock market dodged a bullet with Shein | Nils Pratley
title.zh: 希音伦敦股市躲过一劫

summary.en: China's fashion giant Shein will list in Hong Kong with a reduced valuation, raising significant questions about its business model. This comes after politicians in both major parties in the UK had courted Shein for a London listing, seeing it as a boost to the local market and a signal of openness to international...
summary.zh: 中国时尚巨头希音（Shein）将以缩水的估值在香港上市，其商业模式引发了重大疑问。此前，英国两大政党的政治家曾积极争取希音在伦敦上市，认为这将提振当地股市并彰显英国对外资的开放态度。

body.en: China’s fashion giant will list in Hong Kong with a shrunken price tag – and big questions over its business model In a parallel world, we might now be preparing for the arrival on the London stock market of Shein, the giant Chinese-founded fast-fashion retailer. Or it could have happened already. The possibility of a London flotation was a running story during 2024 and into last year as politicians from both main parties engaged in behind-the-scenes wooing. Shein was seen as a shot of tech adrenalin for a listless local listings scene, and an opportunity to advertise the UK’s openness to international capital. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国时尚巨头将以更低的价格在香港上市——其商业模式面临重大疑问在另一个平行世界中，我们现在可能正在为中国创办的大型快时尚零售商 Shein 登陆伦敦股市做准备。或者它可能已经发生了。 2024 年和去年，随着两个主要政党的政治家都在幕后拉拢，在伦敦上市的可能性一直是一个热门话题。 Shein 被视为为当地无精打采的上市场景注入一剂科技肾上腺素，也是宣传英国对国际资本开放的机会。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news about Shein's decision to list in Hong Kong, rather than London, brings to the fore questions about its business model. This situation echoes the caution found in 1 Timothy 6:10, which warns that the love of money can lead to various troubles. As businesses navigate global markets, the pursuit of profit must be balanced with ethical considerations...
reflection.zh: 关于希音选择在香港而非伦敦上市的新闻，将对其商业模式的疑问推到了台前。这一情况呼应了《提摩太前书》6章10节的警示，该节经文提醒我们，贪财是万恶之根，可能导致各种麻烦。企业在驾驭全球市场时，追求利润必须与道德考量和可持续实践相平衡。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》评论员谈天安门镇压周年纪念定罪：香港也已被噤声。其他人应发声

summary.en: Two activists who organized commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime. For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the...
summary.zh: 两名组织纪念中国1989年镇压民主抗议活动的活动家现在面临牢狱之灾。铭记历史并非犯罪。几十年来，当中国大陆无法悼念时，香港却在哀悼。香港每年举办的大型天安门纪念活动，让人们记住了1989年北京的改革抗议活动以及镇压它们的屠杀。与澳门一起，香港是中国唯一能够公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。但2019年香港起义遭到镇压，...

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 两名组织纪念中国 1989 年民主抗议活动血腥镇压的活动人士现在面临牢狱之灾。铭记不是犯罪 几十年来，香港一直在哀悼，而大陆却无法铭记。一年一度的天安门守夜活动让人们牢牢记住了1989年北京支持改革的抗议活动以及镇压抗议活动的大屠杀。它与澳门一样，是中国唯一可以公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。但2019年香港起义的镇压摧毁了该地区曾经享有的自由。那一年的守夜活动是最后一次。周五，组织这次纪念活动的香港联盟的两名领导人根据严厉的国家安全法被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。 69 岁的李卓人和 41 岁的周恒东将面临最高 10 年的监禁。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of Hong Kong activists for organizing Tiananmen Square commemorations raises profound questions about remembrance and obedience. When state laws compel silence on historical truths, the faithful are called to consider where ultimate allegiance lies. As the activists face potential imprisonment for keeping memory alive, we are reminded that...
reflection.zh: 香港活动家因组织天安门事件纪念活动而被定罪，这引发了关于纪念和服从的深刻问题。当国家法律强迫人们对历史真相保持沉默时，信徒被呼召去思考最终的效忠对象在哪里。当这些活动家因努力让记忆得以保存而面临牢狱之灾时，我们被提醒，有时，服从雅伟意味着要反抗那些试图抹去历史的人类法令。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学
