body.zh: 苏尼尔·博帕亚 (Sunil Bopaiah) 回忆道，十五年前，印度几乎没有牛油果市场。 他说，成熟的果实会从树上掉下来，被狗吃掉，因此牛油果得了一个令人倒胃口的名字“狗果”。 Bopaiah 在印度种植业工作了 26 年，目前担任 Cottanad Plantations 的集团经理，该公司在印度南部喀拉拉邦的瓦亚纳德山种植可可、橡胶、咖啡、香料和水果，包括鳄梨。 “我们从未将鳄梨作为我们的主要作物种植。我们将其作为咖啡种植园的遮荫树引入，后来才意识到它可以成为一项有利可图的业务，”他说。 他说转折点出现在 2011 年左右，当时宝莱坞明星 Shilpa Shetty 说她用鳄梨来护肤。 Cottanad 响应这一需求，在 40 英亩的土地上种植了鳄梨树。去年他们收获了 10 至 15 吨水果。他们希望在四年内将产量提高到 40 至 50 吨。 “在向南非专家学习后，我们完全改变了牛油果的种植方式。如今，我们使用高位苗床、更宽的间距和不同的种植方法，因为牛油果根部极易受到疾病的影响，”Bopaiah 说。 “当我们研究市场时，我们发现供需之间存在巨大差距。印度每年进口约 15,000 吨牛油果，而国内产量仅为约 8,000-9,000 吨，”帮助促进印度牛油果产业的马尼拉尔·帕利亚斯 (Maninal Palliyath) 说道。 他认为农民面临着巨大的机遇，特别是在传统作物遭受损失的情况下。 “由于气候条件的变化，咖啡和胡椒受到了影响，因此多样化对农民来说至关重要。” Hunger Inc. Hospitality 的行政主厨 Hussain Shahzad 表示：“印度种植的牛油果正在不断进步，一些优秀的农民正在种植当地品种，但质量和供应情况可能会因季节和地区的不同而存在很大差异。” 该集团在孟买拥有四家餐厅，包括 Veronica's 和 The Bombay Canteen。 但和餐饮业的许多人一样，他希望在当地采购食材。 “随着当地农产品的不断发展，我们始终对探索更好的当地农产品感兴趣。支持印度农业并使用本土原料是我们处理食物的核心。” 与进口水果的质量和一致性相匹配是一些印度企业家的目标。 Harshit Godha 是位于印度中部中央邦博帕尔的印度-以色列鳄梨苗圃的创始人。 在以色列花了一个月时间了解该行业后，他于 2021 年创立了苗圃业务。 自此以后，生意一直很红火。过去五年来，Godha 已向印度各地的农民提供了约 18,000 株鳄梨。 “以色列种植鳄梨的面积​​大约......

reflection.en: It's remarkable how a crop once dismissed as 'dog fruit' has transformed into a valuable commodity in India. This shift from overlooked potential to profitable business mirrors the wisdom of committing our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He can bring success to diligent and thoughtful work, even in unexpected places. Sunil Bopaiah's experience, where...
reflection.zh: 曾经被视为“狗果”的作物如今在印度转变为有价值的商品，这真是令人瞩目。这种从被忽视的潜力转变为有利可图的业务，恰恰反映了将我们的努力托付给雅伟的智慧，相信祂能够为勤奋而周到的工作带来成功，即使是在意想不到的地方。...

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Could robots be the future of theme parks?
title.zh: 机器人会是主题公园的未来吗？

summary.en: Galaxy Robot Park is a 16,500-square-meter venue in South Korea, featuring attractions like humanoid robots dancing to K-pop music. The company behind it aims to integrate artificial intelligence and robotics into entertainment, posing the question of whether robots can sustain visitor interest.
summary.zh: 银河机器人公园是韩国一个占地16,500平方米的场馆，其景点包括跳着K-pop热曲的拟人机器人。公园的创办公司旨在将人工智能和机器人技术引入娱乐领域，并提出了机器人能否吸引游客持续到来的问题。

body.en: This is Galaxy Robot Park, a 16,500-square-meter venue that’s opened near Seoul in South Korea . The company behind the park says their aim is to bring artificial intelligence and robotics into the world of entertainment. The question is, can robots keep people coming back?
body.zh: 这就是银河机器人公园，一个占地 16,500 平方米的场地，在韩国首尔附近开业。该公园背后的公司表示，他们的目标是将人工智能和机器人技术带入娱乐世界。问题是，机器人能让人们回来吗？

reflection.en: The opening of the Galaxy Robot Park in South Korea, with its dancing humanoid robots, highlights humanity's relentless pursuit of innovation and knowledge. This drive, as described in Daniel 12:4, is leading to an explosion of technological advancement, particularly in AI and robotics, reshaping how we experience entertainment and interact with the world.
reflection.zh: 韩国银河机器人公园的开业，展示了载歌载舞的拟人机器人，这突显了人类对创新和知识的不懈追求。正如但以理书12:4所描述的，这种驱动力正引领着人工智能和机器人技术的爆炸性发展，并重塑着我们体验娱乐和与世界互动的方式。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: 'I lost my savings after a job interview scam'
title.zh: “我损失了毕生积蓄，因为一次虚假的面试”

summary.en: Jobseekers, particularly Gen Z, are increasingly falling victim to fake recruitment apps designed to steal their savings. One individual lost £18,000 after downloading a malicious document disguised as an interview tool, which then drained his cryptocurrency accounts.
summary.zh: 求职者，特别是Z世代，越来越多地成为旨在窃取他们积蓄的虚假招聘应用程序的受害者。一名个人在下载了一个伪装成面试工具的恶意软件后损失了18,000英镑，该软件随后耗尽了他的加密货币账户。

body.en:
Jobseekers are being warned to be vigilant as scammers are targeting people on job listings websites to trick them into downloading bogus interview tools.

One victim was invited on LinkedIn by a fake recruiter to take part in a job interview process and downloaded a normal-looking document which turned out to be malicious software.

Within hours the hackers had drained his cryptocurrency accounts of £18,000 of savings and disappeared.

"It's a horrible feeling to be out a substantial amount - something I wouldn't wish on my worst enemy," the victim, who wanted to stay anonymous, said.

Professional recruitment platforms LinkedIn and Indeed have warned of growing numbers of job scams in recent months.

LinkedIn released data highlighting what it called The Gen Z "Scam Gap" , external - "Younger professionals face the highest exposure to scams (32%), yet nearly a third (32%) admit to ignoring red flags due to a competitive job market."

When approached by the BBC, the company said in a crowded and competitive job market, "many young people feel they can't afford to be skeptical... because they feel opportunities are so scarce".

The platform pointed to advice on its website , external about how to spot recruitment scams by, for example, verifying that the company and job were real and doing thorough research before engaging in talks.

The victim who lost their savings after being hacked had handed his notice in and had made it clear on LinkedIn that they were looking for a new job.

A fake recruiter sent them a potential job offer and held a video call about the job before asking them to carry out a standard technical assessment, with instructions on the Google Sheet document.

After completing the task, the candidate went to bed and woke up to find their online wallets emptied of their savings.

"I wiped my computer and changed all my passwords and was exhausted emotionally and mentally drained," they said.

"I felt a mixture of disbelief and anger - at the hackers and at myself. I was also confused until I figured out how they had got me."

Cyber-security researcher Charlie Kelly from Have I Been Squatted carried out an analysis of how the attack worked and said the new wave of recruitment scams were hard to spot.

"This wasn't a badly written email with a suspicious attachment - this person was walked through what looked like a real job interview, on real Google pages, behind a real Google login, and the software they were asked to install was digitally signed like any legitimate app."

The case comes as others have reported similar attacks through the job listing platform Indeed, which put out advice in July about avoiding scams , external .

Criminals are using the pressure and excitement of job interviews to lure people into downloading...
body.zh: 求职者被警告要保持警惕，因为诈骗者会瞄准职位列表网站上的人员，诱骗他们下载虚假的面试工具。 一名受害者在 LinkedIn 上受到假冒招聘人员的邀请参加工作面试过程，并下载了一份看似正常的文档，结果证明是恶意软件。 几个小时内，黑客就耗尽了他的加密货币账户中 18,000 英镑的积蓄，然后就消失了。 这位不愿透露姓名的受害者说：“长时间外出是一种可怕的感觉——我不希望我最大的敌人遭遇这种情况。” 专业招聘平台 LinkedIn 和 Indeed 警告称，近几个月来，求职诈骗数量不断增加。 LinkedIn 发布的数据强调了所谓的 Z 世代“诈骗差距”（外部）——“年轻专业人士面临的诈骗风险最高（32%），但近三分之一（32%）承认由于就业市场竞争激烈而忽视了危险信号。” 当 BBC 联系该公司时，该公司表示，在拥挤且竞争激烈的就业市场中，“许多年轻人觉得他们不能怀疑......因为他们觉得机会如此稀缺”。 该平台在其网站上提供了有关如何发现招聘骗局的建议，例如，验证公司和职位的真实性，并在进行会谈之前进行彻底的研究。 被黑客攻击后失去积蓄的受害者已经递交了通知，并在 LinkedIn 上明确表示他们正在寻找新工作。 一名假招聘人员向他们发送了一份潜在的工作机会，并就该工作进行了视频通话，然后要求他们进行标准技术评估，并在 Google Sheet 文档中提供说明。 完成任务后，候选人上床睡觉，醒来时发现网上钱包里的积蓄已经空了。 他们说：“我擦除了我的电脑并更改了所有密码，我的情绪和精神都疲惫不堪。” “我对黑客和我自己感到既怀疑又愤怒。我也很困惑，直到我弄清楚他们是如何抓住我的。” Have I Been Squatted 的网络安全研究员查理·凯利 (Charlie Kelly) 对攻击的运作方式进行了分析，并表示新一波的招聘诈骗很难被发现。 “这并不是一封写得不好、带有可疑附件的电子邮件——这个人在真实的谷歌页面上、在真实的谷歌登录后面经历了看起来像真正的工作面试的情况，而且他们被要求安装的软件像任何合法应用程序一样经过了数字签名。” 此案发生之际，其他人也通过职位发布平台 Indeed 报告了类似的攻击，该平台于 7 月份发布了有关避免诈骗的建议。 犯罪分子利用求职面试的压力和兴奋来引诱人们下载...

reflection.en: The pursuit of financial security can tragically lead to devastating loss when it becomes an unchecked love of money. This scam preys on the desire for a good job, turning a hopeful search into a nightmare of financial ruin, reminding us that true security is not found in wealth alone.
reflection.zh: 对财务安全的追求，当它变成对金钱无节制的爱时，可能导致毁灭性的损失。这次骗局利用了人们对好工作的渴望，将充满希望的求职变成了财务破产的噩梦，提醒我们真正的安全并非仅仅在于财富。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Reports: RFK Jr. ordered measles deaths deletion; CDC still secretly counts them
title.zh: 报道：小肯尼迪下令删除麻疹死亡病例；疾控中心仍在秘密统计

summary.en: CDC staff had already accepted the measles death reports when RFK Jr. interfered, ordering their deletion from public records despite their initial characterization as measles-related.
summary.zh: 在小肯尼迪干预之前，疾控中心的工作人员已经接受了麻疹死亡报告，他下令将其从公开记录中删除，尽管这些死亡最初被定性为与麻疹有关。

body.en: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention is still secretly counting two measles deaths that were deleted from the agency's public measles data—a deletion that occurred at the direct request of anti-vaccine Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., according to two reports released today. Early today, Reuters reported that Kennedy instructed new CDC director Erica Schwartz to delete the two deaths from the agency's website. CDC staff had reportedly already reviewed information about the deaths and accepted the characterization that they were measles-related. Still, Schwartz deleted the deaths without objection, insiders told Reuters. According to previous reporting , the two deaths were added and then removed from the CDC's website within hours on August 30. The deaths were of a newborn and a child, and they were reported last week by health officials in Pennsylvania. The state's ongoing measles outbreak has sickened 540 so far, including 119 just in the last week . Read full article Comments
body.zh: 根据今天发布的两份报告，美国疾病控制与预防中心仍在秘密统计两例麻疹死亡人数，这些死亡人数已从该机构的公共麻疹数据中删除——这一删除是应反疫苗卫生部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪的直接要求而进行的。今天早些时候，路透社报道称，肯尼迪指示新任疾病预防控制中心主任埃丽卡·施瓦茨从该机构的网站上删除这两起死亡事件。据报道，疾病预防控制中心工作人员已经审查了有关死亡的信息，并接受了死亡与麻疹相关的定性。知情人士告诉路透社，施瓦茨毫无异议地删除了死亡事件。根据之前的报道，8 月 30 日，两例死亡病例被添加，然后在几小时内从 CDC 网站上删除。死亡病例是一名新生儿和一名儿童，宾夕法尼亚州卫生官员上周报告了这一情况。该州持续爆发的麻疹疫情迄今已导致 540 人患病，其中上周就有 119 人患病。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The news reports that Robert F. Kennedy Jr. ordered the deletion of two measles deaths from public CDC records, even after staff had accepted them as measles-related. This raises questions about the integrity of public health data and the ethical responsibilities of leaders in such sensitive areas. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk...
reflection.zh: 新闻报道称，罗伯特·肯尼迪二世下令从疾控中心的公开记录中删除两例麻疹死亡病例，尽管工作人员已将其认定为与麻疹相关。这引发了对公共卫生数据完整性以及领导人在这些敏感领域所承担的道德责任的质疑。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与神同行，这些原则应指导所有公共服务。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Xbox imposes harsh new time limits for Game Pass game streaming
title.zh: Xbox 对游戏通行证游戏流媒体施加严厉的新时间限制

summary.en: Over 1 million Game Pass subscribers will face increased costs due to new, stricter monthly limits on game streaming time, with additional hours available for purchase.
summary.zh: 超过一百万 Game Pass 用户将因新的、更严格的游戏流媒体月度限制而面临更高的成本，额外的小时数可供购买。

body.en: In 2020, Microsoft announced that Game Pass Ultimate subscriptions would include unlimited access to its new Xbox Cloud Gaming service (then still known as Project xCloud ). Now, that kind of streaming buffet service is coming to an end, as Microsoft announced strict new limits on how much streaming is included in its various Game Pass subscriptions. Starting in November, Game Pass subscriptions will include the following monthly limits on game streaming time: Game Pass Ultimate ($23/month): 15 hours Game Pass Premium ($15/month): 10 hours Game Pass Essential ($10/month): 5 hours Subscribers who use up their monthly streaming allotment will be able to buy additional time, Microsoft said, without sharing specific pricing or availability for that streaming time. Access to downloadable versions of games included in a Game Pass subscription remains unaffected. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 2020 年，微软宣布 Game Pass Ultimate 订阅将包括无限制地访问其新的 Xbox 云游戏服务（当时仍称为 Project xCloud）。现在，随着微软宣布对其各种 Game Pass 订阅中包含的流媒体数量进行严格的新限制，这种流媒体自助餐服务即将结束。从11月开始，Game Pass订阅将包括以下游戏流媒体时间的每月限制： Game Pass Ultimate（23美元/月）：15小时 Game Pass Premium（15美元/月）：10小时 Game Pass Essential（10美元/月）：5小时 微软表示，用完每月流媒体配额的订阅者将能够购买额外的时间，而无需透露该流媒体时间的具体价格或可用性。对 Game Pass 订阅中包含的游戏的可下载版本的访问不受影响。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: Microsoft's decision to limit game streaming time for Game Pass subscribers highlights how technological advancements, while offering convenience, can also introduce new restrictions and costs. The principle that 'not everything is beneficial' reminds us to discern the true value and impact of such changes, considering both the provider's business model and...
reflection.zh: 微软决定限制 Game Pass 用户的游戏流媒体时间，这表明技术进步在提供便利的同时，也可能带来新的限制和成本。《凡事都可行，但不都有益》的原则提醒我们，要辨别这些变化的真正价值和影响，既要考虑提供商的商业模式，也要考虑用户的体验和福祉。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: 150 research primates got diarrhea, flooding lab with priceless vaccine data
title.zh: 150只研究用灵长类动物腹泻，为珍贵疫苗数据带来实验室洪水

summary.en: Researchers have identified new targets and gained insights for developing a Shigella vaccine following an outbreak of diarrhea in over 150 non-human primates, which provided a wealth of immunological data.
summary.zh: 在超过150只非人类灵长类动物爆发腹泻疫情后，研究人员获得了开发志贺氏菌疫苗的新靶点和见解，这次疫情提供了大量的免疫学数据。

body.en: Having more than 150 non-human primates at a research center fall ill with diarrhea in a stomach-churning outbreak that flowed for over two years doesn't sound much like good fortune. But for some scientists, it kind of was, providing a heaping pile of valuable data on how they might finally defeat a foul foe. In a study published in the latest issue of Science Translational Medicine , scientist sifted through the dump of immunological data from the infections, logging new ways to train immune cells to defeat the bacteria behind the outbreak, a type of Shigella . Researchers were able to pluck out specific bits of the bacteria that the immune system could most effectively attack, linking specific target molecules to specific types of germ-busting immune responses. The researchers even precisely homed in on some of the tiny notches within those craggy target molecules where the most potent antibodies attached. In all, the study "revealed unexpected features of the anti-Shigella antibody response in naturally infected [non-human primates] and represents a step toward the rational design of Shigella vaccine candidates," the authors write. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 一个研究中心有超过 150 只非人类灵长类动物在一场持续两年多的令人反胃的疫情中患上腹泻，这听起来不太像是一件好事。但对于一些科学家来说，这可以提供大量有价值的数据，告诉他们如何最终击败邪恶的敌人。在最新一期《科学转化医学》杂志上发表的一项研究中，科学家筛选了感染的免疫学数据，记录了训练免疫细胞击败疫情背后的细菌（志贺氏菌的一种）的新方法。研究人员能够找出免疫系统最有效攻击的细菌的特定部分，将特定的目标分子与特定类型的杀菌免疫反应联系起来。研究人员甚至精确地瞄准了那些崎岖不平的目标分子内的一些微小凹口，这些凹口上附着着最有效的抗体。总而言之，该研究“揭示了自然感染的[非人类灵长类动物]抗志贺氏菌抗体反应的意想不到的特征，并且代表着朝着理性设计候选志贺氏菌疫苗迈出了一步，”作者写道。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: Sometimes, what appears to be a setback can unexpectedly yield profound insights. The unexpected illness among these primates, while unfortunate, has provided scientists with crucial data, reminding us that wisdom can be found even in difficult circumstances. As Job teaches, we can learn from the natural world around us, even when it presents challenges.
reflection.zh: 有时，看似是挫折的事情却能意外地带来深刻的见解。这些灵长类动物的意外疾病虽然不幸，却为科学家提供了关键数据，提醒我们即使在困难的环境中也能找到智慧。正如约伯所教导的，我们可以从周围的自然界中学习，即使它带来了挑战。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Confused about which VPN is right, US senator asks the NSA for guidance
title.zh: 美国参议员呼吁国家安全局就VPN使用提供指导

summary.en: A US senator has asked the National Security Agency (NSA) to provide public guidance on the best practices for using virtual private networks (VPNs) to protect communications from foreign adversaries. The senator noted the complexity and variety of VPN options available, and the NSA's previous recommendations lacked...
summary.zh: 一位美国参议员已要求国家安全局（NSA）就使用虚拟专用网络（VPN）的最佳实践向公众提供指导，以保护通信免受外国敌对势力的侵害。参议员指出，可用的VPN选项复杂且种类繁多，而NSA此前的建议缺乏关于哪些VPN能提供足够保护的具体指导。

body.en: A prominent US senator is asking the National Security Agency to provide guidance to the general public on best practices for using virtual private networks to secure their communications from spying by foreign adversaries. VPNs funnel all of a user’s Internet traffic through an encrypted connection to a remote server. The design provides strong assurances that no one between the user and the server can read the encrypted contents. VPNs also allow users to hide their IP addresses from the destination servers they communicate with. While US agencies have previously recommended use of VPNs, none have given recommendations on which ones provide adequate protection. It's all in the nuances There are a host of limitations that can undo many of the protections users may think their VPN provides them. For instance, the encrypted tunnel often terminates once a single server decrypts the traffic and sends it on to its final destination. That means the decrypted traffic or the sending and destination IP addresses may be available for snooping by rogue employees or attackers who hack the server. VPNs also don’t encrypt certain types of metadata, such as time stamps, allowing nation-states to build profiles that can be useful in intelligence gathering. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 一位著名的美国参议员要求国家安全局向公众提供有关使用虚拟专用网络保护其通信免受外国对手间谍活动的最佳实践的指导。 VPN 通过加密连接将用户的所有互联网流量汇集到远程服务器。这一设计提供了强有力的保证，即用户和服务器之间的任何人都无法读取加密内容。 VPN 还允许用户向与其通信的目标服务器隐藏其 IP 地址。虽然美国机构此前建议使用 VPN，但没有一个机构就哪些 VPN 提供足够的保护给出建议。一切都在细微差别中 有许多限制可能会抵消用户认为 VPN 为他们提供的许多保护。例如，一旦单个服务器解密流量并将其发送到最终目的地，加密隧道通常就会终止。这意味着解密的流量或发送和目标 IP 地址可能会被黑客攻击服务器的流氓员工或攻击者窥探。 VPN 也不加密某些类型的元数据，例如时间戳，从而允许民族国家构建可用于情报收集的配置文件。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: In an age of complex digital tools, discerning the best path forward can be overwhelming. This senator's request for clear guidance on VPNs reflects a need for wisdom in navigating technological choices. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that 'where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety.' May we seek and offer wise...
reflection.zh: 在一个充斥着复杂数字工具的时代，辨别最佳的前进道路可能会让人不知所措。这位参议员呼吁就VPN提供明确指导，反映了在技术选择中寻求智慧的必要性。《箴言》11:14提醒我们：“在无谋划之处，人民就败落；谋士众多，便得安稳。”愿我们在生活的各个领域，尤其是在缺乏理解的地方，都能寻求并提供明智的建议。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Supreme Court urged to let states regulate sports bets on prediction markets
title.zh: 新泽西州敦促最高法院裁定 Kalshi 体育投注为赌博，而非“掉期”

summary.en: A legal dispute between New Jersey and the prediction market Kalshi, concerning whether its sports-betting-like contracts are gambling or financial "swaps," has escalated to the Supreme Court. New Jersey argues Kalshi bypasses state gambling laws, while a lower court sided with Kalshi, granting jurisdiction to the...
summary.zh: 新泽西州与预测市场 Kalshi 之间的一场法律纠纷，围绕其类似体育投注的合约是赌博还是金融“掉期”展开，已升级至最高法院。新泽西州认为 Kalshi 绕过了州赌博法，而下级法院则支持 Kalshi，将管辖权授予了商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）。

body.en: New Jersey yesterday asked the Supreme Court to rule on whether states can regulate sports betting on prediction markets such as Kalshi. “Companies like Kalshi claim to offer legal sports betting in all 50 states, but they refuse to follow the gambling laws of any state," New Jersey Attorney General Jennifer Davenport said in a press release announcing the lawsuit. In April, the US Court of Appeals for the 3rd Circuit ruled that New Jersey cannot regulate sports bets on prediction markets. The court determined that sports-related event contracts meet the legal definition of "swaps," giving the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) exclusive jurisdiction. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 新泽西州昨天要求最高法院就各州是否可以监管卡尔希等预测市场上的体育博彩做出裁决。 “像 Kalshi 这样的公司声称在所有 50 个州提供合法的体育博彩，但他们拒绝遵守任何州的博彩法，”新泽西州总检察长 Jennifer Davenport 在宣布诉讼的新闻稿中表示。今年四月，美国第三巡回上诉法院裁定新泽西州不能监管预测市场上的体育博彩。法院认定，与体育赛事相关的合约符合“掉期”的法律定义，并赋予美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）专属管辖权。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: This legal battle over how to classify financial contracts—whether as gambling or regulated "swaps"—raises questions about fairness and accountability in commerce. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Yahweh, principles that should guide how we regulate markets and protect citizens.
reflection.zh: 这场关于如何界定金融合约性质的法律斗争——是赌博还是受监管的“掉期”——引发了关于商业公平和问责制的疑问。弥迦书 6:8 提醒我们，真正的公义在于行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行，这些原则应指导我们如何监管市场和保护公民。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: VMware migration reduces Tottenham Hotspur's licensing fees by 85 percent
title.zh: VMware迁移使托特纳姆热刺的许可费减少85%

summary.en: Tottenham Hotspur, a Premier League soccer team, has significantly reduced its licensing fees by switching from VMware to HPE's virtualization software. This move was reportedly influenced by concerns related to the Broadcom takeover of VMware, prompting the team's CTO to seek alternative solutions for their stadium's...
summary.zh: 英格兰足球超级联赛球队托特纳姆热刺队通过将VMware的虚拟化软件更换为HPE的解决方案，大幅削减了许可费用。据报道，此举受到了VMware被博通公司收购的影响，促使该队首席技术官为其体育场的IT基础设施寻求替代方案。

body.en: Tottenham Hotspur, a professional soccer team that’s part of the Premier League, has saved over 85 percent in licensing fees by replacing its stadium's VMware instance with Hewlett-Packard Enterprise’s (HPE’s) Morpheus VM Essentials (VME) virtualization software. Tottenham hasn’t disclosed which VMware products it used or how much it previously paid the Broadcom firm. The soccer organization confirmed this week to The Register that it has moved its stadium's server, storage, and networking infrastructure to HPE solutions delivered through HPE's hybrid cloud management platform, GreenLake. That is all “underpinned by" VME and HPE's OpsRamp software for hybrid and multi-cloud environments, Rob Pickering, Tottenham's CTO, told the publication, with HPE in charge of the hybrid cloud-managed service. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 托特纳姆热刺队是英超联赛的一支职业足球队，通过使用惠普企业 (HPE) 的 Morpheus VM Essentials (VME) 虚拟化软件替换其体育场的 VMware 实例，节省了超过 85% 的许可费用。托特纳姆热刺队没有透露它使用了哪些VMware产品，也没有透露它之前向博通公司支付了多少钱。该足球组织本周向 The Register 证实，已将其体育场的服务器、存储和网络基础设施迁移到通过 HPE 混合云管理平台 GreenLake 提供的 HPE 解决方案。托特纳姆热刺队首席技术官 Rob Pickering 表示，这一切都是由 VME 和 HPE 针对混合云和多云环境的 OpsRamp 软件“支撑”的，而 HPE 则负责混合云托管服务。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: In the complex world of corporate mergers and technological shifts, leaders face decisions that impact their organizations' resources and operations. The CTO of Tottenham Hotspur navigated these changes by seeking a more stable and cost-effective solution, demonstrating integrity in managing the team's assets. This echoes the wisdom of Proverbs 16:12, which...
reflection.zh: 在企业合并和技术变革的复杂世界中，领导者面临着影响其组织资源和运营的决策。托特纳姆热刺队的首席技术官通过寻求更稳定、更具成本效益的解决方案来应对这些变化，这体现了其在管理球队资产方面的诚信。这呼应了《箴言》16章12节的智慧：“王因公义得治国，倚靠正直可以长久”，这表明健全、合乎道德的领导力能够带来稳定和繁荣。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: AI data centres are booming in Australia - but at what cost?
title.zh: 澳大利亚数据中心蓬勃发展——但代价是什么？

summary.en: Proponents argue that data centers will create jobs, while others express concern that they will consume significant resources with limited overall benefit.
summary.zh: 支持者认为数据中心将创造就业机会，而其他人则担心它们将消耗大量资源而整体效益有限。

body.en:
The sheer size and noise of data centres are what people tend to notice first. Some say they sound like a jet plane about to take off, others complain of a high-pitched whine.

When Lucy* puts her child to bed, she hears a constant humming. "I'll hear it and think, 'What is that? What is going on?'," she says.

And then she'll remember that the noise is a data centre just 350m (0.2 miles) from her front door in the desirable suburb of Lane Cove, in Sydney's lower north-shore. Another four are in the pipeline at the local industrial park.

Australia has quickly become a global destination for data centres, with investors attracted to the country's abundance of clean energy, natural gas reserves, and land to power and house their technologies.

Earlier this year, OpenAI's CEO Sam Altman said Australia could become a data centre capital of the world, if it wanted to.

Australia is already headed in the direction of big tech's wishes. There are 162 data centres across the country, with plans for 90 more, and an estimated more than A$155bn (£80bn) of investment money lined up.

If approved, one of the world's biggest data centres will be built in western Sydney. At one gigawatt, it is expected to be Australia's largest single energy user.

And in Marsden Park, also in western Sydney, the biggest data centre in the Southern Hemisphere is already under construction only 100m away from a local community.

But as more Australians find themselves living next door to data centres - triggering concerns about water supplies, energy use and the environment - many are asking whether joining the artificial intelligence (AI) race is worth it.

Data centres have been essential to the digital economy since the arrival of the internet.

They were originally built to process and store data for things like emails, online banking and cloud services. But everything changed after 2022 when ChatGPT launched and AI exploded in popularity. This prompted a sudden race to build more data centres to power the technology.

The location of these large, windowless buildings filled with beeping servers and cables also became important to latency – the time it takes for data to travel from its source to its destination.

Delays for things like air traffic control, robotic surgery or even Netflix would not be tolerated today, Belinda Dennett, CEO of Data Centres Australia, says.

Australia has roughly 13.6 million users of AI every month, making them the sixth most active users of the tech globally.

And experts say having data centres in Australia will lower the barrier to building more of its own AI companies.

"If we think about it in reverse, what happens if we don't build infrastructure here", Dennett says. "We get none of the value chain, we are just importing tools from someone...
body.zh: 人们往往首先注意到的是数据中心的庞大规模和噪音。有人说它们听起来像一架即将起飞的喷气式飞机，另一些人则抱怨是尖锐的哀鸣声。 当露西*让她的孩子上床睡觉时，她听到持续不断的嗡嗡声。 “我会听到它并想，‘那是什么？发生了什么事？’”她说。 然后她会记得，噪音来自距离她前门仅 350m（0.2 英里）的数据中心，该数据中心位于悉尼下北岸理想的 Lane Cove 郊区。另外四个正在当地工业园区筹备中。 澳大利亚已迅速成为全球数据中心目的地，投资者被该国丰富的清洁能源、天然气储量以及用于供电和容纳其技术的土地所吸引。 今年早些时候，OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 表示，如果澳大利亚愿意，它可以成为世界数据中心之都。 澳大利亚已经朝着大型科技公司愿望的方向前进。全国有 162 个数据中心，计划再建设 90 个，预计投资资金将超过 1,550 亿澳元（800 亿英镑）。 如果获得批准，世界上最大的数据中心之一将建在悉尼西部。预计将成为澳大利亚最大的单一能源用户，达到一吉瓦。 而在同样位于悉尼西部的马斯登公园，南半球最大的数据中心已经在建设中，距离当地社区仅 100m。 但随着越来越多的澳大利亚人发现自己住在数据中心旁边，引发了人们对供水、能源使用和环境的担忧，许多人开始质疑加入人工智能 (AI) 竞赛是否值得。 自互联网出现以来，数据中心对于数字经济至关重要。 它们最初是为了处理和存储电子邮件、网上银行和云服务等数据而构建的。但 2022 年 ChatGPT 推出、人工智能爆发式普及后，一切都发生了变化。这促使人们突然竞相建造更多数据中心来支持该技术。 这些大型、无窗的建筑物中充满了发出蜂鸣声的服务器和电缆，其位置对于延迟（数据从源传输到目的地所需的时间）也变得很重要。 澳大利亚数据中心首席执行官贝琳达·丹尼特 (Belinda Dennett) 表示，如今空中交通管制、机器人手术甚至 Netflix 等服务的延误都是不能容忍的。 澳大利亚每月约有 1360 万人工智能用户，使其成为全球第六大最活跃的技术用户。 专家表示，在澳大利亚拥有数据中心将降低建立更多自己的人工智能公司的障碍。 “如果我们反过来思考，如果我们不在这里建设基础设施，会发生什么”，丹尼特说。 “我们没有获得任何价值链，我们只是从某人那里进口工具......

reflection.en: The rapid growth of data centers in Australia presents a complex challenge, balancing potential economic gains with environmental and resource concerns. This situation calls for careful consideration, as Proverbs 18:15 reminds us that the human heart seeks knowledge and understanding, but this pursuit must be tempered with wisdom and foresight to ensure...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚数据中心的快速增长带来了复杂的挑战，需要在潜在的经济收益与环境和资源问题之间取得平衡。这种情况需要仔细考虑，正如箴言 18:15 所提醒我们的，人心寻求知识和理解，但这种追求必须以智慧和远见为辅，以确保可持续的进步。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: OpenAI hails ‘new era of artificial general intelligence’ with Astra model release
title.zh: OpenAI 宣布 Astra 模型发布，开启“通用人工智能新时代”

summary.en: OpenAI has announced the release of its latest model, Astra, which it describes as the "world's most intelligent and aligned model." This announcement comes shortly after CEO Sam Altman had downplayed the term 'AGI' and follows a period of international concern over AI safety incidents involving other OpenAI models.
summary.zh: OpenAI 宣布发布其最新模型 Astra，并称其为“世界上最智能、最协调的模型”。此次发布正值该公司首席执行官萨姆·奥特曼此前淡化“通用人工智能”（AGI）一词，并且此前国际社会对 OpenAI 其他模型出现的 AI 安全事件表示担忧。

body.en: Astra’s arrival comes days after Sam Altman, OpenAI’s chief executive, described AGI as an ‘irrelevant marketing term’ The president of OpenAI, Greg Brockman, has claimed the world has entered a new era of artificial general intelligence after the release of his company’s latest model, Astra, which it described as the “world’s most intelligent and aligned model”. Brockman made the claim on Thursday as the San Francisco company released the model only weeks after a serious AI safety incident involving other models under its development caused international concern and a pause in Astra’s training. Continue reading...
body.zh: 几天前，OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 将 AGI 描述为“无关紧要的营销术语”。OpenAI 总裁格雷格·布罗克曼 (Greg Brockman) 声称，在其公司最新模型 Astra 发布后，世界已进入通用人工智能新时代，并称其为“世界上最智能、最一致的模型”。布罗克曼于周四发表了上述声明，当时这家旧金山公司发布该模型仅几周前，涉及其正在开发的其他模型的严重人工智能安全事件引起了国际关注并暂停了 Astra 的培训。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The ambition to create 'artificial general intelligence' can be a powerful driver of innovation, as seen with OpenAI's Astra model. However, the Genesis account of Babel warns against unchecked human ambition that seeks to reach the heavens on its own terms, potentially leading to confusion and division. The challenge for developers and society is to pursue...
reflection.zh: 创造“通用人工智能”的雄心可以成为创新的强大驱动力，正如 OpenAI 的 Astra 模型所展示的。然而，《创世记》中关于巴别塔的记载告诫人们要警惕不受约束的人类野心，这种野心试图按自己的方式触及天堂，可能导致混乱和分裂。对于开发者和社会而言，挑战在于以谦逊的态度追求技术进步，并清晰地认识到人类的局限性。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'

title.en: Nvidia strikes $12.9bn deal to buy AI platform Hugging Face
title.zh: 英伟达斥资129亿美元收购AI平台Hugging Face

summary.en: Nvidia has agreed to acquire Hugging Face, a prominent AI platform and developer community, for approximately $12.9 billion. This acquisition signifies Nvidia's expansion into software and its move to control a significant open-source AI ecosystem.
summary.zh: 英伟达已同意以约129亿美元的价格收购领先的人工智能平台和开发者社区Hugging Face。此次收购标志着英伟达向软件领域的扩张，并获得了对一个重要的开源人工智能生态系统的控制权。

body.en:
Nvidia has agreed to buy artificial intelligence platform Hugging Face in a deal valued at about $12.9bn (£9.5bn), one of the AI chipmaker's biggest acquisitions as it expands into software.

Hugging Face, founded in 2016, has become a popular online platform where developers and researchers can find, share and test AI models and tools.

It recently made headlines after rogue AI agents that escaped a testing environment hacked into it, raising questions about AI safety and oversight.

The deal would bring one of the world's largest AI developer communities into Nvidia and give it control of a leading open-source platform - an alternative to systems offered by OpenAI and Anthropic.

Nvidia is best known for making the advanced chips used to train and run AI systems. Demand for those chips has surged as companies race to build AI products.

The companies already work together to help developers use Nvidia's computing services through the platform.

According to the companies, Hugging Face is used by more than 18 million developers and hosts more than three million AI models. More than 200,000 companies use the platform, they said.

Nvidia said Hugging Face would remain open to developers and that users would not be required to use its chips or services.

Under the agreement, Nvidia will pay about $11.9bn to Hugging Face investors and offer up to $1bn in stock-based incentives to employees who join the company.

The deal could also help Nvidia expand its presence in AI software as some of its biggest customers, including Microsoft, Meta and OpenAI, develop their own chips.

Open-source AI models can be downloaded and adapted by users, unlike many AI systems that are controlled by a single company.

Supporters say the approach can make the technology more accessible to businesses, researchers and developers.

Yaël Ossowski, deputy director of advocacy group Consumer Choice Center, said the acquisition was "a vote of confidence in open AI" and suggested it could encourage competition by making AI tools more widely available to start ups and smaller companies.

The deal will be a "major victory for innovators and consumers worldwide" if Nvidia keeps Hugging Face open and accessible, he added.

The deal would also give Nvidia access to one of the world's largest AI developer communities as competition in the sector intensifies .

Founded by French entrepreneurs Clément Delangue, Julien Chaumond and Thomas Wolf, Hugging Face also provides datasets, software tools and cloud services used to build AI applications.
body.zh: 英伟达已同意收购人工智能平台 Hugging Face，交易价值约 129 亿美元（合 95 亿英镑），这是这家人工智能芯片制造商向软件领域扩张的最大收购案之一。 Hugging Face 成立于 2016 年，现已成为一个流行的在线平台，开发人员和研究人员可以在其中查找、共享和测试人工智能模型和工具。 最近，在其平台上出现了逃离测试环境的流氓人工智能代理后，该公司成为了头条新闻，引发了有关人工智能安全和监督的质疑。 这笔交易将把世界上最大的人工智能开发者社区之一引入英伟达，并使其控制领先的开源平台——这是 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 提供的系统的替代品。 Nvidia 以制造用于训练和运行人工智能系统的先进芯片而闻名。随着公司竞相开发人工智能产品，对这些芯片的需求激增。 两家公司已经合作，帮助开发人员通过该平台使用 Nvidia 的计算服务。 据两家公司称，Hugging Face 已被超过 1800 万开发者使用，并托管超过 300 万个人工智能模型。他们表示，超过 20 万家公司使用该平台。 英伟达表示，Hugging Face 将继续向开发者开放，并且不会要求用户使用其芯片或服务。 根据协议，英伟达将向 Hugging Face 投资者支付约 119 亿美元，并向加入该公司的员工提供高达 10 亿美元的股票激励。 这笔交易还可以帮助英伟达扩大其在人工智能软件领域的影响力，因为包括微软、Meta 和 OpenAI 在内的一些最大客户都在开发自己的芯片。 与许多由单个公司控制的人工智能系统不同，开源人工智能模型可以由用户下载和调整。 支持者表示，这种方法可以使企业、研究人员和开发人员更容易使用该技术。 倡导组织消费者选择中心副主任 Yaël Ossowski 表示，此次收购是“对开放人工智能的信任票”，并表示它可以通过让初创企业和小公司更广泛地使用人工智能工具来鼓励竞争。 他补充说，如果英伟达保持 Hugging Face 的开放性和可访问性，这笔交易将是“全球创新者和消费者的重大胜利”。 随着该行业竞争的加剧，这笔交易还将使英伟达能够进入世界上最大的人工智能开发者社区之一。 Hugging Face 由法国企业家 Clément Delangue、Julien Chaumond 和 Thomas Wolf 创立，还提供用于构建人工智能应用程序的数据集、软件工具和云服务。

reflection.en: The rapid acceleration of knowledge, particularly in artificial intelligence, is a hallmark of our time. This acquisition by Nvidia underscores the immense value and potential seen in AI platforms like Hugging Face, which serve as hubs for innovation and collaboration among developers. As we witness this explosion of knowledge, it calls us to consider its...
reflection.zh: 知识的快速发展，尤其是在人工智能领域，是我们这个时代的标志。英伟达的此次收购凸显了像Hugging Face这样的人工智能平台所蕴含的巨大价值和潜力，它们是开发者创新与协作的中心。当我们见证知识的爆炸式增长时，这促使我们思考其目的和伦理应用，在技术进步的同时寻求智慧。

verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

summary.zh: BBC的佐伊·克莱因曼周四乘坐Uber的自动驾驶机器人出租车，该服务已在伦敦推出。伦敦的顾客现在可以乘坐英国首批机器人出租车，因为Uber于周四推出了其自动驾驶迷你出租车，成为首家推出此服务的公司。最初，该公司在伦敦只有15辆获得运营许可的自动驾驶汽车，每辆车都必须配备一名人类安全驾驶员。目前，机器人出租车的英国票价将...

body.en:
Customers in London can now travel in the UK's first robotaxis as Uber launches its self-driving minicab on Thursday - the company is the first to launch the service.

Initially, it only has 15 autonomous vehicles with a licence to operate in the city, and each one must have a human safety driver behind the wheel ready to take control if anything goes wrong.

At the moment, the UK fare for a robotaxi ride will be the same fare as a standard UberX, Uber Electric, or Uber Comfort journey, with upfront fares shown in the app.

The BBC's Zoe Kleinman was the first British journalist to hail a self-driving Uber in London - here's how the ride went.
body.zh: 优步周四推出了自动驾驶小型出租车，伦敦的顾客现在可以乘坐英国第一辆机器人出租车出行——该公司是第一家推出这项服务的公司。 最初，它只有 15 辆拥有在该市运营许可证的自动驾驶汽车，每辆汽车都必须配备一名人类安全驾驶员，随时准备在出现问题时接管控制。 目前，英国机器人出租车的票价将与标准 UberX、Uber Electric 或 Uber Comfort 旅程的票价相同，预付费用会显示在应用程序中。 BBC 的佐伊·克莱曼 (Zoe Kleinman) 是第一位在伦敦称赞自动驾驶 Uber 的英国记者 - 以下是乘坐过程。

reflection.en: The rollout of self-driving taxis in London marks a significant leap in technological advancement, bringing science fiction closer to reality. As Daniel prophesied, 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' This innovation promises convenience and efficiency, yet it also prompts reflection on how we integrate such powerful tools into our...
reflection.zh: 自动驾驶出租车在伦敦的推出标志着技术进步的重大飞跃，使科幻小说更接近现实。正如但以理所预言的，“许多人来往奔走，知识就必增长。”这项创新带来了便利和效率，但它也促使我们反思如何将如此强大的工具融入我们的生活和社会。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Creation Desk
title.zh: 受造世界

strap.en: The world Yahweh made — its wonders, and the toll of a warming, wounded earth.
strap.zh: 雅伟所造的世界——它的奇妙，以及一个渐暖、渐伤的地球所付的代价。

title.en: Jackdaw gasfield set to be approved by ministers this month, sources say
title.zh: 消息人士称，杰克多油气田将于本月获批

summary.en: Ministers are poised to approve a controversial new gasfield in the North Sea this month, according to government sources, and are considering approving a major oilfield later this year. Energy secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh will give her recommendation to approve the Jackdaw field off the coast of Aberdeen as soon as...
summary.zh: 据政府消息人士透露，部长们本月将批准一个备受争议的北海新气田，并考虑在今年晚些时候批准一个大型油田。据知情人士称，能源部长米亚塔·法恩布勒将在下周向批准阿伯丁海岸的杰克多气田提出建议，正式批准可能在一周后进行。

body.en: Energy secretary could recommend new North Sea drilling next week, as ministers also consider approval for Rosebank oilfield UK politics live – latest updates Business live – latest updates Ministers are poised to approve a controversial new gasfield in the North Sea this month, according to government sources, and are considering approving a major oilfield later this year. Miatta Fahnbulleh, the energy secretary, will give her recommendation to approve the Jackdaw field off the coast of Aberdeen as soon as next week, according to people close to the decision, and the formal approval could follow a week after. Continue reading...
body.zh: 能源大臣可能会建议下周在北海进行新的钻探，因为部长们也考虑批准罗斯班克油田 英国政治直播 - 最新更新 商业直播 - 最新更新 据政府消息人士称，部长们准备本月批准北海一个有争议的新气田，并考虑在今年晚些时候批准一个主要油田。据知情人士透露，能源部长 Miatta Fahnbulleh 最快将于下周提出批准阿伯丁海岸寒鸦油田的建议，正式批准可能会在一周后进行。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The potential approval of the Jackdaw gasfield and the Rosebank oilfield raises questions about our stewardship of the Earth's resources. Psalm 24:1 reminds us that 'The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it.' As we extract and utilize these resources, we are called to remember their divine origin and to manage them with wisdom and care for creation.
reflection.zh: 杰克多气田和罗斯班克油田的潜在批准，引发了关于我们如何管理地球资源的疑问。《诗篇》24篇1节提醒我们：“地和其中所充满的，世界和其中所居住的，都属雅伟为业。”当我们开采和利用这些资源时，我们被呼召要铭记它们的神圣起源，并以智慧和对受造物的关怀来管理它们。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Week in wildlife: a hitchhiking crab, a shy wallaby and penguins in little jackets
title.zh: 本周野生动物：搭便车的螃蟹、害羞的小袋鼠和穿小外套的企鹅

summary.en: This week’s best wildlife photographs from around the world.
summary.zh: 本周来自世界各地的最佳野生动物照片。

reflection.en: The sheer diversity and wonder captured in this week's wildlife photographs are a testament to the intricate beauty of creation. Each creature, from a hitchhiking crab to penguins in little jackets, reflects the profound wisdom and artistry of their Creator. These images invite us to pause and marvel at the world around us, recognizing that the natural...
reflection.zh: 本周野生动物照片中捕捉到的奇妙多样性，证明了造物的精妙之美。每一种生物，从搭便车的螃蟹到穿小外套的企鹅，都反映了其创造主的深邃智慧和艺术造诣。 这些图像邀请我们停下来惊叹于我们周围的世界，认识到自然界是雅伟品格和力量的深刻启示。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: Moveable feast: myna birds on Sydney train looking for food not ‘joyride’ in viral video
title.zh: 可移动的盛宴：悉尼火车上的八哥鸟在寻找食物，而不是在病毒视频中“兜风”

summary.en: Mynas are 'incredibly good learners' and likely hopped on the inner-city train to scrounge, an expert says. A viral video of common myna birds appearing to calmly ride a Sydney train instead of flying has shocked social media users, but experts say it makes sense as bird life has adapted to urban environments and...
summary.zh: 专家称，八哥是“学习能力极强的鸟类”，很可能是为了觅食而跳上了市内的火车。一段病毒视频显示，普通八哥鸟似乎平静地乘坐悉尼的火车，而不是飞行，这让社交媒体用户感到震惊，但专家认为这并不奇怪，因为鸟类已经适应了城市环境和公共交通。

body.en: Mynas are ‘incredibly good learners’ and likely hopped on the inner-city train to scrounge, expert says Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A viral video of common myna birds appearing to calmly ride a Sydney train in place of winged flight has shocked social media users. But not experts, who say it makes perfect sense that avian life has adapted to routinely navigate public transport. Bird life is ubiquitous in Australia’s urban landscapes. They appear in our shopping centres, our workplaces, our homes. To witness a feathered friend on a train isn’t exceptional. Continue reading...
body.zh: 专家表示，八哥是“非常好的学习者”，很可能会跳上市中心的火车去乞讨。获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客。一段常见的八哥鸟似乎平静地乘坐悉尼火车而不是带翅膀飞行的病毒视频震惊了社交媒体用户。但专家们并不这么认为，他们认为鸟类已经适应了日常乘坐公共交通工具，这是完全有道理的。鸟类在澳大利亚的城市景观中随处可见。它们出现在我们的购物中心、我们的工作场所、我们的家中。在火车上目睹一位长着羽毛的朋友并不罕见。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The viral video of myna birds riding a Sydney train offers a glimpse into the remarkable adaptability of creation. These 'incredibly good learners' are not on a joyride, but are seeking sustenance, demonstrating a practical wisdom honed by their environment. This reminds us that Yahweh's creation is full of lessons, inviting us to observe and learn from the...
reflection.zh: 悉尼火车上八哥鸟的病毒视频，让我们得以一窥受造界惊人的适应能力。这些“学习能力极强的鸟类”并非在兜风，而是在寻找食物，展现了它们因环境而磨练出的实用智慧。这提醒我们，雅伟的创造充满了教训，邀请我们观察并学习生命适应和繁荣的复杂方式。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Australian ski resorts to close up to a month early due to global heating and El Niño
title.zh: 由于全球变暖和厄尔尼诺现象，澳大利亚滑雪胜地将提前一个月关闭

summary.en: ‘Challenging’ weather conditions and lack of snowfall are being blamed after a winter that broke multiple heat records Sign up for climate and environment editor Adam Morton’s free Clear Air newsletter here Major Australian alpine resorts are closing their ski operations up to a...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: ‘Challenging’ weather conditions and lack of snowfall are being blamed after a winter that broke multiple heat records Sign up for climate and environment editor Adam Morton’s free Clear Air newsletter here Major Australian alpine resorts are closing their ski operations up to a month early after a winter that broke multiple records for heat with limited snow falls being washed away by rain. Predictions in June that a building El Niño could combine with global heating for a challenging ski season came to pass , with seven resorts either already closed or announcing ski lifts will stop operating this weekend. Sign up to get climate and environment editor Adam Morton’s Clear Air column as a free newsletter Continue reading...
body.zh: 在打破多项高温记录的冬季之后，人们将责任归咎于“具有挑战性”的天气条件和降雪量不足。在经历了打破多项高温记录的冬季后，澳大利亚主要高山度假村提前一个月关闭滑雪场，有限的降雪被雨水冲走。六月份的预测是，厄尔尼诺现象可能会与全球变暖相结合，导致滑雪季节充满挑战，这一预测最终成为现实，七个度假村要么已经关闭，要么宣布滑雪缆车将在本周末停止运营。注册以获取气候与环境编辑 Adam Morton 的 Clear Air 专栏作为免费时事通讯 继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to stewardship, provision, and the common good. 1 Peter 4:10 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with stewardship that serves neighbours, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到管家责任、供应与公共福祉。1 Peter 4:10提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以服事邻舍的好管家心态来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Revealed: how companies ‘secretly’ use billions of litres of public water in drought-hit England
title.zh: 揭露：在干旱的英格兰，公司如何‘秘密地’消耗数十亿升公共用水

summary.en: Exclusive: As millions of people face hosepipe bans, many companies are not required to report, let alone cut, their use of public water supplies. Less than 1% of businesses in England use more water than the daily needs of 10 million people, while millions of households face hosepipe bans and three-quarters of the...
summary.zh: 独家报道：在数百万人面临限水令的同时，许多公司却无需报告，更不用说削减其公共供水的使用量。英格兰不到1%的企业用水量超过了1000万人的日常需求，而数百万家庭却面临限水令，全国四分之三的地区处于干旱之中。据英格兰商业用水市场运营商Mosl称，英格兰的企业每天从公共供水中消耗26亿升水，其中三分之二的消耗量集中在缺水地区...

body.en: Exclusive: As millions of people face hosepipe bans, many companies are not required to report, let alone cut, use of public supply Less than 1% of businesses in England use more water than the daily needs of 10 million people, as millions of households face hosepipe bans and three-quarters of the country is in drought. Businesses across England use 2.6bn litres a day from the public water supply, which includes potable and non-potable water provided by water companies. In total, businesses account for about 30% of public supply use, with two-thirds of their consumption in water-stressed areas, according to Mosl, the organisation that operates England’s business water market. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家报道：由于数百万人面临软管管道禁令，许多公司不需要报告公共供应的使用情况，更不用说削减了。英格兰只有不到 1% 的企业用水量超过 1000 万人的日常用水量，因为数百万家庭面临软管管道禁令，而且该国四分之三的地区正处于干旱之中。英格兰各地的企业每天使用 26 亿升公共供水，其中包括自来水公司提供的饮用水和非饮用水。据运营英格兰商业用水市场的组织 Mosl 称，总体而言，企业用水量约占公共供水量的 30%，其中三分之二的用水量来自缺水地区。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In England, millions face water restrictions while companies consume billions of liters without public accountability. This disparity raises questions about fairness and responsible stewardship of shared resources. Yahweh calls us to act justly, show mercy, and walk humbly, principles that should guide how we manage the earth's precious gifts for the common...
reflection.zh: 在英格兰，数百万人面临用水限制，而公司却在无需公开问责的情况下消耗着数十亿升的水。这种差异引发了关于公平和共同资源负责任管理的疑问。雅伟呼召我们行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心，这些原则应指导我们如何管理地球宝贵的恩赐，以造福大众。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Genetic road map offers hope for threatened Visayan spotted deer
title.zh: 基因图谱为濒危的维萨扬斑鹿带来希望

summary.en: Scientists have sequenced the first draft genome of the Visayan spotted deer, a critically endangered species in the Philippines. This genetic map is expected to aid conservation efforts aimed at preventing its extinction, as the population has dwindled to around 700 individuals due to habitat loss and hunting.
summary.zh: 菲律宾的科学家们已完成了对极度濒危的维萨扬斑鹿的基因组测序初稿。这一基因图谱有望帮助保护该物种免于灭绝，因其数量已因栖息地破坏和狩猎而锐减至约700只。

body.en: Scientists have sequenced the first-ever draft genome of the Philippines’ highly threatened Visayan spotted deer. The genome could guide efforts to save it from extinction, reports contributor Pippo Carmona for Mongabay. The Visayan spotted deer (Rusa alfredi) was once found across six islands in the central Philippines. But deforestation and hunting decimated its population, prompting the IUCN, the global wildlife conservation authority, to list it as endangered in 1988. By 2019, Philippine authorities had classified the species as nationally critically endangered. The last count from 2016 recorded only about 700 mature individuals, now only found on the islands of Negros and Panay. To understand the genetic health of the species, researchers from Silliman University and the Philippine Genome Center Visayas collaborated to map its DNA. They used a tissue sample from Abraham, a captive Visayan spotted deer that was raised and died at Silliman University’s Center for Tropical Conservation Studies (CENTROP). The sequenced genome contains 2.5 billion DNA letters and 24,531 genes. It’s the first genome that’s been sequenced for any of the Philippines’ endangered mammals. The researchers found Abraham’s heterozygosity score, a measure of genetic differences, was just 0.17, far below the 0.3 score typical of healthy, genetically diverse wild populations. The low score indicates his parents were genetically closely related. “Since Abraham is from a captive population, we expected to get a low heterozygosity result,” said Albert Noblezada, who runs the bioinformatics pipeline at the Philippine Genome Center Visayas. Noblezada added that decades of isolation have allowed inbreeding…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 科学家们对菲律宾高度濒危的米沙鄢梅花鹿的第一个基因组草案进行了测序。 Mongabay 撰稿人皮波·卡莫纳 (Pippo Carmona) 报道称，该基因组可以指导拯救其免于灭绝的努力。米沙鄢梅花鹿（Rusa alfredi）曾在菲律宾中部的六个岛屿上被发现。但森林砍伐和狩猎导致其数量锐减，促使全球野生动物保护机构 IUCN 在 1988 年将其列为濒危物种。到 2019 年，菲律宾当局已将该物种列为国家极度濒危物种。 2016 年的最新统计仅记录了约 700 只成熟个体，目前仅在内格罗斯岛和班乃岛发现。为了了解该物种的遗传健康状况，西利曼大学和菲律宾维萨亚斯基因组中心的研究人员合作绘制了其 DNA 图谱。他们使用了亚伯拉罕的组织样本，亚伯拉罕是一只圈养的米沙鄢梅花鹿，在西利曼大学热带保护研究中心（CENTROP）饲养并死亡。已测序的基因组包含 25 亿个 DNA 字母和 24,531 个基因。这是菲律宾第一个濒危哺乳动物的基因组测序。研究人员发现，亚伯拉罕的杂合度得分（遗传差异的衡量标准）仅为 0.17，远低于健康、遗传多样性野生种群的典型得分 0.3。低分表明他的父母在遗传上密切相关。 “由于亚伯拉罕来自圈养种群，我们预计会得到低杂合性的结果，”菲律宾米沙鄢基因组中心生物信息学管道负责人阿尔伯特·诺布尔扎达 (Albert Noblezada) 说。 Noblezada 补充道，数十年的隔离使得近亲繁殖成为可能……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The intricate genetic code of the Visayan spotted deer, now mapped by scientists, reveals the profound wonder of creation. Each species is a testament to the Creator's artistry and wisdom, a complex design that inspires awe and calls for careful stewardship. May this scientific endeavor lead to renewed care for this unique creature.
reflection.zh: 维萨扬斑鹿复杂的基因密码如今已被科学家绘制出来，这揭示了造物之工的深邃奇妙。每一个物种都彰显着造物主的艺术与智慧，其精妙的设计令人惊叹，并呼唤我们悉心守护。愿这项科学的努力能带来对这一独特生灵的更新的关爱。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: Country diary: It’s 10am at the Melplash Show and the cider contest is well under way | Sara Hudston
title.zh: 乡村日记：梅尔普拉什展上午10点，苹果酒大赛如火如荼

summary.en: The annual Melplash Show in Bridport, Dorset, featured a cider contest, livestock displays, and local produce. Attendees enjoyed the festivities, though there was some concern among producers about the year's apple harvest.
summary.zh: 在多塞特郡布里德波特举行的年度梅尔普拉什展上，展出了苹果酒比赛、牲畜展示和当地农产品。与会者享受了节日的乐趣，尽管生产商对今年的苹果收成有些担忧。

body.en: Bridport, Dorset: Away from the sheep, pigs and Martin Clunes’s horse, I find a bounty of local ciders – and concern about this year’s apple harvest It’s Melplash Show day and all of Bridport is here. Crowds jostle for a look at the pigs, cattle and sheep. The actor Martin Clunes, who lives locally, leads one of his heavy horses into the ring, a big strawberry roan gelding with a mane plaited with ribbons. Everyone ignores the celebrity: they are far more interested in the finer points of his horse. In the handicrafts and local produce tent, lines of glass cider bottles glow palest amber and urinous gold. The two judges, the cider-maker Ross Mangles of North Down Orchard, and the cider writer James Crowden, began tasting at 8.30am. Fortified with a block of blue-veined cheddar cheese, a packet of cream crackers and a glass of water, they have sampled all 36 entries by 10am. When I join them for the results, the winning bottles are at least a quarter empty, and Ross and James are feeling upbeat. Continue reading...
body.zh: 多塞特郡布里德波特：远离羊、猪和 Martin Clunes 的马，我发现了丰富的当地苹果酒 - 以及对今年苹果收成的担忧 今天是 Melplash Show 日，整个布里德波特都在这里。人们争先恐后地观看猪、牛和羊。住在当地的演员马丁·克鲁内斯 (Martin Clunes) 牵着他的一匹重马进入赛场，这是一匹巨大的草莓花色骟马，鬃毛上缠着丝带。每个人都忽略了名人：他们对他的马的优点更感兴趣。在手工艺品和当地农产品的帐篷里，一排排玻璃苹果酒瓶闪烁着淡琥珀色和淡金色的光芒。两位评委，北唐果园 (North Down Orchard) 的苹果酒制造商罗斯·曼格尔斯 (Ross Mangles) 和苹果酒作家詹姆斯·克劳登 (James Crowden) 于上午 8.30 开始品尝。他们用一块蓝纹切达干酪、一包奶油饼干和一杯水进行强化，截至上午 10 点，他们已经对所有 36 款产品进行了采样。当我和他们一起查看结果时，获胜的瓶子至少有四分之一是空的，罗斯和詹姆斯感到很乐观。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The Melplash Show in Bridport, Dorset, beautifully illustrates humanity's connection to the land, as locals gather to celebrate the bounty of ciders and other produce. This event, with its focus on cultivation and the subtle concern for the apple harvest, reminds us of our ancient calling to work and care for creation. It's a tangible expression of our...
reflection.zh: 在多塞特郡布里德波特的梅尔普拉什展上，当地人聚集一堂，庆祝丰盛的苹果酒和其他农产品，这生动地展现了人类与土地的联系。这项活动，以其对耕作的关注以及对今年苹果收成的细微担忧，提醒我们古老的呼召，即耕耘和看顾雅伟的创造。这是我们与雅伟合作，从大地中带来美好事物的具体体现。

verse.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verse.textZh: 雅伟神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。

title.en: Judge rules 2,000 Catalina Island deer can be killed to save native plant species
title.zh: 法官裁定可杀死 2,000 只圣卡塔利娜岛鹿以拯救本地植物物种

summary.en: A judge has allowed the island's conservancy to proceed with killing nearly all of Catalina Island's 2,000 mule deer. These deer consume native shrubs, which in turn allows fast-igniting grasses to spread. The decision comes despite significant opposition from locals and tourists who have long cherished the deer...
summary.zh: 一名法官已允许该岛保护协会继续杀死圣卡塔利娜岛上近 2,000 只骡鹿。这些鹿以本地灌木为食，导致易燃的草类得以蔓延。尽管当地居民和游客长期以来一直珍视这些近一个世纪以来一直是岛上熟悉景色的鹿群，并对此表示强烈反对，但该裁决仍得以通过。

body.en: Cull of animals that eat native shrubs, causing spread of fast-igniting grasses, to go ahead despite fierce opposition Locals and tourists have long fawned over Catalina Island’s mule deer population. For nearly a century, the ungulates have roamed the land’s waterfronts and woodlands, so comfortable around humans that it is not uncommon to spot deer roaming downtown Avalon. But that sight will soon disappear, after a judge this week paved the way for the island’s conservancy to kill nearly all the island’s 2,000 deer. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尽管遭到强烈反对，但仍继续扑杀以本地灌木为食的动物，导致快速燃烧的草类蔓延。当地人和游客长期以来一直对卡塔利娜岛的黑尾鹿种群表示欢迎。近一个世纪以来，有蹄类动物一直在这片土地的海滨和林地中漫步，它们在人类周围非常舒适，因此在阿瓦隆市中心漫步的鹿并不罕见。但这种景象很快就会消失，因为本周一名法官为该岛的保护机构杀死了岛上几乎所有的 2000 只鹿铺平了道路。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The delicate balance of ecosystems, like the one on Catalina Island, reveals the profound wisdom woven into Yahweh's creation. When human intervention becomes necessary to restore that balance, as with the deer cull, it underscores the intricate interconnectedness of life and our responsibility to steward it.
reflection.zh: 圣卡塔利娜岛上生态系统的微妙平衡，彰显了雅伟创造中蕴含的深邃智慧。当人类干预成为恢复这种平衡的必要手段时，例如这次的鹿群扑杀，就凸显了生命之间错综复杂的相互联系，以及我们管理它的责任。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Ebola outbreak underscores food insecurity crisis in DRC
title.zh: 埃博拉疫情加剧刚果（金）粮食不安全危机

summary.en: The Bundibugyo strain of Ebola has caused over 3,000 deaths and twice as many cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Concurrently, approximately 26 million people in the region face a food insecurity crisis, which exacerbates the spread and lethality of the virus, as hunger and disease are described as "old...
summary.zh: 在刚果（民主共和国），由邦迪布吉奥（Bundibugyo）埃博拉病毒引起的疫情已导致超过3000人死亡，报告病例数是死亡人数的两倍以上。与此同时，该地区约有2600万人正经历粮食不安全危机，这加剧了病毒的传播和致命性，正如世界卫生组织总干事所言，“饥饿与疾病是老友”。

body.en: The recent Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain of the virus has reportedly claimed more than 3,000 lives, and more than twice as many reported cases, in the Democratic Republic of Congo, according to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. At the same time, analysts warn that roughly 26 million people across the region are experiencing a food insecurity crisis, a compounding factor that increases both the spread and lethality of the virus. “Hunger and disease are old companions,” Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, director-general of the World Health Organization, said in a statement referring to the outbreak. “People weakened by hunger are far more vulnerable to infections.” Ebola weakens the immune system, making it more difficult for the body to fight the disease and recover once infected. Healthy food can both support an immune system response and improve conditions for medications to work properly, thus accelerating recovery, Grace Kwakezime Mongame, emergency nutritionist at the World Food Programme in DRC, told Mongabay in a call. A lack of reliable food can force people out of their homes where they potentially spread or contract the disease from others in the community. “Since the disease is transmitted through contact, moving around risks creating new layers of infection; the aim is to keep people within a single environment, Kwakezime said. WFP also provides food to patients’ families, especially dependent children, so the sick can rest and recover instead of leaving isolation to care for their dependents. The need for food can also…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 据美国疾病控制与预防中心称，最近由本迪布焦病毒株引起的埃博拉疫情在刚果民主共和国造成了 3,000 多人死亡，报告病例数是报告病例数的两倍多。与此同时，分析人士警告称，该地区约 2600 万人正在经历粮食不安全危机，这一复杂因素加剧了病毒的传播和致命性。世界卫生组织总干事谭德塞在一份声明中谈到此次疫情时表示：“饥饿和疾病是老伴。” “因饥饿而虚弱的人更容易受到感染。”埃博拉病毒会削弱免疫系统，使身体更难抵抗疾病并在感染后恢复。刚果民主共和国世界粮食计划署紧急营养师 Grace Kwakezime Mongame 在电话中告诉 Mongabay，健康食品既可以支持免疫系统反应，又可以改善药物正常发挥作用的条件，从而加速康复。缺乏可靠的食物可能会迫使人们离开家，他们可能会从社区中的其他人那里传播或感染疾病。 Kwakezime 说：“由于这种疾病是通过接触传播的，走动有可能造成新的感染层；目的是让人们呆在一个单一的环境中。粮食计划署还向患者家属，特别是受抚养的儿童提供食物，这样病人就可以休息和康复，而不是离开隔离来照顾他们的家属。对食物的需求也可以......本文最初发表在 Mongabay 上

reflection.en: The news from the Democratic Republic of Congo paints a stark picture of how hunger and disease intertwine, making vulnerable populations even more susceptible to deadly outbreaks like Ebola. The WHO director's observation that "hunger and disease are old companions" underscores the urgent need for practical compassion, sharing our resources to alleviate...
reflection.zh: 来自刚果（民主共和国）的消息描绘了一幅严峻的图景，说明了饥饿与疾病如何交织在一起，使弱势群体更容易感染埃博拉等致命疫情。世界卫生组织总干事关于“饥饿与疾病是老友”的说法，凸显了实际怜悯的紧迫性，即分享我们的资源以减轻痛苦。当我们满足饥饿者的基本需求时，我们也增强了他们抵御其他危机的能力。

verse.textEn: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter — when you see the naked, to clothe them?
verse.textZh: 不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人，将飘流的穷人接到你家中，见赤身的给他衣服遮体？

title.en: Key tree species boost Amazon forest restoration, new study shows
title.zh: 关键树种助力亚马逊雨林恢复，新研究表明

summary.en: A new study in the Brazilian Amazon highlights the critical role of a few hyperdominant tree species in restoring biodiversity and carbon stocks in deforested areas, suggesting these species are key to preventing a 'quiet collapse' of regenerating forests.
summary.zh: 一项在巴西亚马逊地区进行的新研究强调，少数占主导地位的树种在恢复森林砍伐地区的生物多样性和碳储量方面起着至关重要的作用，这表明这些物种是防止再生森林“悄然崩溃”的关键。

body.en: A few tree species are key to restoring biodiversity and carbon storage in deforested areas of the Brazilian Amazon, suggests an article published in June in Global Change Biology. Researchers examined 102 plots under natural regeneration in four municipalities in Pará state — Bragantina, Marabá, Paragominas and Santarém — and concluded that a range of 15 to 25 species accounted for nearly half of the trees present and half of the plots’ carbon stocks. ​Among these species are the embaúba (Cecropia palmata), the tatapiririca (Tapirira guianensis), the ingá-vermelho (Inga alba), and the araticum-bravo (Annona exsucca). ​This relatively short list of hyperdominant species could “guide assisted restoration and enrichment strategies” in the Amazon, the researchers said, and help Brazil meet the goal of restoring 12 million hectares (30 million acres) of forests by 2030, an area roughly the size of North Korea. ​“These areas are already restoring [ecological] services and biodiversity,” Fernando Elias, a researcher in Pará’s Emílio Goeldi Museum and the coordinator of the study, told Mongabay. “That is why it is so important to understand how these forests behave.” According to Elias, the Brazilian Amazon has more than 140,000 square kilometers (around 57,000 square miles) of regrowing forests in areas previously deforested, known as secondary forests. In many cases, these lands have been abandoned after being used for cattle ranching. ​Most of it has the potential to recover naturally, without the need to plant a single seed. Close monitoring, however, is necessary to control fires, cattle ranching and land…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 六月发表在《全球变化生物学》杂志上的一篇文章指出，一些树种对于恢复巴西亚马逊森林砍伐地区的生物多样性和碳储存至关重要。研究人员检查了帕拉州四个城市（布拉干蒂纳、马拉巴、帕拉戈米纳斯和圣塔伦）的 102 个自然更新地块，得出的结论是，15 至 25 个物种占现有树木的近一半和地块碳储量的一半。这些物种包括 embaúba (Cecropia palmata)、tatapiirica (Tapirira guianensis)、ingá-vermelho (Inga alba) 和 araticum-bravo (Annona exsucca)。研究人员表示，这个相对较短的超级优势物种清单可以“指导亚马逊地区的辅助恢复和富集策略”，并帮助巴西实现到 2030 年恢复 1200 万公顷（3000 万英亩）森林的目标，该面积大约相当于朝鲜的面积。 â�<“这些地区已经在恢复[生态]服务和生物多样性，”帕拉州埃米利奥戈尔迪博物馆的研究员兼该研究的协调员费尔南多·埃利亚斯告诉Mongabay。 “这就是为什么了解这些森林的行为如此重要。”据埃利亚斯介绍，巴西亚马逊地区在之前被砍伐的地区有超过 140,000 平方公里（约 57,000 平方英里）的再生森林，称为次生林。在许多情况下，这些土地在用于养牛后就被废弃了。​其中大部分都有可能自然恢复，无需种植一粒种子。然而，密切监控对于控制火灾、养牛场和土地是必要的……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: Scientists have identified a handful of tree species essential for the Amazon's recovery, offering hope for restoring these vital ecosystems. This echoes the Genesis account where Yahweh surveyed all that He had made and declared it 'very good.' The intricate web of life, from the smallest seed to the grandest tree, reflects a divine artistry that calls for...
reflection.zh: 科学家们已经确定了对亚马逊恢复至关重要的少数几种树木，这为恢复这些重要的生态系统带来了希望。这与创世记中雅伟审视他一切所造之物并宣告“甚好”的记载相呼应。生命错综复杂的网络，从最小的种子到最宏伟的树木，都反映了神圣的艺术，呼唤我们谨慎地管理。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Cherokee youth win legal rights for waterway in first all-female U.S. effort
title.zh: 切罗基女孩在全女性美国首次努力中赢得水道的法律权利

summary.en: Young Cherokee women successfully advocated for the legal rights of a waterway, bringing water from its headwaters in traditional pottery into the council chambers. Their effort, supported by a large crowd, resulted in a unanimous tribal council resolution on January 8, 2026, in North Carolina.
summary.zh: 年轻的切罗基女性成功争取到一条水道的法律权利，她们将传统陶罐中收集的水源从源头带入议事厅。她们的努力得到了众多支持者的声援，并于2026年1月8日在北卡罗来纳州获得了部落委员会的一致通过。

body.en: Before the proceedings began, the young women carried Longperson into the room with them, water gathered from the mountain headwaters and held in traditional pottery. The chamber filled beyond capacity, supporters spilling into the lobby. When the vote came, the council passed the resolution unanimously. The crowd and the council rose in standing ovation. On Jan. 8, 2026, the Eastern Band of Cherokee Indians (EBCI) Tribal Council convened in Cherokee, in what is today the U.S. state of North Carolina, to consider a resolution brought forward by the NAIWA Daughters, the youth arm of the North American Indian Women’s Association, made up of a group of Indigenous girls between the ages of 10 and 17. The resolution recognizes the inherent legal rights of the Longperson, or vwi Ganvhida, the interconnected waterway system whose headwaters rise in the Great Smoky Mountains and travel more than 1,270 kilometers (790 miles), branching through multiple states before its “feet,” as the Cherokee describe it, reach the Gulf of Mexico. To the Tribe, Longperson (formerly Long Man) is a living entity of great cultural and spiritual significance. Zailiana Blythe, from NAIWA Daughters, speaks to the Council at the podium. Image from EBCI Tribal Council live-stream recording. “The room was heavy with the presence of Ancestors and community alike,” said Jasmine Smith, NAIWA Daughters chair and co-founder, describing the moment in a keynote speech at the Bioneers Conference in Berkeley, California. She delivered her speech wearing the moccasins of her Ancestor Ruth Littlejohn. “That day crystallized…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 在诉讼开始前，年轻妇女们将朗曼带到了房间，水从山源收集并装在传统的陶器中。会议厅挤满了人，支持者涌入大厅。表决时，理事会一致通过了该决议。人群和议会起立鼓掌。 2026 年 1 月 8 日，切罗基印第安人东部部落 (EBCI) 部落理事会在切罗基（今天的美国北卡罗来纳州）召开会议，审议由北美印第安妇女协会的青年组织 NAIWA 女儿提出的一项决议，该组织由一群 10 至 17 岁的土著女孩组成。该决议承认长人的固有合法权利，或Ganvhidv Asgaya 是一个相互连接的水道系统，其源头发源于大烟山，行程超过 1,270 公里（790 英里），分支穿过多个州，然后用切罗基人的话说，到达墨西哥湾。对于部落来说，龙人（以前的龙人）是一个具有重大文化和精神意义的生物体。来自 NAIWA Daughters 的 Zailiana Blythe 在讲台上向理事会发表讲话。图片来自 EBCI 部落理事会直播录制。 “房间里挤满了祖先和社区的人，”NAIWA Daughters 主席兼联合创始人 Jasmine Smith 在加州伯克利举行的 Bioneers 会议上发表主题演讲时描述了这一时刻。她穿着她祖先露丝·利特尔约翰 (Ruth Littlejohn) 的鹿皮鞋发表演讲。 “那一天具体化了……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: These young women, carrying water from the headwaters, embodied a deep connection to their ancestral lands and the natural world. Their successful advocacy for the waterway demonstrates the power of a clear voice speaking for the voiceless, reminding us that even the most vulnerable parts of creation deserve our defense and care. Their victory is a...
reflection.zh: 这些年轻女性带着源头的水，体现了她们与祖传土地和自然世界的深厚联系。她们为水道成功进行的倡导，展示了清晰的声音为无声者发声的力量，提醒我们，即使是造物中最脆弱的部分也值得我们去捍卫和关爱。她们的胜利证明了植根于传统和对遗产的热爱的、持续而忠实的行动的力量。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: A ‘lost’ Philippine pigeon reappears after 20 years — but its forest is disappearing
title.zh: “失踪”的菲律宾鸽子在 20 年后重新出现——但它的森林正在消失

summary.en: A camera trap on the Philippine island of Mindoro has photographed one of the country’s rarest birds, confirming that the critically endangered Mindoro bleeding-heart pigeon still survives in the wild. Captured in August in the Puerto Galera rainforest, the image is the first confirmed photograph of the species...
summary.zh: 菲律宾民都洛岛的一台相机陷阱拍摄到了该国最稀有的鸟类之一，证实了濒危的民都洛血胸鸽仍然野外生存。根据非营利组织菲律宾保护创新中心（CCIPH）的说法，这张于 8 月在波多黎各加莱拉雨林拍摄到的照片是二十年来首次确认拍摄到该物种 Gallicolumba platenae。

body.en: A camera trap on the Philippine island of Mindoro has photographed one of the country’s rarest birds, confirming that the critically endangered Mindoro bleeding-heart pigeon still survives in the wild. Captured in August in the Puerto Galera rainforest, the image is the first confirmed photograph of the species Gallicolumba platenae in two decades, according to the nonprofit organization Center for Conservation Innovation Ph Inc. (CCIPH). “For an extremely rare and secretive species, a single image can carry enormous weight,” CCIPH researchers wrote in a Sept. 3 announcement. “It confirms that the bird continues to survive within the landscape.” Juan Carlos Gonzalez, an ornithologist and curator for birds at the Museum of Natural History at the University of the Philippines Los Baños, independently confirmed that the image shows a Mindoro bleeding-heart. “This record not only proves that this very rare species continues to persist in these steep rainforests, but solidifies the importance of Puerto Galera as a UNESCO biosphere reserve and an important sanctuary for this critically endangered species,” Gonzalez told Mongabay by email. Mindoro Bleeding-heart captured via camera trap. Image courtesy of CCIPH. Alex Berryman, who oversees species conservation assessments for Asia at the NGO BirdLife International, also separately confirmed the identification. “There is no doubt that this refers to a Mindoro bleeding-heart,” Berryman told Mongabay by email. Berryman said the orange-red spot on the bird’s otherwise white chest, together with the iridescent green plumage on its head and neck, make it readily identifiable. Gonzalez also pointed to its blue-green…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 菲律宾民都洛岛上的一个相机陷阱拍摄到了该国最稀有的鸟类之一，证实极度濒危的民都洛血心鸽仍然在野外生存。据非营利组织保护创新中心 (CCIPH) 称，这张照片于 8 月在加莱拉港热带雨林拍摄，是二十年来第一张经证实的 Gallicolumba Platenae 物种照片。 CCIPH 研究人员在 9 月 3 日的一份公告中写道：“对于一种极其稀有且神秘的物种，一张图像可以承载巨大的重量。” “这证实了这只鸟继续在这片土地上生存。”鸟类学家、菲律宾洛斯巴尼奥斯大学自然历史博物馆馆长胡安·卡洛斯·冈萨雷斯独立证实，该图像显示了民都洛岛流血的心脏。 “这一记录不仅证明了这种非常稀有的物种继续存在于这些陡峭的雨林中，而且巩固了加莱拉港作为联合国教科文组织生物圈保护区和这种极度濒危物种的重要保护区的重要性，”冈萨雷斯通过电子邮件告诉 Mongabay。通过相机陷阱捕捉到的民都洛岛流血心脏。图片由 CCIPH 提供。非政府组织国际鸟盟负责亚洲物种保护评估的亚历克斯·贝里曼（Alex Berryman）也单独证实了这一身份。 “毫无疑问，这指的是民都洛人的心在流血，”贝里曼通过电子邮件告诉 Mongabay。贝里曼说，这只鸟白色​​胸部上的橙红色斑点，加上头部和颈部的虹彩绿色羽毛，使其很容易辨认。冈萨雷斯还指出了它的蓝绿色和棕色……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The reappearance of the Mindoro bleeding-heart pigeon after two decades is a moment of profound wonder, reminding us of the intricate beauty Yahweh has woven into creation. Even as its forest habitat faces threats, this rediscovery offers a glimmer of hope and underscores the deep wisdom inherent in the natural world.
reflection.zh: 民都洛血胸鸽在二十年后重新出现，这是一个充满惊奇的时刻，提醒我们雅伟已将精妙之美编织进祂的创造之中。即使它的森林栖息地面临威胁，这次的重新发现也带来了一线希望，并强调了自然界固有的深邃智慧。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: A Surge of Marine Heat Waves Threatens to Scramble Ocean Life
title.zh: 海洋热浪激增，威胁要扰乱海洋生物

summary.en: Record-breaking marine heat waves, driven by climate change and a strengthening El Niño, are affecting oceans globally and severely disrupting marine life. Evidence suggests these events could cause long-lasting damage both on land and at sea. For example, an unusually large bloom of common octopuses has appeared off...
summary.zh: 受气候变化和不断增强的厄尔尼诺现象的推动，创纪录的海浪热浪正在席卷全球海洋，并对海洋生物造成严重破坏。越来越多的证据表明，这些事件可能对陆地和海洋都造成严重且持久的损害。例如，英国海岸出现了有史以来规模最大的普通章鱼幼体聚集现象，这与异常温暖的海水有关。

body.en:
Fueled by climate change and a strengthening El Niño, record-setting marine heat waves are gripping oceans worldwide and playing havoc with sea life. Mounting evidence from recent events suggests the damage could be severe and long-lasting, both onshore and off.

The common octopus is a warm water species that usually lives in the temperate waters of the Mediterranean. But last year, octopus larvae hitchhiked across the English Channel attached to plankton, resulting in an octopus bloom off England’s coast. This year, the bloom is the largest it’s been in 75 years.

Normally, octopus larvae that drift into cold waters die. But this year’s bloom, experts say, is the result of an unusually intense marine heat wave off of Devon and Cornwall, which raised water temperatures up to 9 degrees F above normal.

The change in species has been a boon for local fishers selling octopus into the lucrative European export market. (Octopus landings along the U.K.’s southwest coast were roughly 7,700 percent higher than usual in 2025.) And while the invasion has slashed the catch of scallops, lobster, and crab, it has boosted numbers of seals, conger eels, and dolphins, which eat octopus. The warming, in combination with abundant prey, has also drawn bluefin tuna and sharks to British waters for the first time in decades.

“It has completely shaken up the food chain,” said Bryce Stewart, a senior research fellow at the UK’s Marine Biological Association, which has been studying the phenomenon. While this kind of bloom has happened here before, he said, this one is different. During past surges, the return of cold water killed off the octopuses. This time, the octopuses aren’t dying. They’re reproducing.

Globally, marine heat waves — prolonged periods of unusually warm water — are becoming more common, more intense, longer lasting, and more widespread, experts say . This year, ocean heat is unusually severe, setting new temperature records . According to Global Climate Risks, a nonprofit created by scientists to publicize the effects of climate change, an estimated 82 percent of the world’s oceans are currently experiencing marine heat waves. Evidence from recent hot spells suggests the impacts on sea life could be profound and long-lasting.

Subscribe to the E360 Newsletter for weekly updates delivered to your inbox. Sign Up .

Ocean fevers can rearrange marine ecosystems, drive fish to move into deeper, colder layers of the sea, trigger coral bleaching, and cause widespread marine die-offs. They can increase the severity and number of algal blooms, which harm fish, shellfish, marine mammals, and birds. And they can cause extreme weather events, like tropical storms and hurricanes, and upend fishing and tourism.

To officially be called a heat wave, temperatures...
body.zh: 在气候变化和厄尔尼诺现象加剧的推动下，创纪录的海洋热浪正在席卷全球海洋，对海洋生物造成严重破坏。最近发生的事件中越来越多的证据表明，无论是陆上还是海上，损害都可能是严重且持久的。 普通章鱼是温水物种，通常生活在地中海温带水域。但去年，章鱼幼虫附着在浮游生物上，搭便车穿越英吉利海峡，导致英格兰海岸出现章鱼大量繁​​殖。今年的花期是 75 年来规模最大的一次。 通常情况下，章鱼幼虫漂入冷水后就会死亡。但专家表示，今年的水华是德文郡和康沃尔郡异常强烈的海洋热浪造成的，导致水温比正常水平高出 9 华氏度。 物种的变化对于将章鱼销往利润丰厚的欧洲出口市场的当地渔民来说是一个福音。 （2025 年，英国西南海岸的章鱼登陆量比平时增加了大约 7,700%。）虽然入侵减少了扇贝、龙虾和螃蟹的捕获量，但以章鱼为食的海豹、海鳗和海豚的数量却增加了。气候变暖加上丰富的猎物，几十年来首次将蓝鳍金枪鱼和鲨鱼吸引到英国水域。 “它彻底撼动了食物链，”一直在研究这一现象的英国海洋生物协会高级研究员布莱斯·斯图尔特说。他说，虽然以前这里也发生过这种花，但这次不同。在过去的海潮中，冷水的回归导致章鱼死亡。这一次，章鱼没有死。他们正在繁殖。 专家表示，在全球范围内，海洋热浪（长时间异常温暖的海水）正变得更加常见、更加强烈、持续时间更长、范围更广。今年，海洋高温异常严重，创下了新的气温记录。据科学家创建、旨在宣传气候变化影响的非营利组织“全球气候风险”估计，目前世界上 82% 的海洋正在经历海洋热浪。最近的高温天气的证据表明，这对海洋生物的影响可能是深远而持久的。 订阅 E360 新闻通讯，每周更新发送到您的收件箱。报名 。 海洋热可以重新安排海洋生态系统，促使鱼类进入更深、更冷的海层，引发珊瑚白化，并导致广泛的海洋死亡。它们会增加藻华的严重程度和数量，从而危害鱼类、贝类、海洋哺乳动物和鸟类。它们还可能引发热带风暴和飓风等极端天气事件，并颠覆渔业和旅游业。 正式称为热浪，温度...

reflection.en: The prophet Isaiah spoke of creation's deep sigh, and Romans 8 echoes this, describing all of creation groaning as in labor pains. We see this groaning in the oceans, where rising temperatures disrupt ancient ecosystems and lead to unexpected blooms, like the octopus surge off England's coast. It is a reminder that the natural world, in its current state,...
reflection.zh: 先知以赛亚曾提到受造界的深沉叹息，罗马书第八章也呼应了这一点，将万物描述为一同叹息，如同经历生产之苦。我们在海洋中看到了这种叹息，不断升高的温度扰乱了古老的生态系统，并导致了意想不到的生物爆发，例如英国海岸的章鱼激增。这提醒我们，自然界在其现状下，也承载着影响所有生命的堕落的痕迹。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: I camped in one of Britain’s last remaining rainforests
title.zh: 我在英国最后一片雨林之一露营

summary.en: A fragment of temperate rainforest on the edge of Dartmoor, the subject of years of conservation efforts, has now opened to the public with a sustainable campsite. The author describes their experience camping near this delicate ecosystem, known as Atlantic woodland.
summary.zh: 位于德文郡达特穆尔边缘的一小片温带雨林，经过多年的保育工作，现已开放并设有一个可持续露营地。作者描述了在这一脆弱生态系统——被称为大西洋林地——附近露营的经历。

body.en: A fragment of temperate rainforest lies on the edge of Dartmoor, and following years of conservation work, its owners have now opened up a sustainable campsite next to this fragile ecosystem Mist blankets the valley as I wheel my camping gear down the small hill towards a clearing ringed by trees and shrubs. A picnic bench sits at its edge, angled towards the reason why I’m here: one of the last remaining fragments of temperate rainforest in Britain. I’m pitching my tent at Wray Valley Camping, a low-impact site on Dartmoor’s eastern edge between Lustleigh and Moretonhampstead, where I’ll spend five days on one of the site’s “nearly wild” pitches. Also known as Atlantic woodland, temperate rainforests depend on a rare combination of high humidity, rainfall and consistently mild coastal temperatures where the sea moderates the climate. They once stretched from the western Highlands of Scotland down to Cornwall, covering 20% of the UK , and sheltering rare and delicate lichens and plants. Today more than 95% of our temperate rainforest cover is gone, but Devon’s near-constant dampness and its exposure to the Atlantic make it one of the last strongholds for this rare habitat. Continue reading...
body.zh: 达特穆尔边缘有一片温带雨林，经过多年的保护工作，它的主人现在在这个脆弱的生态系统旁边开辟了一个可持续的露营地。当我推着露营装备沿着小山坡走向一片树木和灌木环绕的空地时，薄雾笼罩着整个山谷。一条野餐长凳坐落在它的边缘，与我来这里的原因成一定角度：英国仅存的温带雨林碎片之一。我正在雷谷露营地搭帐篷，这是达特穆尔东部边缘勒斯特利和莫顿汉普斯特德之间一个影响较小的营地，我将在该营地“近乎荒野”的营地之一待上五天。温带雨林也被称为大西洋林地，依赖于高湿度、降雨量和持续温和的沿海温度（海洋调节气候）的罕见组合。它们曾经从苏格兰西部高地一直延伸到康沃尔郡，覆盖了英国20%的面积，并庇护着稀有而娇嫩的地衣和植物。如今，超过 95% 的温带雨林覆盖面已经消失，但德文郡几乎持续潮湿且暴露在大西洋中，使其成为这一稀有栖息地的最后据点之一。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The author's experience in Britain's dwindling temperate rainforest highlights the preciousness of creation. The Apostle Paul speaks of all creation groaning, awaiting its redemption (Romans 8:22). This fragile ecosystem, carefully tended, offers a glimpse of what Yahweh intends for all of nature.
reflection.zh: 作者在英国日益稀少的温带雨林中的经历，凸显了受造界的宝贵。使徒保罗提到，万物都在一同叹息，等候得赎（罗马书 8:22）。这片精心呵护的脆弱生态系统，让我们得以一窥雅伟对万物的心意。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Australia’s new environmental protection agency approves coal project, angering climate groups
title.zh: 澳大利亚新环保机构批准煤炭项目，激怒气候团体

summary.en: Australia's new national environmental protection agency has approved its first coal project, allowing the Saraji mine in Queensland to continue operations until 2055, despite clearing threatened woodland and koala habitat. This approval comes as Prime Minister Anthony Albanese denies tensions with Pacific leaders...

The confirmation of the extension of the Saraji mine, which digs and exports coal for steel making, comes after the prime minister, Anthony Albanese, denied this week there was tension over Australia’s fossil fuel exports during talks with Pacific leaders.
